title: Behavior Specialist - Hawaii School & In-Home
description:
Your First Step Into a Career That Changes Lives

This isn’t just an entry-level job. It’s the first step in a mapped-out journey — toward a degree, a promotion, and even leadership. At CSD, we don’t just hire people. We invite changemakers who believe that every child deserves to shine.

Starting Pay: $20–$27 per hour, based on experience

What Makes This Role Different:

  • Career Compass: clarity from day one with your growth pathway.
  • Dreams Come True: free college or tuition reimbursement to help you earn your degree.
  • Career Rewards: recognition and milestones as you grow.
  • Flexible schedules + paid training so you can learn, earn, and thrive.

What If Growth Wasn’t a Mystery? – Introducing CSD Career Rewards!

About Us

At Center for Social Dynamics (CSD), we believe in possibilities. From a child’s first session to every milestone after, we’re building futures filled with play, progress, and joy.

We meet kids where they are — at home, in schools, in the community — and help them grow through Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA). Every day is about connection, compassion, and celebrating breakthroughs big and small.

We live our TRUE values: Transparency, Respect, Understanding, and Excellence. It’s not just how we work — it’s who we are.

At CSD, we don’t just change lives. We light them up.

About the Opportunity

As a Behavior Specialist, Schools you’ll:

  • Use play, games, and evidence-based strategies to help kids build communication, social, and life skills in a school environment.
  • Bring energy and compassion to each session — whether it’s at a child’s home, one of our centers, or out in the community.
  • Follow personalized plans designed by our clinical leaders while celebrating small wins that lead to big growth.
  • Thrive in a flexible, on-the-go role where no two days look the same.

You don’t need prior experience — we’ll train you and support you every step of the way.

What Success Looks Like

  • Kids smiling because they can now say a new word, share a toy, or join in play; achieving life changing milestones.
  • Families feeling hope and relief because they see progress.
  • You growing through paid training, coaching, and mapped-out career milestones.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive pay + bonus opportunities
  • Paid drive time & mileage reimbursement
  • Company-issued cell phone
  • Free college or tuition reimbursement (Dreams Come True Program)
  • Hands-on training, career advancement, and a vibrant team culture

About You

This role is for you if:

  • You love working with kids and making a difference.
  • You bring patience, energy, and optimism to every session.
  • You thrive in flexible, dynamic environments.
  • You’re ready to grow your career while helping kids grow, too.

Requirements:

  • H.S. Diploma or GED
  • Availability: Monday-Friday, 8:00-3:30 pm
  • At least 6 months' experience working with special needs in a school or related setting preferred.
  • Current CPR certification preferred
  • Proof of vaccinations (MMR, Varicella, COVID – CA mandated)
  • Reliable transportation
  • Comfort working with diverse populations
  • Willingness to complete training and documentation
  • Ability to frequently sit and stand; keeping pace with your client

Ready to Apply?

If you’ve been looking for a role where your work matters, where kids look forward to seeing you, and where your career path is clear — this is it.

Join us. Let’s light up lives together.

CSD is a proud equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

In accordance with the Fair Chance Act, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. CSD is dedicated to ensuring fair hiring practices and encourages all individuals, including those with prior criminal histories, to apply. #LI-Onsite

About Us

At Center for Social Dynamics (CSD), we believe that every child deserves a chance to shine. We're a passionate team on a mission to open up a world of possibilities for individuals with autism and other developmental needs—through science, compassion, and a whole lot of heart.

From our very first session to each milestone we celebrate, we bring the power of play, connection, and evidence-based care to every moment. With services that are as unique as the individuals we support, we meet kids where they are—at home, in schools, and in communities—and guide them on a path toward growth.

We live our TRUE values—Transparency, Respect, Understanding, and Excellence—in everything we do. As a fast-growing leader in the field, we're known for our vibrant culture, hands-on training, and career pathways that help you grow just as much as those we serve.

At CSD, we don’t just change lives—we light them up.

About Our Values

  • Transparency in the work that we do and the actions we take to achieve our mission. There are no hidden agendas or motives at Center for Social Dynamics. Each family’s unique cultures, values, and generational dynamics.

  • Understanding through tolerance, cooperation, and empathy in the pursuit of our mission. We never lose sight of who we are, the people we serve, and our purpose and meaning.

  • Respect for all and the value that everyone brings towards accomplishing our mission. No one at CSD is worth more or less, and together we are greater than the sum of our parts.

  • Excellence in our drive, passion, and commitment to our mission. CSD will always do what it takes to deliver the best, leave no one behind, and champion our cause.

CSD is a proud equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
We're hiring!

Junior Data Engineer – 3D Data Team

Are you passionate about the world of data and looking to take your first steps as a Data Engineer in an international environment? At HP SCDS we are looking for a Junior profile to join our 3D Data team, responsible for supporting the data products that power HP's 3D printing business worldwide.

What will you do?

  • Build and maintain the data pipelines required for the correct operation of the team's data products.
  • Collaborate with the rest of the team on data ingestion, transformation and validation, applying Data Engineering best practices.
  • Support the evolution and maintenance of existing data products, contributing to their quality and stability.
  • Help ensure data is accurate, consistent and readily available for analysis and decision-making across the team.

✅ What are we looking for? (Must-have requirements)

  • Knowledge of Data Engineering and the fundamentals of building/maintaining data pipelines.
  • SQL knowledge and database management skills.
  • Knowledge of databases , both relational (e.g. PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (e.g. MongoDB ).
  • Basic knowledge of Data Quality (data validation and consistency).

Nice to have

  • Software development knowledge with Python , as the team is migrating legacy software products into data products.
  • Knowledge of Data Lake platforms, such as Databricks , Snowflake or Azure Data Lake .

What do we offer?

  • Be part of a dynamic team within HP SCDS, with direct impact on HP's global 3D printing data products.
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility.
  • Continuous training and real growth opportunities as a Data Engineer.
  • The chance to grow professionally in a field with strong long-term career development, working alongside experienced engineers.

Location: León, Spain (hybrid work model)

At Plunkett's, our technicians do more than treat pests. They solve problems and help customers feel safe and comfortable. As a Service Technician, you'll manage your own route, provide pest control services, and build strong customer relationships.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________


Training Pay is $20.00 - $22.00 Per Hour + Uncapped Sales Incentives!

You set your schedule

Your own territory

title: Senior Workforce Lead
description:
Senior Workforce Lead

Remote, UK based.

Full time, permanent.

Salary: £49,000

Hybrid working

Help shape the future of the IPS workforce across England

Social Finance is an ambitious not-for-profit organisation working in partnership with governments, service providers, the voluntary sector and the financial community to tackle complex social challenges.

Through IPS Grow, Social Finance supports the expansion and development of Individual Placement and Support (IPS) services across England. The programme works across mental health, primary care, and drug and alcohol services and is funded by NHS England, the Department for Work and Pensions and the Office for Health Improvement and Disparities.

They are now recruiting two Senior Workforce Leads to play a key role in the professional development of the IPS workforce.

Working remotely as part of the Workforce team and reporting to the Learning & Development Manager, you will lead the development and delivery of training, onboarding, accredited learning and professional development programmes for IPS Employment Specialists across England.

This is an opportunity for an experienced learning and development professional with strong IPS knowledge to make a meaningful impact at a national level.

Senior Workforce Lead, the role:

• Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of the IPS Level 3 qualification

• Develop and deliver additional accredited and non-accredited learning opportunities

• Deliver comprehensive training programmes for new IPS Employment Specialists

• Support the development and delivery of face-to-face and e-learning programmes

• Provide mentoring and ongoing support to new IPS Employment Specialists during their first year

• Identify training needs and develop workshops, resources and learning interventions to address them

• Monitor learner engagement, progression and outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement

• Support onboarding activities, ensuring new hires are well prepared to deliver high-fidelity IPS services

• Work closely with the Learning & Development Manager to evaluate and improve training effectiveness

• Apply specialist IPS knowledge to ensure learning content reflects current best practice and research

• Build strong relationships with IPS services, ICB Leads, Regional NHS Leads and other national stakeholders

• Ensure training and onboarding activity meets IPS Grow's quality assurance standards

• Collect and analyse workforce and EDI data and contribute to reporting and evaluation

• Support IPS services with workforce development and race equity action planning

• Work collaboratively with Workforce Leads, Regional Leads and the wider IPS Grow team to deliver a joined-up workforce strategy

• Share best practice and contribute to national workforce development initiatives

Senior Workforce Lead, the person:

• In-depth knowledge and understanding of Individual Placement and Support (IPS) principles and practice

• Extensive experience developing and delivering training programmes, ideally within IPS or a related employment and health setting

• Experience designing and delivering face-to-face, virtual and e-learning programmes

• Understanding of adult learning principles and how to develop engaging learning experiences

• Experience supporting onboarding, mentoring and the professional development of new employees

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships and influence a wide range of audiences

• Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and projects

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to develop practical solutions

• Experience monitoring and evaluating training effectiveness and learner outcomes

• Comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment

• A commitment to inclusive and equitable workforce development

• Willingness to undertake significant travel across England to deliver training, build relationships and support IPS services

Desirable:

• Experience delivering accredited qualifications

• Experience acting as a tutor, assessor or internal quality assurer

• Experience developing IPS-specific e-learning

• Experience working with NHS, ICB or regional healthcare stakeholders

Senior Workforce Lead, the benefits:

• Remote working
• Healthcare cash plan
• Mental health support, including Mental Health Aiders
• Generous holiday allowance of 25 days with the ability to buy and sell up to 5 additional days
• 3 days closure between Christmas and New Year
• Enhanced maternity and paternity policies
• Volunteer leave
• Pension contributions of 4% matched

Please note applications close on the 18th of September.

title: Reporter
description:
Morningstar is a leading provider of independent investment research in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The Editorial team functions as an independent newsroom separate from the research departments.

The mission of the Editorial team at Morningstar is to help investors meet their financial goals, and our coverage of investing and the markets is through that lens. That means putting the day-to-day noise of the markets and investing into context while informing investors about the news, trends, and opportunities that are critical to making smart decisions.

Morningstar’s Editorial team publishes news about the financial markets and investing trends, along with digestible research content in the form of articles, data visualization, videos, and podcasts. Our articles run primarily on Morningstar.com, which millions of readers visit each month to help make sense of the markets, find investment advice, and manage their finances.

We’re looking for a recent college journalism program graduate to play an active role in our coverage and gain experience writing market and investing articles. This is an early career role designed for someone who is interested in gaining experience reporting on financial markets and investing.

This role is based in our Park Ave South office and will require four days a week in office.

As a reporter on the Editorial Markets team, you will:

  • Help us report on key financial market and economic trends and news.
  • Report on big moves in important stocks.
  • Write articles based on Morningstar’s research and data.
  • Work closely with the team’s editors to hone your craft and meet deadlines.
  • Create data-driven charts and tables that tell clear stories.
  • Train in using Morningstar’s extensive database of financial and investing information.

Qualifications:

  • Journalism experience.
  • Demonstrated interest in markets and business reporting.
  • Experience with MS Office suite, including knowledge of Excel and Word.
  • The ability and interest to pick up new systems and software.
  • Bachelors in Journalism or other related field.

This role does not qualify for immigration sponsorship. Morningstar will not be considering candidates that require immigration sponsorship now or in the future for this role.

  • Financial Health

    • Comprehensive health benefits (medical/dental/vision) including potential premium discounts and company-provided HSA contributions (up to $500-$2,000 annually) for specific plans and coverages

    • Company-provided long- and short-term disability insurance

    • Competitive 8-24 Week Paid Parental Leave

    • Adoption Assistance

    • Leadership Coaching & Formal Mentorship Opportunities

    • Annual Flex Stipend - $1000 annually to cover personal education & well-being expenses

    • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Social Health

    • Charitable Matching Gifts program

    • Dollars for Doers volunteer program

    • Paid volunteering days

    • 15+ Employee Resource & Affinity Groups

title: Frontend Engineer, Internship
description:
About Us

At Armadin, we're a group of engineers, researchers, and hackers on a mission to redefine what proactive security can do in the AI era. Cyberattacks are becoming autonomous and relentless and we believe defending against threats before they materialize is one of the most powerful ways to protect the institutions the world depends on.

We're building autonomous proactive security from the ground up, reinforcing the tradecraft of elite red teamers into purpose-built security models and agents that discover risk and remediate it before organizations are breached.

Led by Kevin Mandia, founder of Mandiant ($5.4B exit to Google), our team brings together researchers and engineers from Google, xAI, Meta, Stanford, and MIT to reinvent security for an adversary that never sleeps.

The Role

As a Frontend Engineer Intern on the Product & UX/UI team, you'll help turn complex security data and graph information into clear, navigable interfaces that make sophisticated, AI-integrated security workflows accessible to the people relying on them. You'll ship production code alongside full-time engineers from day one, paired with a mentor invested in your growth, and see your work deployed to real customers rather than left in a sandbox.

We're a small, fast-moving team, so interns get real ownership: you'll work across the stack, from polished React interfaces to the full-stack systems that power them, and you'll partner directly with founders, product, and design to understand the problems worth solving.

What You'll Do

  • Transform complex security data and graph information into clear, navigable user interfaces.

  • Collaborate with product and design to make sophisticated, AI-integrated security workflows accessible.

  • Contribute to scalable frontend and full-stack systems, balancing polish, performance, and reliability.

  • Pair with a dedicated mentor and take part in code reviews and design collaboration.

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and team rituals just like a full-time engineer.

Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Math, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation in 2027 or 2028.

  • Comfortable writing clean, well-tested code and picking up new languages and frameworks quickly.

  • Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.

  • Prior experience with Python, Go, or with LLM/agent frameworks is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data visualization or graph rendering (D3 or similar).

  • Exposure to building products that emphasize reliability and scalability.

  • Open-source contributions, hackathon projects, or independent builds that show initiative.

Technologies We Use

  • Our stack centers on React and TypeScript for the frontend, Node.js and Python for full-stack services, and D3 (or similar) for rendering complex security and graph data.

  • We care more about your ability to learn than the specific frameworks on your resume.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $75 USD/hour, paid on the same cycle as full-time employees.

  • Relocation and housing support for the Palo Alto term.

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage for the duration of the internship.

  • Daily meals in-office, plus the standard Armadin perks (yes, including the office haircuts).

  • Direct mentorship from senior engineers and regular exposure to founders and leadership.

  • A clear path to a full-time offer for interns who are a strong match.

Transportation and Housing

Relocation and housing support provided for the Palo Alto term.

Benefits & Perks

🏥 Full Health, Dental, & Vision Coverage

📈 Meaningful Equity Ownership

🥙 In-Office Meals

✂️ Haircuts at the Office
🎉 Company Sponsored Conferences & Events

💸 401(k), HSA, and FSA Plans

🌴 Flexible PTO

title: Analyst, Cyber Security Resilience
description:
• Pivotal position in advancing cyber capabilities within Insignia Financial
  • Exciting opportunity and timing to make an impact in a best-in-class cyber team
  • A role with breadth, depth, and support to push the boundaries in all things Cyber!

This is a great opportunity to have a real impact while working alongside supportive and dedicated professionals. You’ll tackle interesting challenges, develop your expertise in cyber security, and play a key role in keeping our organisation safe. Be part of a team that values your input and helps you grow in your career.

The opportunity to join our team

As a Resilience Analyst, you'll play a vital role within Insignia Financials’ Cyber Security team, focusing on detecting, responding to, and recovering from cyber security incidents. You'll be engaged in the daily triage of alerts, investigating potential threats, and providing essential insights that contribute to strengthening our security posture.

Key areas of this role include:

  • Provide internal teams with best practice guidance and policy advice based on your findings.
  • Investigate incidents, perform digital forensics, and respond to suspicious emails to mitigate risks.

What you will bring:

We are looking for an analyst with experience in cyber security operations, incident response, and threat hunting, and most importantly – have a passion for cyber security operations!

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a solid understanding of security technologies, including SIEM, XDR, EDR, firewalls, IDS/IPS, and threat intelligence platforms.
  • Demonstrate expertise in analysing complex security events and identifying root causes.
  • Excel at interpreting threat intelligence to improve detection and response capabilities.
  • Experience in managing incident responses, from initial identification to resolution.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and external SOC providers.
  • Stay updated on evolving cyber threats and industry best practices.

Job Description:

Who We Are

Adelphi Real World is a global consultancy in healthcare. We collect and interrogate real world data to aid the pharmaceutical industry in understanding the management and treatment of specific diseases. This understanding informs the successful development of pipeline assets and the positioning of inline products. Real world data can also be used to leverage Health Outcomes / Economic argumentation through statistically validated publications.

The Role

To assist with the Bespoke project team in conducting global non-interventional studies across a range of therapy areas to meet clients’ needs. You will work collaboratively with an enthusiastic and cohesive team, supporting various research projects from study design through to reporting and publication.

Accountabilities:

  • Participate actively in study design, this includes:
    • Working with clients to understand their evidence needs and assist with identifying appropriate research solutions.
    • Developing an understanding of different therapy areas through background research and literature searches
    • Identifying existing validated questionnaires and drafting new measures for data collection purposes.
    • Drafting study protocols.
  • Implementation of the research process
    • Document and study file management
    • Commissioning, briefing and management of external agencies/ partners
    • Recruiting, briefing and management of physicians and hospitals for participation in research projects.
    • Supporting applications for ethical approval of studies
    • Regular reporting of study updates and meeting minutes both internally and to the client
    • Quality checking of completed research
    • Liaison with internal teams such as programming, operations the statistical team and the health economics team.
  • Analysis and reporting of results
    • Conducting analysis in conjunction with other team members (project manager, statistical and health economic teams)
    • Supporting completion of the final research report and the presentation of the study data.
    • Supporting publication activities including abstracts, posters and manuscripts.
  • Proposal writing
    • Involvement in generating ideas in proposal meetings
    • Assisting in writing sections of the proposal

The Person:

  • A strong interest in research and willingness to develop skills required for the conduct of non-interventional/ observational studies. (Essential)
  • Educated to at least degree level in a relevant discipline. This may include science subjects, epidemiology, public health, medicine or health economics. (Essential)

  • A high level of interpersonal skills and a willingness to work collaboratively on projects as part of a wider team.

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and governance, ensuring NRL's data assets are both high-performing and trustworthy. 'Goede architectuur ontstaat niet alleen aan de ontwerptafel. Het vraagt om slimme technische keuzes, nauwe samenwerking en een sterke digitale aanpak. Als engineer architectuur speel je daarin een sleutelrol. Je vertaalt ontwerpen naar technisch haalbare en uitvoerbare oplossingen en werkt daarbij op een hoog BIM-niveau samen met architecten, modelleurs en specialisten. Juist die combinatie van inhoudelijke diepgang, innovatie en samenwerking maakt deze functie zo interessant.'

— Emiel Hengst– BUM Architectuur

Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega’s met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Onze business unit Architectuur in Nederland bestaat uit 75 collega’s, verspreid over Maastricht, Eindhoven, Utrecht. Samen werken we aan een bijzondere mix van projecten: van woningbouw en zorg tot complexe opgaven binnen de hightech maakindustrie en leisure. Daarbij werken architecten, engineers en BIM-specialisten integraal samen aan gebouwen waarin ontwerp, techniek en uitvoerbaarheid samenkomen. De digitalisering van ons vakgebied speelt hierin een steeds grotere rol. BIM vormt de basis van onze manier van werken en stelt ons in staat om projecten slimmer, efficiënter en met hogere kwaliteit te realiseren.

Als engineer architectuur geef jij de technische richting aan projecten en zorg je ervoor dat ontwerpen worden vertaald naar maakbare, uitvoerbare en toekomstbestendige oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met architecten, projectleiders, constructeurs en andere disciplines en bewaakt de technische kwaliteit gedurende het proces. Daarbij speel je een belangrijke rol binnen BIM-trajecten. We werken op een hoog BIM-volwassenheidsniveau en verwachten dat je hierin ervaring meebrengt of de ambitie hebt om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen. Voor senior engineers biedt dit de mogelijkheid om richting te geven aan projecten en collega's. Heb je die ervaring nog niet volledig, maar ben je klaar voor een volgende stap? Ook dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren. Binnen ons team is veel kennis aanwezig en krijg je begeleiding van ervaren engineers en BIM-specialisten die je ondersteunen in je verdere ontwikkeling.

Wat deze functie bijzonder maakt, is dat je terechtkomt in een team met veel inhoudelijke expertise. Je werkt samen met ervaren engineers, BIM-specialisten en architecten die hun kennis graag delen. Hierdoor krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen BIM, digitalisering en technische engineering. Of je nu een ervaren engineer bent die een voortrekkersrol wil vervullen of een professional die de volgende stap wil zetten richting een senior positie, we bieden je de ondersteuning en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om daarin te groeien. Ben jij klaar om je technische kennis in te zetten binnen complexe architectuurprojecten én jezelf verder te ontwikkelen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

[sweco-recruitee-vacancy-summary]

Dit is wat we jou bieden

Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Om te beginnen ontvang je conform CAO voor Architectenbureaus een goed salaris en 30 vakantiedagen. Daarnaast bieden we een thuiswerkvergoeding, vakantietoeslag, een circulaire thuiswerkplek en een goede pensioenregeling.

Daarnaast krijg je bij Sweco veel regie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Over hoeveel je werkt, waar je werkt, hoe je werkt en wanneer je werkt. Binnen ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket heb je de keuze om te kiezen op welke manier jij reist. We stimuleren duurzame en actieve keuzes en belonen deze extra. Ook krijg je direct toegang tot onze eigen AI-omgeving SwecoGPT, tot de Sweco Academy voor zeer ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden, en tot ons vitaliteitsprogramma gericht op leefstijl en sport.

Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan een tweedaags event voor alle nieuwe collega’s, de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, en activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en de lokale personeelsverenigingen.

Solliciteer op deze functie

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie!

Neem bij inhoudelijke vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Emiel Hengst, BUM Architectuur via emiel.hengst@sweco.nl. Vragen over het sollicitatieproces kun je stellen aan Bert aan den Toorn via +31 6 39 44 05 98 of bert.aandentoorn@sweco.nl.

**Acquisitie stellen wij niet op prijs**

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in architectuur of bouwkunde

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de bouwbranche

  • Ruime ervaring met BIM en Revit en de ambitie om hierin een inhoudelijk voortrekkersrol te vervullen of hierin verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je bent technisch sterk, denkt integraal en schakelt gemakkelijk met architecten, projectleiders en andere disciplines.

  • Je neemt initiatief, deelt graag kennis en draagt actief bij aan de ontwikkeling van collega's en projecten.

title: Dietitian
description:
The Dietitian Inpatient (Registered Dietitian) is a member of a multidisciplinary team that assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates all aspects of a patient's nutrition care. The Dietitian Inpatient is able to use validated tools to identify patients that require nutrition interventions or that have the potential for developing nutrition related problems. They provide a nutrition assessment which may include anthropometric measures and/or growth measures, pertinent biochemical data and medical test results; a nutrition focused physical exam and a food and nutrition –related history assessment. They identify specific nutrition related problem(s) and they provide specific, purposeful interventions to improve or change the nutrition and health status for their patient or client. They provide a nutrition diagnosis of malnutrition using approved, evidence based criteria. They provide nutrition education to individuals and/or caregivers. They assist in the management of the department resources. They support orientation, training and education for department and medical center staff. Performs related tasks as required.

Providence Swedish caregivers are not simply valued – they’re invaluable. Join our team at Swedish Cherry Hill and thrive in our culture of patient-focused, whole-person care built on understanding, commitment, and mutual respect. Your voice matters here, because we know that to inspire and retain the best people, we must empower them.

  • Coursework/Training: Bachelor’s Degree in Food & Nutrition or Dietetics
  • Within 6 months (180 days) of hire:
    • Washington Dietitian Certification --or--
    • Washington Nutritionist Certification
  • Upon hire: National CDR Registered Dietitian - Commission on Dietetic Registration

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree

Why Join Providence Swedish?

Our best-in-class benefits are uniquely designed to support you and your family in staying well, growing professionally, and achieving financial security. We take care of you, so you can focus on delivering our mission of improving the health and wellbeing of each patient we serve.

MRM Health is looking for a Director, Resource Management. The primary responsibility of the Director, Resource Management is to identify and manage resourcing needs (particularly across creative departments) for all potential and assigned projects. This position requires that the individual be the liaison between Project Management and team leads across Account, Creative, Technology, Strategy, UX, Medical Editing, and Regulatory Operations as it relates to resourcing across all deliverables. The Director, Resource Management also works directly with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, and third-party staffing vendors to facilitate appropriate staffing on projects across the agency based on aggregate understanding of the project requirements. The Director, Resource Management must also ensure that project resourcing is managed to ensure timely delivery and must communicate to appropriate project managers resourcing issues that may impact scheduled deadlines.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Evaluate data in resource management tools to understand workload for full-time and freelance staff across all departments; partner with Project Management to identify and solve resource challenges to ensure all projects are properly staffed to meet client deadlines

  • Ensure balanced workload across teams by managing overall utilization, resolving issues regarding under or overallocation, and understanding when to leverage freelance and/or offshore support

  • Maintain visibility into current and upcoming project and business development activities to anticipate resourcing needs and implement adjustments to align with shifting priorities

  • Run weekly resource meetings and facilitate resourcing issues/conflict resolution with Project Management and appropriate department leads

  • Manage resourcing forecast reports for all departments based on input from weekly meetings.

  • Monitor team hours against project budgets and align resourcing decisions to financial goals

  • Work with department leads to identify appropriate resource requirements for each account and project based on skillset, experience, and project requirements

  • Receive, analyze, and report on weekly utilization reports to department leads

  • Identify need for freelance talent and work with Talent Acquisition and third-party staffing vendor to staff accordingly

  • Partner with third-party staffing vendor to manage freelance onboarding and offboarding process, contract extensions, and weekly payroll processing

  • Partner with Finance, IT, and HR to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant freelance administration and budgeting

  • Build and maintain a network of internal and external talent to support flexible resourcing needs

  • Recommend process improvements for Resource Management

What We Are Looking For:

  • 8-10 years of project management or resource management experience in advertising agency; health agency a plus

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • Experience working within a workflow operational tool, such as Workfront, a must

  • Proficiency in MS office applications including Microsoft excel

  • Assertive conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills

  • Confidence in meeting with department leads to recommend resource solutions

  • Clear and concise communication in both written and verbal form

  • Good interpersonal, organizational, and presentation skills

  • Highly detail oriented and able to work autonomously

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and tight deadlines with confidence and ease

The salary range for this position is up to $115,000. title: Principal GNC Engineer
description:
At Reflect, you will be expected to move fast, have a lot of ownership and, most importantly, be able to effect change. If this excites you, we are interested in hearing about your best work and accomplishments across any domain and from any points in your life.

About the Role

As a Principal GNC Engineer you will directly shape the in-orbit performance of a novel space vehicle. Your work will span vehicle-level dynamics and control, orbit propagation, flight software and HITL testing on our avionics. We're looking for someone who brings "full-stack" GNC development capability to the table.

Responsibilities

  • Come up with creative solutions to the unique problems that come with precisely putting a spot of reflected sunlight on the ground from space.

  • Design, develop and test our closed-loop guidance, navigation and control for both attitude and orbit.

  • Plan trajectories and attitude motion profiles that satisfy our spot serving constraints.

  • Develop and own our 6-DOF simulation of vehicle attitude and orbital dynamics, and use it to characterize vehicle performance through Monte Carlo analysis.

  • Write GNC algorithms in flight software (C++/Rust) and validate them using our avionics in the loop.

  • Drive sensor and actuator selection with our avionics engineers so attitude determination and control are reliable in flight.

  • Analyze and plan orbits and constellation design to maximize our overall spot serving capability.

Ideal Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional GNC engineering experience, ideally on spacecraft or other dynamically controlled vehicles.

  • Clear technical ownership of a GNC subsystem that has flown, covering the simulation, the algorithms and the flight software.

  • Strong background in modeling physical systems from first principles, including flexible body dynamics, sensors, actuators and the space environment.

  • Expertise in state estimation design for attitude and orbit determination, validated in flight.

  • Ability to verify and validate GNC flight software in an integrated environment, using HITL testing.

  • Experience in guidance, maneuver and constellation design, including orbit selection, coverage and station-keeping.

  • Experience in real-time spacecraft operations support, from commissioning through console operations to on-orbit anomaly resolution.

  • Fluency in Python, C++ and/or Rust.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, we are likely still interested in hearing from you. Hiring exceptional individuals is our #1 priority, and we believe that exceptional people often have highly unusual backgrounds.

We are also interested in carving out unique roles for unconventional people that we are excited about working with.

Benefits

Reflect Orbital’s success will hinge on our team, which is why our compensation and benefits plan is designed to reward our employees and support their families as generously as we’re able.

  • Broad choice of medical/dental/vision coverage, Reflect covers 100% of each base-policy

  • Access to HSA, FSA, and 401K

  • Unlimited paid time off

  • Healthy lunches provided daily

Equal Opportunity

Reflect Orbital is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Reflect Orbital is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

title: Tooling Coordinator
description:
Ready to put your manufacturing experience to work?

Join our Winsted, CT team as a Tooling Coordinator and play a key role in supporting our manufacturing operations. You’ll help keep production moving by ensuring the right tooling, gages, fixtures, and setup materials are available when and where they’re needed

SUMMARY

The Tooling Coordinator supports plant operations by managing, issuing, and maintaining tooling and setup kits used throughout the manufacturing floor. This position plays an important role in ensuring manufacturing teams have the correct tooling, gages, fixtures, and setup materials available when needed.

The Tooling Coordinator also supports continuous improvement initiatives focused on setup efficiency, tooling availability, inventory accuracy, cost reduction, and improved tooling and supply practices.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Manage and maintain inventory of fixtures, diamond rolls, gages, scooters, set masters, and other tooling.
  • Perform daily shop-floor walks to identify gages and tooling that are no longer in use and return them to the crib.
  • Issue tooling and materials from the crib to the manufacturing floor as needed.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve setup tool kits to support efficient machine setups.
  • Develop and improve tooling delivery and staging processes.
  • Coordinate operation sheet and tooling documentation control.
  • Remove completed operation tool kits from manufacturing cells and return tooling to the crib.
  • Coordinate rejected diamond rolls for repair and ensure repaired tooling is properly returned and staged.
  • Re-stage and organize all tooling returned to the crib.
  • Process, inspect, and kit new tooling entering the manufacturing operation.
  • Maintain and update tooling surveillance inspection stickers.
  • Coordinate the movement and availability of inspection gages between the tooling crib and layout.
  • Support the supply crib by issuing materials and maintaining accurate inventory levels.
  • Work with outside vendors, suppliers, and internal support teams to maintain appropriate tooling inventory and resolve shortages or discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate tooling inventory records using electronic gage and tooling tracking systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve tooling availability, setup efficiency, material usage, and overall process effectiveness.
  • Actively participate in and promote continuous improvement, EHS, Quality, and 6S programs.
  • Follow all company policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

KEY CONTRIBUTION

This role helps keep manufacturing running efficiently by ensuring the right tooling and setup materials are available, organized, accurately tracked, and ready for use when needed.

Apply Today and Join Our Manufacturing Team!

EDUCATION

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Basic math skills, including working with decimals and fractions.
  • Basic reading comprehension and written communication skills.
  • Ability to plan, organize, perform tasks, and make sound decisions in a manufacturing environment.
  • Basic computer, keyboarding, and data entry skills.
  • Ability to learn and navigate electronic inventory, tooling, and tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, such as Oracle, is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain accurate inventory records and follow established processes.
  • Ability to work effectively with manufacturing, quality, maintenance, purchasing, and other internal teams.

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 3 years of manufacturing experience required.
  • Experience in a warehouse, tool crib, inventory control, or material control environment preferred.
  • Experience working with manufacturing tooling, gages, fixtures, or setup materials is a plus.

title: Director, Development & Fundraising
description:
Director, Development & Fundraising(Chicago Bulls Charities)

Position Overview:

At the Chicago Bulls, we believe our business is built on a connection to the city and our fan base, and it is important that we use our resources and influence to make a positive impact. We know the power of sports can inspire change and are dedicated to teaming up with local organizations to drive positive outcomes. The work of the Bulls Community Engagement team and Chicago Bulls Charities (CBC) aligns with our brand purpose and enhances our unique strengths and resources. The mission of Chicago Bulls Charities and Community Engagement is to unite Chicago through the lessons of basketball, the power of opportunity, and the strength of community. By extending our philanthropic efforts beyond donations, we can make greater and longer lasting impacts in our community.


The Director of Development & Fundraising for CBC will build, maintain, and expand existing philanthropic initiatives that will bolster our ability to provide resources to our community through grantmaking, programming, and special projects. Working alongside the Manager of Community Engagement & Fundraising, you will have day-to-day responsibility for the team’s fundraising, development, and grantmaking efforts to support Chicago Bulls Charities’ including annual fundraising events as well as donor stewardship. As a member of the CBC team, you will collaborate with other departments across the organization to develop and execute innovative development activations that support our impact priorities and help achieve the goals of the team, NBA, as well as nonprofit and civic partners.


Responsibilities:

Under the direction of the Executive Director of Community Engagement and Chicago Bulls Charities, you will be responsible for the following:


Fundraising Leadership

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive fundraising and development strategy, leveraging yearly events, individual and corporate donations, that will broaden the organization’s ability to raise funds to support the Bulls charitable endeavors.
  • Establish annual fundraising goals and objectives, budgets, and track performance metrics
  • Lead the annual CBC marquee fundraising event “Evening with the Chicago Bulls,” showcasing the community work of the Chicago Bulls and providing an interactive experience for CBC supporters
  • Lead the planning and execution for the annual Chicago Bulls Charities themed home game in partnership with the Game Entertainment and Marketing teams and Manager, Community Engagement & Fundraising
  • Manage relationships and activities with CBC Business Advisory Board
  • Build and manage a portfolio of individual donors, prospects, and philanthropic partners.
  • Lead donor communications, impact reporting, and relationship management activities.
  • Lead aspects of CBC in-game fundraising, including the 50/50 raffle program and player memorabilia and novelty items sales with Manager, Community Engagement & Fundraising
  • Pilot new fundraising opportunities throughout the season.
  • Partner with the Chicago Bulls Digital Marketing and Product teams and with external service providers to ensure that online fundraising and digital processes are working properly to optimize fundraising capabilities.


Grantmaking and Special Projects

  • Serve as the organization’s primary contact for the McCormick Foundation and all grant recipients for the annual CBC grant process.
  • Coordinate with CBC board to select, review and approve grantees.
  • Support the Executive Director with the annual CBC board meeting.
  • Research and evaluate new nonprofit organizations to be considered for support.
  • Support the Executive Director with managing NBA Foundation grantmaking in the Chicago market.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Provide support with the following:
  • Storytelling and promoting CBC work within the league, community and the organization.
  • Various Chicago Bulls community outreach initiatives.
  • Community Engagement and CBC game day activations.
  • Community Engagement and CBC department administrative activities
  • Represent team at events and in external and internal meetings.
  • Support any related hospitality events as needed.
  • Manage 1-2 full-time staff who will oversee the 25+ seasonal part-time staff who implement game-day fundraising activities.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and / or 7+ years of progressive fundraising, development, sponsorship, or nonprofit leadership experience.
  • Experience leading full-time staff, including assigning projects, providing ongoing coaching, and conducting performance evaluations.
  • Experience within professional sports, collegiate athletics, sports foundations, or community development organizations.
  • Experience managing fundraising events and donor engagement programs.
  • Experience with donor management and CRM systems.
  • Ability to develop positive relationships internally, operate in a manner that reflects the Bulls’ collaborative-based culture and ability to thrive within a rapidly changing environment.
  • Demonstrated success of securing major gifts, sponsorships, and philanthropic partnerships.
  • Strong knowledge of trends and standard methodologies in the nonprofit sector, Corporate Social Responsibility, Social Impact and Cause Marketing.
  • Experience developing and implementing processes to track and measure philanthropic impact.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Chicago area and the region’s corporations and nonprofit community.
  • Ability to communicate articulately and confidently both verbally and in writing with individuals at every level of the organization.
  • Ability to anticipate obstacles and build solutions in a timely manner.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to prioritize.
  • Ability to lead meetings and handle multiple priorities.
  • Great teammate with positive energy

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
If you enjoy working alongside positive people, in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing is part of the culture and everyone is happy to help each other grow, keep reading, we're pretty sure you'll love idealista.

The challenge

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to rebuild the data layer of one of idealista's core verticals from the ground up. This isn't maintenance work: it means redesigning data models, analytics, domain objects, and integrations on a modern architecture. You'll work within an established team, with real technical ownership over data decisions.

About the team

You'll join the Seeker segment, a group of multidisciplinary teams working together to shape one of idealista's most strategic products. Your day-to-day will involve close collaboration with engineers, product managers, and other specialists across multiple teams, contributing to shared technical decisions and driving initiatives that go beyond the scope of a single squad. Together, you'll help build the next generation of our platform, with the scale, ambition, and impact of one of Europe's leading proptech companies.

What you'll do

  • Redesign the vertical's data model: entities, relationships, events, and metrics. Think in terms of domain, not just tables.
  • Design and implement ingestion, transformation, and serving pipelines using dbt and columnar/OLAP databases.
  • Define and enforce data governance practices: ownership, lineage, asset cataloging, naming standards, and quality policies (freshness, completeness, accuracy).
  • Integrate heterogeneous sources (APIs, relational databases, events) by designing clear data contracts between teams.
  • Collaborate with product and backend teams to understand what data they need and why, and translate that into robust models and pipelines.
  • Document from day one: modeling decisions, contracts, standards.

What you need

  • Advanced SQL : CTEs, window functions, query optimization over large volumes. This is your primary tool.
  • Experience with transformation frameworks like dbt or equivalent.
  • Data modeling : dimensional, Data Vault, or both. You can articulate when to use which approach.
  • Familiarity with modern data architectures : lakehouse, medallion, ELT. You understand the "why", not just the "how".
  • Python or JVM (Java/Kotlin) for pipeline or data service development.
  • Git and comfort with the command line.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles.
  • Experience working alongside product/backend teams , not only within data silos.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other columnar/OLAP databases.
  • Familiarity with Oracle as an operational database.
  • Experience with object storage (S3 or equivalent).
  • Hands-on use of metadata catalog tools such as DataHub or similar.
  • Experience with data observability tools and practices.
  • Event-driven architectures (Kafka or equivalent).
  • Domain knowledge in marketplaces or real estate.

Skills we value

  • You know how to do technical discovery with business and product stakeholders: understanding what they need and why, not just taking requirements at face value.
  • You communicate modeling decisions to non-technical audiences without losing rigor.
  • You spot repetitive tasks and automate them.
  • You have a documentation mindset: if it's not written down, it doesn't exist.

What we offer

  • This is a fully remote position, but if you enjoy working from the office, you'll always be welcome at our headquarters in the heart of Madrid or at one of our collaborative workspaces.
  • You'll keep learning—we mean it. Our platform is constantly evolving, generating plenty of opportunities for internal tech talks, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • We'll support your professional growth with the training you need to continue developing your skills.
  • We're active members of the tech community: we sponsor events, attend conferences, and regularly host meetups in our offices. We believe learning is important, but sharing knowledge with others is just as valuable.
  • In addition to your salary, you'll have access to a flexible compensation plan from day one, including benefits such as public transport, meal vouchers, and private health insurance.
  • Free language classes in English, Italian, and Portuguese.
  • Your wellbeing matters to us. That's why we offer a comprehensive wellness package, including physiotherapy, yoga, and psychotherapy sessions.
  • We also know that work is about more than just delivering great products. Throughout the year, we celebrate together with themed events, seasonal parties, and plenty of opportunities to connect with your colleagues.
  • Regular team-building activities—and much more!

And something more about us…

Since we began this adventure in the year 2000, idealista has been much more than a company.

It is a culture, a way of doing and understanding things that sets us apart. Respect, tolerance, integrity, and transparency are part of our DNA.

We have a team of people representing more than 20 different nationalities, with diverse languages, profiles, cultures, and backgrounds. We value differences and learning from others; different beliefs and ways of thinking enrich us.

idealista promotes equality in all areas, carrying out awareness and visibility actions for the LGTB+ community among employees, in advertising, and in the community in general.

We are committed to creating environments and spaces where people feel safe, protected, free from discrimination, and where equal opportunities are a priority.

Likewise, gender equality is another foundation of our commitment to our team. We are dedicated to developing measures that promote equality and support work–life balance, maternity, and paternity.

Do you see yourself in this? Take the challenge! :)

We’re waiting for you.

title: Technical Program Manager, Inventory Control
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) continues to expand its global data center footprint, delivering some of the industry’s largest and most complex builds. The Data Center Inventory Control Management (DCICM) team ensures that inventory is tracked, deployed, and governed with the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and efficiency.

We are seeking an IC4 Technical Program Manager to oversee Global build projects, reporting directly into the Global DCICM leadership team. This role will focus on build material deployment, inventory governance, and third-party logistics (3PL) oversight, ensuring our largest data center programs maintain operational readiness and audit compliance.

This position carries a high level of accountability and autonomy. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to manage material lifecycle execution, drive accuracy and efficiency across builds, and partner effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Inventory Tracking & Deployment: Own execution of material deployment activities across assigned builds, ensuring inventory accuracy, timely delivery, and governance against DCICM standards.
  • 3PL Management: Oversee third-party logistics operations, ensuring compliance with Oracle’s chain of custody requirements, service level agreements (SLAs), and quality standards.
  • Build Support: Partner with construction, engineering, and operations teams to align material flow and inventory readiness with aggressive build schedules.

  • Schedule Coordination & Readiness: Partner with construction, engineering, logistics, operations, and regional inventory teams to maintain an integrated material readiness schedule. Track critical milestones, dependencies, lead times, and constraints; communicate status and escalate schedule risks or required recovery actions to keep material deployment aligned with build commitments.

  • System Accuracy & Compliance: Ensure all inventory transactions, movements, and deployments are captured accurately within Oracle systems; maintain audit-ready records.
  • Risk Management: Anticipate material and logistics risks, proactively developing mitigation strategies to protect build timelines and operational continuity.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary inventory control contact for regional builds, providing regular updates to global DCICM leadership, project teams, and external partners.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive opportunities for process automation, efficiency gains, and standardization in material management practices.
  • Governance: Enforce global inventory policies while tailoring practices to regional build realities; ensure compliance with security, safety, and operational standards.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Program/Project Management: Proven ability to manage large-scale, cross-functional programs with measurable outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Inventory Management Expertise: Strong understanding of material flow, inventory accuracy, reconciliation, and audit requirements.
  • 3PL / Vendor Oversight: Demonstrated experience managing third-party logistics providers and ensuring SLA/governance adherence.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret inventory data, highlight trends, and drive improvements across material deployment and accuracy.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Skilled at identifying risks early, building mitigation plans, and maintaining project alignment.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven success in engaging executive leadership, global peers, and vendor partners.
  • Technical Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with ERP, WMS, and inventory management tools; Oracle Fusion or similar experience a plus.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working across regions, time zones, and with multiple concurrent builds under tight deadlines.

Experience: 10+ years of experience in Program Management, Planning & Scheduling, Inventory Control, Logistics, or Warehouse Management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data center or large-scale infrastructure builds.
  • Strong knowledge of material governance, chain of custody, and audit compliance requirements.
  • Lean Six Sigma or other process improvement certification a plus.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business administration, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

  • Certification in inventory or supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CPIM, or CSCP) is preferred but not required.

title: Senior Scientist – Hectorite Materials
description:
About Us

Elementis is a global specialty chemical company, with 1,300 employees operating 17 manufacturing sites across the globe. At Elementis, we bring a distinctive combination of expertise, innovation, and teamwork to every formulation challenge. We create high-value specialty additives that enhance the performance of our customers' products and make a positive change in the world. Combining our leading positions in the science of materials flow, surface modification, and formulation with access to unique natural materials, Elementis delivers unique chemistry, sustainable solutions to customers in a wide range of markets, including cosmetics, anti-perspirants, decorative and industrial coatings, automotive and ceramics.

Job Description Summary

The Senior Scientist, Hectorite Materials, leads the development of next-generation Hectorite products and related clay-based technologies. This role applies advanced expertise in organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, and materials science to drive innovation, solve complex technical challenges, and support strategic business objectives.
In addition to leading research programs and providing technical guidance, the Hectorite focused Senior Scientist plays a critical role in identifying and evaluating new market opportunities, emerging technologies, customer needs, and application spaces. By integrating market insights with scientific expertise, the role helps shape the Hectorite research pipeline, prioritize technology investments, and accelerate the development of commercially relevant Hectorite products. The position balances laboratory work with project leadership, opportunity assessment, and cross-functional collaboration across R&D, marketing, business development, manufacturing, and commercial teams.

Job Description

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Opportunity & Portfolio Development for new Hectorite Products

  • Identify emerging technologies, market trends, customer needs, and review competitive developments to uncover new growth opportunities for Hectorite.
  • Evaluate the technical feasibility, business potential, and strategic fit of new Hectorite growth opportunities / concepts and recommend research programs, technology platforms, and innovation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with commercial, marketing, and business development teams to define value propositions and support Hectorite innovation portfolio decisions.
  • Contribute technical expertise to long-term technology roadmaps and business growth strategies.

2. Research, Innovation & Technology Development

  • Lead and execute research and development activities focused on Hectorite materials and related clay technologies, from concept generation through laboratory validation and scale-up.
  • Develop innovative Hectorite based material solutions through synthesis, modification, and characterization, applying expertise in chemistry and materials science.
  • Establish structure-property-performance relationships to create differentiated technologies and improve product performance.
  • Solve complex technical challenges and identify scientific approaches that advance the organization's technology portfolio.
  • Generate and protect intellectual property through inventions, patents, technical publications, and knowledge creation.

3. Project Leadership & Business Execution

  • Lead multiple research projects, establishing objectives, experimental plans, resource requirements, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Drive projects through defined development milestones while balancing technical risks, customer requirements, and business objectives.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure effective execution and successful transition of technologies into product development and commercialization.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership to support decision-making.
  • Represent the organization in technical interactions with customers, suppliers, academic institutions, and external partners.

Additional Job Description

Technical Knowledge and Skills
1. Strong knowledge of organic chemistry, inorganic chemistry, materials science, colloidal systems, and structure-property-performance relationships.
2. Demonstrated experience in the synthesis, modification, characterization, and application development of Hectorite, clay minerals, specialty additives, or related material systems.
3. Proficiency in the use and interpretation of advanced material characterization techniques, including XRD, SEM, TEM, rheology, particle size analysis, thermal analysis, spectroscopy, and surface characterization methods.
4. Strong experimental design, data analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from complex technical data.
5. Experience developing innovative materials and translating laboratory findings into commercially relevant products and technologies.
6. Knowledge of product development processes, scale-up activities, technology transfer, and commercialization pathways.
7. Understanding of intellectual property processes, including invention disclosures, patent applications, and technology protection strategies.
8. Ability to evaluate emerging technologies, market trends, customer needs, and application opportunities to support innovation and business growth.
9. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within established timelines.
10. Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
11. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams involving R&D, Marketing, Business Development, Manufacturing, Operations, and Commercial organizations.
12. Strong attention to detail, scientific rigor, and commitment to laboratory safety, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
13. Self-motivated, results-oriented individual with the ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and thrive in a dynamic research environment.

Position Requirements
1. Ph.D. in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, or a related scientific discipline preferred.
2. M.S. degree with significant relevant industrial research experience may be considered.
3. Typically 5-10+ years of industrial R&D experience in advanced materials, specialty chemicals, minerals, or related technologies.
4. Demonstrated success in developing new materials, products, or technology platforms from concept through commercialization.
5. Record of innovation demonstrated through patents, publications, technical presentations, or successful product introductions.
6. Experience with Hectorite materials, synthetic clays, rheology modifiers, specialty minerals, coatings, personal care, agricultural, or related application areas is highly desirable.

title: Spray Technician
description:
Salary Range:

$30,743.44 - $59,344.48

DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS OF WORK
This is skilled work in the operation of equipment used in a municipal pest control program. Work in this class involves responsibility for continuous safe and efficient operation of automotive, marine, and spraying machinery/equipment in the application of pesticides and herbicides in accordance with all regulatory
stipulations. The variety of pest targets includes insects, rodents, aquatic weeds, turf weeds, fungus, and plant pests. Chemical preparations are mixed, stored, used, and disposed of in accordance with state and federal guidelines. Work is generally performed independently in the field and the employee is required to follow all instructions with the greatest concern for safety. Work is reviewed by the effectiveness of the applications and completed work orders.


ESSENTIAL EXAMPLES OF DUTIES
The following illustrates examples of some of the essential duties and responsibilities of the Spray Technician. There may be other essential functions, not listed below, in order to accomplish the tasks as presented by the Supervisor.


• Identifies pests, weeds, and plant material diseases that need to be controlled by the chemical application.
• Prepares chemicals for application, which includes mixing and storing.
• Sprays chemical solutions or dust powders in work areas.
• Operates all related pesticide spray machinery and equipment.
• Walks two to three miles along rights-of-way while applying herbicides.
• Set traps and places poisonous bait in rodent infested areas.
• Loads and unloads cases of chemicals in 2 to 2½ gallon containers and materials from trucks and storage areas.
• Checks condition of assigned truck, small gasoline engines, and spraying equipment and makes minor repairs.
• Installs or removes various types of mechanical equipment on vehicles according to assigned task.
• Attends seminars and classes relative to pest control in order to keep necessary licenses up-to-date.
• Completes daily assignment work sheets.
• Performs related work as required.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES
• Knowledge of the methods, techniques, and objectives of pest control technology which includes right-of-way, turf and ornamental, and insect control.
• Knowledge of the proper mixing and preparation of chemicals used in pest control programs according to labels and the law.
• Ability to identify weeds and plant material diseases that need to be eradicated.
• Ability to work with and handle toxic chemicals.
• Ability to lift cases of chemicals weighing 40-50 pounds.
• Ability to operate automotive, marine and machine equipment safely and efficiently during pesticide and herbicide applications.
• Ability to detect equipment operating defects and either make minor repairs or initiate proper repair procedures.
• Ability to follow all written or oral instructions.
• Ability to develop and maintain effective and positive working relationships with other employees and the general public.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• High school diploma or equivalent;
• Have at least one year of experience in the pest control field, which includes operating mechanical pesticide/herbicide application equipment, or a minimum of two years in turf or landscape maintenance;

• Ability to perform heavy, outdoor manual work in heat, rain and around chemicals and the ability to lift at least 50lbs. and walk and stand for long periods;
• Must possess valid Ornamental & Turf, Aquatic Weed, and Right-of-Way applicator licenses/certifications and maintain such certifications current, as required by the State of Florida or possess the ability to pass those exams within 3 months of hire at own expense;

• Must qualify for a Florida "registered technician" card under Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services; and
• Must possess a valid Florida driver license, and an acceptable driving record.

title: Lead Software Engineer- Uplink Systems
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Responsibilities:

The Ground Communications and Architecture Section provides engineering development, implementation, and maintenance of state-of-the-art and high-reliability technologies for NASA’s Deep Space Network (DSN).

We’re seeking a Software Engineer (Uplinks Systems) to develop and maintain the software systems that control the DSN Uplink Tracking and Command Subsystem. This subsystem performs the critically important functions of signal generation, transmission, and transmitter control to send spacecraft command data as well as the tracking functions to implement spacecraft ranging. This role focuses on real-time signal processing software that interfaces with Software Defined Radios (SDRs) and FPGA-based hardware to generate modulated RF uplink signals supporting all NASA deep-space missions.

You will be a member of the Control Systems and Electronics Group and work closely with teammates across the section supporting all phases of the lifecycle from inception through the end of maturity.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Design, implement, test, and ship iterations of the uplink software package.

  • Lead and mentor a small team of software and test engineers, providing technical guidance and managing dependencies.

  • Own the software side of the interface to FPGA and mixed-signal hardware, defining and negotiating that boundary with the project team.

  • Develop and maintain the signal processing capability of Uplink (error correction, modulation, signal generation), interfacing with software-defined radio (SDR) systems.

  • Architect and maintain high-rate data paths between hardware and software, accountable for data integrity and timing across the path.

  • Define the verification strategy for the subsystem and build the automated test capability that supports it.

  • Maintain the software release schedule, balancing critical mission milestones with the capability and resources of the team.

  • Make technical architecture decisions and defend them to stakeholders and leadership.

  • Present updates of the project to program leadership in review meetings (PDR, CDR, etc.) showing the project meets the expected capability and minimizes risk.

  • Work cross-collaboratively with stakeholders of the internal interfaces to the subsystem and the external users of the subsystem.

  • Perform hands-on work testing and evaluating the software deployments in the lab and in the field ensuring requirements are satisfied.

  • Work closely with OEs and engineers at the three DSN complexes worldwide (USA, Spain, and Australia).

  • Travel occasionally (<= 5% of your time) to the DSN complexes to support installation, checkout, or debugging of deployments.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with typically a minimum of 9 years of related work experience; or Master's degree in similar discipline with a minimum 7 years of related work experience;
    or a PhD in a similar discipline with a minimum of 5 years of related work experience.

  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring software engineering teams, or demonstrated technical leadership on complex projects.

  • Strong C++ and working proficiency in Python.

  • Experience developing software that interfaces directly with hardware. (FPGA-based systems, data acquisition, embedded platforms, or instrumentation)

  • Experience architecting high-rate data transport between hardware and software over PCIe, Ethernet, or comparable interfaces.

  • Experience with software that must meet timing, throughput, or data-integrity requirements.

  • Experience implementing signal processing algorithms in production software (digital modulation schemes, FIR/IIR filtering, forward error correction)

  • Experience working within a structured engineering process, including design reviews and requirements-based verification.

  • Experience testing and debugging software against real hardware in a lab or operational field environment.

Preferred Skills:

Strong candidates will have depth in several of the following areas:

  • Advanced experience or strong knowledge of signal processing systems.

  • Experience in software development that interfaces with SDRs using various radio interfaces (Ethernet or PCI-E).

  • Experience with SDR frameworks and drivers, such as USRP Hardware Driver (UHD) and RF Network-on-Chip (RFNoC).

  • Implementing protocols from formal specifications and authoring interface definitions between subsystems.

  • Direct experience with the implementation of communication data and telemetry systems.

  • Experience with or knowledge of Consultative Committee for Space Data Systems (CCSDS) Space Link Extension (SLE).

  • Experience with continuous integration (e.g., Jenkins or GitHub Actions) and modern source configuration control (e.g. git).

  • Experience with software testing frameworks and test-driven development practices.

  • Knowledge of container and runtime orchestration frameworks (Podman, Docker, or Kubernetes).

  • Experience with project planning, resource estimation, and budget tracking for software development efforts.

  • Owning release, deployment, and support of software for fielded systems.

  • Leading root-cause investigations that span software, firmware, and hardware.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Direct deep space, DSN, or spacecraft communications experience is not required. We welcome strong candidates from avionics, radar, test and measurement, telemetry, instrumentation, industrial control, and comparable hardware-adjacent software domains.

Castleview Hospital is a 39-bed acute care hospital that offers exceptional care to Carbon and Emery counties in the high desert of Eastern Utah.
