title: Huishoudelijke hulp Druten
description:
Word jij het zonnetje in huis? Kom werken als Huishoudelijke Hulp!

Werkgebied: Druten
Contract: 2-24 uur per week, flexibele werktijden

Bij Miep Huishoudservice en Begeleiding draait alles om het creëren van een écht thuisgevoel – niet alleen voor onze cliënten, maar ook voor jou als medewerker. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je je gewaardeerd voelt, je werk met plezier doet en altijd de steun krijgt die je nodig hebt. Flexibiliteit, persoonlijke aandacht en een fijne werksfeer staan bij ons centraal!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Huishoudelijke Hulp bij Miep Huishoudservice zorg je ervoor dat onze cliënten zich thuis blijven voelen in hun eigen woning, ook als zij zelf niet meer volledig voor het huishouden kunnen zorgen. Jouw taken bestaan uit:

  • Schoonmaken, stofzuigen en andere huishoudelijke werkzaamheden.

  • Cliënten zoveel mogelijk betrekken bij het huishouden.

  • Persoonlijke aandacht en een luisterend oor bieden.

Jij maakt elke dag het verschil! Dankzij jouw hulp blijft het huis van onze cliënten schoon en fijn, waardoor zij langer zelfstandig kunnen blijven wonen. Een sociaal en dankbaar beroep waarin jij elke dag iets moois betekent voor een ander!

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij ons bepaal jij je eigen werktijden en -dagen! Extra werken in de vakantie? Geen probleem! Je krijgt een salaris volgens de cao VVT, vanaf € 15,07 bruto per uur afhankelijk van ervaring, met jaarlijkse verhogingen tot € 18,27. Daarnaast ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%), die je ook maandelijks kunt laten uitbetalen. Ook bouw je pensioen op en kun je gebruikmaken van een collectieve zorgverzekering. Reiskosten (zoals auto, fiets, brommer of scooter) en reistijd tussen cliënten worden vergoed.

We investeren in jouw groei met een digitaal onboardingsprogramma via de MiepApp vol e-learnings. Wil je alvast een kijkje nemen? Klik dan hier. Je krijgt een contract voor bepaalde tijd met de intentie tot een vaste aanstelling. Twee keer per jaar organiseren we een medewerkersbijeenkomst om je collega’s beter te leren kennen. Miep is een warme, betrokken werkgever die naar je luistert. Jouw werk is niet alleen belangrijk, maar maakt ook écht een verschil voor onze cliënten!

Wie ben jij?

  • Jij bent het zonnetje in huis, zorgzaam en hebt een groot inlevingsvermogen.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je taken.

  • Je spreekt en begrijpt Nederlands.

  • Je bent minimaal 2 uur per week beschikbaar tussen 9:00 en 18:00 uur (ma-vr).

  • Ervaring is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme en een passie voor schoonmaken zijn minstens zo belangrijk!

  • Je hebt eigen vervoer (auto, scooter of fiets) om naar cliënten te reizen.

Enthousiast geworden?

Wil jij het verschil maken en onze cliënten laten stralen? Solliciteer vandaag nog!
Stuur je CV en motivatie naar ons op en wie weet verwelkomen wij jou binnenkort als onze nieuwe collega. Na je sollicitatie laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten hoe het verder gaat. Bij indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan.

title: Principal Data Center Commissioning Engineer
description:
In response to increased concurrent projects for the delivery of our data centers, Oracle is recruiting a Principal Commissioning Engineer. The role is a senior multi-disciplinary data center commissioning engineer with a focus all levels of commissioning activities up to IST, and responsible for the direct interface between Oracle and our data center partners in the completion and testing of building systems to bring a data center reliably to ready for service and eventually turn over to operations. With extensive experience reviewing design and delivering mission critical facilities, professional qualifications in mechanical, control or electrical engineering with a commissioning focus. The role is responsible for setting Oracle’s stance for commissioning activities and working with our delivery, construction and collocation partners to ensure successful IST and turnover to operations

Responsibilities:

  1. Oversight of the commissioning of multiple lease provider projects. Providing guidance and engineering leadership to ensure project quality, commissioning and engineering initiatives are meeting or exceeding company expectations.
  2. Expert operating knowledge of engineering systems to include advanced diagnostics and repairs. Ability to apply knowledge of Oracle processes, procedures and industry standards to resolve issues.
  3. Utilizes safe working practices at an EXPERT level (e.g. can apply procedure for lockout/tag out, can explain MDS, etc.). Evaluates and assures the safe working practices of others.

Acquires knowledge by expanding experience with systems, vendor training, participation in industry groups or meetings and shadowing others. Is SME with many systems and trains others inside and outside of the group.
  6. Provides expert input for effective contract administration including generation and review of contracts, change orders, cost forecasts, and other pertinent documents and documentation.
  7. Expert level of communications; Including cross functional SOP development and relevant technical writing. Interactions are primarily to collaborate between departments within the organization.
  8. Lead the interaction for Oracle with datacenter partners for successful commissioning of all electrical, control and mechanical systems, including but not limited to primary and back up electrical plant, mechanical plant, life safety and fire suppression systems, building monitoring and controls systems.
  9. Review of all commissioning testing procedures used to verify data center equipment, subsystems and systems work as intended as per the basis of design, sequence of operations and owners project requirements.
  10. Contribute to the design specifications of Oracle to ensure the contracting of reliable, resilient, and efficient data centers.
  11. Travel can be up to two weeks a month and candidate must live in or be willing to move to Thailand.

description:
Job Description Summary

Job Description

Senior People Analyst

12-Month Fixed Term Contract

Location: Edinburgh (We believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and our hybrid model requires colleagues to be in the office a minimum of 40% of their time)

Salary: A competitive salary from £43,120 – £64,680 depending on the experience you can bring

Closing date: 6th September 2026

As a purpose-led business, we're focused on supporting our customers as they navigate through new stages of their lives and all the moments that matter. We're here for everyone who wants to make the most of their time on the planet and leave it a little better than they found it, however grand or humble their ambitions.

We help people live their best lives. We help them with the big stuff, for the moments that matter: Pensions, Savings, Investments. At Aegon, we strive in creating a diverse organisation that plays a meaningful role in driving greater equity, inclusion and belonging.

The People function puts our people at the heart of everything we do. Working closely with leaders across the business, we help shape a culture where colleagues can thrive, develop and deliver great outcomes for our customers. As part of this, our People Analytics team plays a critical role in transforming people data into meaningful insight that drives better decision-making and organisational effectiveness.

We're looking for a Senior People Analyst to join our team and lead the delivery of high-quality people MI, reporting and analytics.

This is a highly visible role where you'll combine technical expertise, commercial awareness and stakeholder engagement skills to provide actionable insights that influence business and people strategies. Working with colleagues across the UK business, you'll drive innovation in reporting, automation and advanced analytics while championing a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering impactful people MI, reporting and analytics that support informed business and people decisions.

  • Identifying trends, risks and opportunities within workforce data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Developing and enhancing dashboards, reports and visualisations using tools such as Tableau and Power BI.

  • Driving automation and continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency, accuracy and scalability.

  • Applying advanced analytics and statistical techniques to generate deeper workforce insights.

  • Acting as a trusted subject matter expert for people data, reporting and analytics across the business.

  • Building strong relationships with stakeholders, understanding business challenges and using data to help shape solutions.

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Significant experience in analytics, MI, reporting or data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience interpreting large and complex datasets.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience using data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

  • Experience working Python or similar data transformation tools.

  • Experience partnering with and influencing stakeholders at all levels.

  • The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and confidently to non-technical audiences.

  • Experience working with HR or people data, with Workday knowledge being an advantage.

  • Knowledge of statistical modelling and the ability to turn complex outputs into meaningful business insights.

What’s in it for you?

  • We’re serious about your future and our enhanced pension scheme is now in place. We ask you to contribute 3% of your salary to your pension and we’ll put in 9%. If you decide to contribute more, we’ll match it up to a combined total of 20% of your salary (that’s 7% from you and 13% from us).

  • A discretionary bonus, depending on personal and company performance

  • 36 days leave per year (including bank holidays, pro-rated for part-time)

We also offer private medical cover, life assurance, critical illness cover, enhanced parental leave and a variety of lifestyle benefits to help our employees live their best lives, including retail discount vouchers, cycle2work scheme, subsidised restaurant and online GP appointments. To find out more about what to expect at Aegon, visit our careers site.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how people data informs strategic decision-making across the business. You'll work with a wide range of stakeholders, influence meaningful change, drive innovation in analytics and have the chance to make a tangible impact on both colleague and business outcomes while continuing to develop your own expertise in a supportive and forward-thinking team.

The legal bits

We’ll need you to confirm you have the right to work in the UK. If we offer you a job and you accept, there are some checks we need to complete before you can start with us. This will include a credit and criminal record check, as well as providing satisfactory references.

The Universal Banker (UB) acts as a full service, single point of contact for Apple Bank clientele by providing prompt, courteous, and efficient service to new and existing customers through the processing of monetary and account related transactions. The UB position is a hybrid role that requires the incumbent to operate in the dual capacity of Customer Service Representative and Teller, providing branch leadership with the ability to deliver quality customer service at an enhanced level. The Universal Banker also provides sales and service support to the branch by acquiring new clients, offering suitable Bank products/services (that add value to the customer), performing branch/platform related functions and processing account maintenance transactions.

The successful candidate will open new accounts, resolve issues, and educate our customers on Bank products/services and may refer them to a licensed representative of ABS Associates of NY, Inc. when appropriate. The UB seeks to build mutually beneficial and long-term relationships based on trust and the offering of suitable solutions that meet the client’s needs, exceeding expectations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide exceptional customer service by engaging clients in a friendly and professional manner and also resolving service-related issues timely and efficiently.
  • Conduct business ethically, thoroughly communicating to current and prospective clients the facts/features of the various products, accounts, and services that Apple Bank has to offer.
  • Recognize opportunities to acquire new or additional banking relationships by engaging in discussions with both customers, as well as prospects, to understand their needs and offer suitable products and services that add value; make appropriate referrals to licensed representatives of ABS Associates of NY, Inc.
  • Establish, retain, and deepen relationships with existing and potential customers to achieve team sales and referral goals while providing quality customer service.
  • Handle all aspects of Teller operations by processing transactions in accordance with established policies and procedures; prove daily transactions within a reasonable timeframe and safeguard assigned cash and negotiable instruments.
  • Assist in the opening and closing of vault, safe, and ATM machine and ensure the customer area is kept orderly and properly supplied (deposit and withdrawal tickets, ATM envelopes, changing the rate boards, dates on writing desks, etc.).
  • Communicate all disclosures, rules, and regulations covering transactions, as well as FDIC protection to customers upon the opening of new accounts.
  • Ensure accurate new account record keeping practices and perform timely follow-up as needed.
  • Adhere to regulatory, compliance, security, and audit policies/procedures, as well as our code of conduct and operational controls to ensure the safety and security of the client, as well as Bank assets.
  • Protect Bank against loss by ensuring that all new account procedures including CIP and BSA requirements are adhered to.
  • Assist in training and mentoring of newly hired Tellers, Customer Service Representatives, and Universal Bankers.
  • Build and maintain technical and professional knowledge by attending educational workshops.
  • Perform additional duties as requested.

SKILLS, EDUCATION, & EXPERIENCE

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Must have at least 1-2 years retail banking experience in the combined experience of Teller/ Customer Service Representative.
  • General understanding of banking operations (Risk, Compliance, Fraud, Loss, etc.) preferred.
  • Prior experience in fostering and developing strong customer relationships.
  • Ability to develop, as well as maintain a detailed level of knowledge of banking products and services.
  • Display willingness to be cross trained in other branch functions.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to provide solutions to customer issues.
  • Must present a confident, professional, and positive demeanor to customers.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication (verbal + written) skills; must have excellent phone skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and detailed oriented.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office suite of products (Word, Excel, & PowerPoint).
  • Display sound judgment and discretion when utilizing confidential information.
  • Weekend work and extended hours or filling in at neighboring branch locations may be required.
  • Mandatory training may require occasional travel.

Visa sponsorship not available.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow-MSH-32910-034
description:
The Windreich Department of Artificial Intelligence and Human Health and the Mount Sinai Fuster Heart Hospital at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai are inviting applications for a Postdoctoral Data Science Research Fellowship position in Artificial Intelligence (AI) based in New York City.

This role focuses on applications to novel devices, cardiac waveform processing, electronic health records (EHR) data, and clinical care.

Key topics of interest include, but are not limited to:
- Deep learning applications to novel waveform acquisition devices
- Multimodal data (structured, unstructured, images, waveforms)
- Deep learning based clustering and predictive modeling for disease diagnosis and risk stratification
- Graph neural networks
- Personalized therapeutic recommendations
- Development of AI based clinical decision support systems

We have a specific interest in applications for cardiovascular disease and applications to novel device technologies.

The postdoctoral fellow will join a dynamic team of data scientists, engineers, and clinicians. They will participate in unique opportunities to apply deep learning for important scientific breakthroughs that are scalable, clinically meaningful, and operationally pragmatic.

The ideal candidates will have the following background:
1. PhD, MD/PhD in a quantitative science-related field (e.g., biomedical informatics, clinical informatics, machine learning, biostatistics, etc.).
2. Significant experience in machine learning techniques is preferred, ideally with published work and/or code available. Expertise with CNNs, Transformers, ECG embeddings, GNNs, and Deep Learning frameworks is preferred (e.g. d3rlpy, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Keras).
3. Expertise with programming and statistical software experience with advanced Python proficiency.
4. A strong statistics, data science, and/or engineering background is advantageous.
5. The ideal candidate will have a track record of academic publication and likes to be creative.
6. Strong communication and presentation skills with fluency in spoken and written English.

To apply, please submit a CV and a brief cover letter to joshua.lampert@mountsinai.org

Information on the Postdoctoral Training Program at Mount Sinai: .

To learn more about the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai: .

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $74,692.00 - $80,000.00 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

description:

  • Knowledge of security technologies including TPM, Secure Boot, kernel signing, and encryption frameworks.

  • Familiarity with Python and Bash scripting for development and automation tasks.

Responsibilities

title: Senior Vice President - Loan Operations
description:
About Citco:

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About the Team & Business Line:

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a core member of our Loan operation team, you will be working with some of the industry’s most accomplished professionals to deliver award-winning services for the world’s largest alterative credit lenders. Citco’s total loan portfolio exceeds 100B, across a variety of asset and loan types including publicly traded bank debt, private syndications, middle market transactions, and commercial real estate. We provide shadow and direct loan agency.

About the Role:
The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Loan Operations is a strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the global delivery, risk management, and performance of loan processing functions. The SVP will lead a high-performing team across multiple regions, ensure operational excellence, drive client satisfaction, and implement scalable solutions that support business growth and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead and manage global loan operations teams responsible for trade capture, funding, position management, reconciliations, and lifecycle events across syndicated and bilateral loans.
  • Define and execute strategic initiatives to scale operations, enhance controls, and improve overall efficiency.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (Middle Office, Fund Accounting, Compliance, IT) and external clients to ensure timely and accurate processing.
  • Provide governance oversight of agent notice workflows, system transitions, and issue resolution processes.
  • Build and maintain a strong risk and control environment by implementing the best practices and robust documentation standards.
  • Drive transformation projects include automation, system integration, and workflow optimization (e.g., Aexeo, Sentry, CitcoRecs).
  • Manage talent across global locations, including coaching, performance reviews, and succession planning.
  • Serve as an escalation point for clients and internal teams on complex or high-risk transactions.
  • Ensure adherence to internal policies, client SLAs, and regulatory obligations.
  • Contribute to the firm’s strategic direction through active participation in governance committees and global initiatives.

About You:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in loan operations, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Deep understanding of syndicated loans, private credit, bilateral lending, and associated operational processes.
  • Proven track record of managing global teams and driving operational improvements.
  • Strong project management skills and experience with system implementations.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (MBA or CFA preferred).

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, short and long-term disability benefits, a retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, mental health and wellness support, parental leave, and more. Additional details about our total rewards package will be shared during the hiring process.

At Citco, we take pride in fostering an inclusive culture by prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation, mutual respect, and collaboration. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. If you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer, Citco adheres to making all employment and personnel decisions without discriminating based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, physical disability, mental disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national or ethnic origin, or any other protected status. We believe that an inclusive workforce not only enriches our company but also drives us towards greater success.

title: Crew Tech Lead
description:
• We are engineering the future of banking using modern cloud, AI and software engineering technologies.

  • Together, we will build scalable technology platforms that solve real customer problems and transform how Operations works.

Do work that matters

Are you ready to lead the transformation of customer and operational journeys through modern engineering and AI?

As Crew Tech Lead, you will shape the strategic, architectural and engineering direction of our next-generation Complaints platforms, including the evolution from traditional workflow-based solutions towards modern, API-led, event-driven and AI-enabled capabilities.

You will combine deep engineering leadership with a strong customer and product mindset, creating technology solutions that simplify complex operational journeys and improve the lived experience of our customers and people.

See yourself in our team

Operations Technology supports the critical work that happens behind the scenes to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers. You will lead technology capabilities that are important to the bank's customer experience, operational resilience, risk and compliance posture.

As Complaints Crew Tech Lead, you will lead a diverse, cross-functional engineering organisation and create an environment where talented engineers can perform at their best. You will be expected to build a highly motivated, inclusive and technically strong engineering culture, developing engineering leaders and creating clear accountability and ownership across teams.

You will champion a build-it, run-it, own-it mindset, raising engineering standards across software quality, DevSecOps, resilience, observability and operational excellence.

You will also play a pivotal role in the adoption of AI and agentic technologies, building solutions that responsibly combine AI, enterprise data, knowledge, reusable services and human oversight to deliver better customer and operational outcomes.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organisation, creating a strong culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence and continuous learning.

  • Coach and develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers and emerging technical leaders, building sustainable leadership capability across the crew.

  • Shape the technology and engineering roadmap for Complaints and Operations capabilities, ensuring alignment with customer outcomes, business strategy and enterprise architecture.

  • Provide architectural leadership across cloud-native, distributed and microservices-based platforms, including API-led and event-driven architectures.

  • Drive appropriate decomposition of legacy and monolithic platforms into reusable business capabilities and independently scalable services, while avoiding unnecessary architectural complexity.

  • Lead the responsible adoption of AI and agentic engineering, with demonstrated experience taking AI-enabled capabilities beyond experimentation into measurable business or customer outcomes.

  • Establish engineering patterns for integrating AI models, agents, enterprise APIs, knowledge and data while ensuring appropriate security, governance, observability and human oversight.

  • Champion modern software engineering practices across automated testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, SRE, observability and platform engineering.

  • Build strong partnerships across Product, Operations, Architecture, Data, AI, Risk and other Technology teams to translate business strategy into executable technology outcomes.

  • Drive simplification and reuse, reducing dependency on bespoke and legacy technologies in favour of strategic enterprise platforms and reusable capabilities.

  • Maintain strong accountability for the resilience, security, risk and operational performance of production services owned by the crew.

We're interested in hearing from people who have:

  • Proven experience leading, motivating and developing large engineering organisations of ~ 70+ people, including Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders, within a complex enterprise environment.

  • A demonstrated track record of building high-performing engineering cultures, developing talent, raising technical standards and creating strong ownership across geographically distributed teams.

  • Strong software engineering foundations with sufficient hands-on technical depth to challenge designs, influence architecture and provide credibility with senior engineers.

  • Hands-on engineering experience in one or more technologies such as Java, .NET, Python, React or similar modern technology stacks.

  • Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native microservices and distributed architectures, including APIs, event-driven integration, containerisation, resilience patterns and observability.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering AI/GenAI initiatives into real business environments, ideally including agentic AI, LLM-based applications, RAG/knowledge architectures, AI evaluation or MLOps.

  • An understanding of how to safely operationalise AI, including responsible AI, security, model and agent evaluation, data governance, human-in-the-loop controls and production observability.

  • Strong experience with modern cloud engineering practices (AWS is added advantage) experience with Pega, Flowable, Appian or similar workflow platforms would be advantageous.

  • Strategic thinking and strong solution architecture experience, with the ability to balance immediate delivery requirements with long-term platform strategy.

  • Experience modernising complex legacy environments and moving towards reusable, scalable enterprise platforms.

  • Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder leadership skills, with demonstrated ability to align customer and business objectives with technology strategy.

  • The ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, make difficult technology decisions and bring teams and stakeholders together around a clear direction.

Working with us

title: Cardiac Technician - Cardiac Stress Testing - York Hospital
description:
Schedule

PRN: Day shift hours, Rotating Weekends and Holidays.

General Summary

Performs various stress tests and other non-invasive cardiac diagnostic procedures utilizing clinical knowledge and professional judgement within the parameters of professional and departmental standards and protocols. Prepares, assesses, and provides care for the patient throughout the procedure. Tests performed may include exercise stress test, pharmacological stress tests, stress echocardiograms and nuclear stress tests. Other testing done may include 12-lead EKG's, EEG's, EECP, and scanning Holter Monitors. Tests are performed in the inpatient and outpatient setting.

Essential Functions:

  • Possesses the knowledge and skills level to administer treadmill and pharmacological protocols for stress tests which includes: monitor, record, and interpret EKG tracings for diagnostic purposes, determine appropriate testing protocol, recognize presence of permanent pace maker, calculate and record diagnostic parameters, monitor and evaluate patient tolerance to test including chest pain, and prepare study for physician interpretation.
  • Responsible for patient safety including recognizing cardiac arrhythmias and respond according to emergency protocols utilizing BLS skills and obtaining emergency medical equipment.
  • Provides care to patient: obtain history, assesses patient condition, collects and interprets clinical information for appropriateness for ordered test, explains procedure, obtains consent, provides personal care/hygiene
  • Performs electrocardiograms. Possesses knowledge of rhythm recognition to notify physician of abnormal EKG and patient's total condition throughout the test. May also be responsible for processing EKG’s from various units/off-site locations including reconciling errors and assigning EKG’s for interpretation.
  • Maintains clinical information, and enters and retrieves patient data from software applications and EMR specific to testing being done.
  • Maintains operational knowledge of Noninvasive Cardiology equipment with ability to troubleshoot this equipment.
  • Performs clerical duties (as applicable to specific department): schedule procedures utilizing knowledge of test codes, inventory management, transport tracking. Answers phone.
  • Trains/precepts new employees
  • Additional training/competency to be completed to independently perform other diagnostic procedures possibly done in department including EEG’s, EECP, and Holter Monitor application and scanning.

Common Expectations:

  • Demonstrates knowledge of the principles of growth and development over the life span of the assigned patient population. Assesses and interprets patient age specific data and provides appropriate, age specific treatment.
  • Provides direct patient care to assigned patient age group(s).
  • Demonstrates a commitment to patient, visitor and staff by: complying with all applicable safety regulations; learning the impact of medical errors and methodology that will lead to reduction of errors; reporting actual and potential errors, as well as hazardous conditions; identifying opportunities to standardize processes and "error proof" systems that will lead to increased safety; and participating in safety education programs and root cause analyses as required.
  • Maintains established policies and procedures, objectives, quality assessment, safety, environmental and infection control standards, cleans equipment.
  • Prepares written documentation as required by the profession and the department. Maintains established policies and procedures, safety, and environmental and infection control standards.
  • Maintains records of examination data and other pertinent information on patients.
  • Provides outstanding service to all customers; fosters teamwork; and practices fiscal responsibility through improvement and innovation.
  • Enhances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs, current literature, attends in-services, and staff meetings as required

Qualifications

Minimum Education:

  • High School Diploma or GED Required
  • Certificate Program Education in Cardiovascular Technology or Exercise Science. Preferred

Work Experience:

  • Less than 1 year Relevant experience. Required

Licenses:

  • Basic Life Support Upon Hire Required

Courses and Training:

  • Completion of cardiac related training/certification. Upon Hire Required

Position Summary:

Facilities Management and Ancillary Services (FMAS) is the steward of McGill University’s physical campuses and infrastructure. It oversees the management of the University’s facilities portfolio in support of institutional strategic priorities and operational needs. FMAS comprises more than 400 employees organized under four functional pillars: Integrated Planning, Project Delivery, Operations, and Ancillary and Support Services.


Reporting to the Senior Director, Integrated Planning, the incumbent is responsible for establishing, planning, organizing and directing the activities of the Building Sustainment sub-unit including its budget and financial activities. They provide leadership to managers and experts under their responsibilities in the strategic planning of budget, policies, procedures and processes. They ensure alignment with Facilities Management and Ancillary Services mission and strategic plan.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Establish the strategic direction of the Building Sustainment sub-unit in collaboration with the Senior Director Integrated Planning and oversees the implementation of short- and long-term plans related to the function of building sustainment planning, asset management, capital renewal and investment planning including budget, policies, procedures and processes.

  • Establish training needs and work with the responsible managers and subject matter experts in developing training programs or in scheduling outside resources to address training needs for the Building Sustainment sub-unit.
  • In collaboration with the Senior Director Integrated Planning, evaluate the effectiveness of the Building Sustainment sub-unit’s business and operational models. Develop methods of improving and/or expanding these models while ensuring integration with other FMAS processes.
  • Provide technical expertise and leadership as required to support the Senior Director, Integrated Planning’s role to guide the McGill community on the delivery of services related to Building Sustainment.
  • Foster relationships with McGill’s stakeholders and external organizations related to the Building Sustainment mandate.
  • Ensure that all the responsible sub-units’ work is completed in compliance with the University and the Government building and construction policies, rules and regulations.
  • Direct and ensure, in conjunction with other Facilities Management and Ancillary Services units, that Building Sustainment guidelines and standards are implemented and adhered in all renovation and/or construction.

  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendation to McGill senior leadership and governance bodies in support of institutional decision-making
  • Lead and organize multidisciplinary teams, including external expertise as required, to support building sustainment and asset management initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment of the University’s building sustainment priorities with applicable external planning frameworks and regulatory requirements.

  • An undergraduate degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

  • Excellent organizational, leadership, and delegation skills, with a demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across diverse teams.
  • Strong written, presentation, and oral communication skills in both English and French, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders at all organizational levels as well as external partners and authorities.

description:
Summary/Objective:

The Foster Care Case Planner is responsible for coordinating services and case planning activities that support the safety, permanency, and well-being of children and families served through the CHJC Foster Care Program. Working collaboratively with children, families, foster parents, local departments of social services, courts, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners, the Case Planner assesses needs, develops and monitors plans, facilitates permanency efforts, and advocates for the services and supports necessary to achieve positive outcomes. This position ensures compliance with agency policies, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations while promoting family engagement, child safety, and stability.


Essential Functions:

1. Complete comprehensive assessments of children, parents, foster parents, and family systems to identify strengths, needs, risks, and service recommendations.

2. Develop, implement, monitor, and update individualized service and permanency plans in collaboration with children, families, foster parents, service providers, and the treatment team.

3. Maintain regular contact with children, birth families, foster families, and collateral contacts in accordance with agency policy, local district contracts, and New York State regulations.

4. Coordinate and monitor visitation between children and family members, including providing supervision when assigned and assessing progress toward permanency goals.

5. Facilitate and participate in treatment team meetings, case conferences, family meetings, permanency planning reviews, and other required service planning activities.

6. Provide supportive case management, guidance, and resource coordination to children, birth families, and foster families to support safety, stability, and permanency outcomes.

7. Coordinate with schools, healthcare providers, care coordinators, behavioral health providers, and community-based services to ensure children and families receive necessary supports.

8. Maintain ongoing communication with service providers to monitor participation, progress, and barriers related to treatment and service plan goals.

9. Attend Family Court proceedings; prepare reports, provide case updates, and testify when required.

10. Serve as a liaison between Children's Home of Jefferson County, local departments of social services, courts, schools, healthcare providers, foster parents, and other community partners.

11. Conduct foster home visits and monitor foster home compliance with agency standards, OCFS regulations, and applicable safety requirements.

12. Assess child and family safety on an ongoing basis and develop, implement, and revise safety plans as necessary.

13. Maintain complete, accurate, and timely case documentation, including contacts, assessments, service plans, visitation reports, court documentation, incident reports, home visits, and other required records.

14. Maintain case records in compliance with OCFS regulations, LDSS requirements, agency policy, and applicable accreditation standards.

15. Complete all required reports, forms, and documentation within established timeframes.

16. Assist in the facilitation of independent living and life skills activities for youth, as applicable.

17. Lead permanency planning efforts for assigned children and families, including reunification, kinship placement, adoption, guardianship, and other permanency outcomes as appropriate.

18.Participate in the agency on-call rotation and provide crisis response support as assigned


Agency/Regulatory Compliance:

1. Maintains case records and prepares on-going reports on all children and families receiving services through the CHJC Foster Care Program

2. Completes all required documentation

3. Aid in the facilitation of Life Skills Instruction

4. Participate in the Oncall rotation

1. Aid in facilitation of GPSII/MAPP and on-going training. Training expectations may include times outside of normal business hours

Responsible for assuring that certification of Foster Parents and their homes are in compliance with OCFS Regulations, including but not limited to: Part 443 Certified and Approved Foster Family Boarding Homes-Agency Procedures for Certification; Approval and Supervision, Part 444-Requirements for Licensed Certified and Approved Foster Family Boarding Homes and Part 435-Respite Care and Services for Families and Foster Families.

title: Site Lead, Data Center Operations
description:
Manages operations for a moderately complex data center, monitoring key metrics, addressing routine issues like capacity and cooling, and recommending improvements aligned with industry best practices. Provides support for escalated technical problems, optimizes automation and monitoring tools, documents processes and incident responses, and contributes to continuous improvement projects. Supports new region builds and expansions, collaborates with project teams, and oversees installations, repairs, inventory, and logistics—leading component upgrades and advising on data center purchases and deployments.

Key Responsibilities
Data Center Site Portfolio Management:

-Typically one data center of moderate complexity.

Performance Monitoring and Analysis:
-Independently monitors and analyzes data center operations, providing insights and recommendations based on metrics.
-Analyzes and resolves routine issues (e.g., physical capacity, power capacity, cooling capacity).
-Partners across functions and regions to identify, measure, and improve processes in alignment with industry best practices (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), contribute to improvement projects, and support alignment with strategic objectives.

Issue Management and Automation:
-Provides support for escalated complex technical issues.
-Triages and/or escalates issues and optimizes the use of automation, scheduling, and monitoring tools to proactively mitigate potential problems.

-Independently supports new region builds and expansion activities, both onsite and remotely.

-Oversees installations, repairs, inventory management, and logistics tasks for data centers.
-Leads efforts to replace and upgrade components.
-Evaluates and recommends purchases or upgrades for data centers.
-Plans and oversees rack deployments, installation.

Planning & Execution:
-Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.
Collaboration & Partnership:
-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.
Continuous Improvement:

Job Description:

Gilead Freelance Project Manager

Project Manager, Creator & Influencer Operations

Client: Gilead Sciences

Reporting To: Jayne Almonte

Overview

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to support creator and influencer marketing programs for pharma brand, Gilead. This role will serve as the operational backbone of multiple influencer workstreams, managing timelines, approvals, communications, content workflows, and cross-functional coordination across agency teams, creators, platform partners, legal/compliance stakeholders, and client teams.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced, highly regulated environments and has experience managing complex social, influencer, and content production programs from planning through execution.

Key Responsibilities

Creator & Influencer Program Management

  • Manage end-to-end project plans for creator and influencer campaigns across multiple Gilead pharma brands.

  • Develop and maintain master timelines, deliverable calendars, approval schedules, and launch trackers.

  • Coordinate creator onboarding, briefing calls, content submission schedules, posting timelines, and campaign milestones.

  • Ensure all deliverables remain on track and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and blockers.

Approval & Compliance Coordination

  • Manage content review workflows across Gilead, agency partners, legal, regulatory, and PRC review teams.

  • Track submission deadlines, approval status, revisions, and final sign-offs.

  • Ensure all content and creator deliverables meet regulatory, disclosure, and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinate feedback consolidation and facilitate timely revisions with partners and creators.

Cross-Functional Team Coordination

  • Serve as central point of contact across:

  • Internal teams: Social Strategy, Paid Social, Initiative

  • Influencer Partners Agencies and Vendors

  • External Creative Agencies

  • Client Teams

  • Lead status meetings and distribute meeting recaps, action items, and next steps.

  • Maintain clear communication across all stakeholders to ensure alignment and accountability.

Content Operations & Workflow Management

  • Maintain internal and client-facing trackers and comms for:

  • Creator selection

  • Content development

  • PRC submissions

  • Approvals

  • Usage rights

  • Posting schedules

  • Reporting deliverables

  • Manage asset collection and organization across multiple workstreams.

  • Package up assets and posting instructions and launch readiness activities.

Influencer & Partner Management

  • Support creator briefing processes and logistics coordination.

  • Manage communications with creator partners and influencer agencies.

  • Coordinate campaign paperwork and campaign documentation.

  • Ensure all stakeholders have the information needed to execute successfully.

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Track campaign deliverables and performance reporting schedules.

  • Review influencer videos and flag any concerns on messaging or quality of videos for Strategist to review.

  • Support in building monthly report templates and work alongside Strategist to deliver.

  • Support development of client-ready status updates and executive summaries.

  • Monitor project health and provide regular updates to leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Required

  • 4–7+ years of project management experience within social, influencer, or integrated marketing.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent campaigns and stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage detailed workflows and timelines.

  • Experience working with influencer marketing programs and creator partnerships.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience working within highly regulated industries (Pharma, Healthcare, Financial Services, Government).

  • Familiarity with PRC/legal review processes.

  • Experience with creator platforms, influencer agencies, and social content workflows.

  • Experience managing cross-functional agency teams.

  • Knowledge of whitelisting and paid amplification workflows.

Success Looks Like

  • Own operational management of Gilead creator and influencer programs.

  • Centralize communications across agency, client, creator, and partner teams.

  • Improve approval process efficiency and timeline adherence.

  • Maintain accurate project trackers and reporting cadence.

  • Reduce project management burden currently spread across strategy team members.

  • Serve as the day-to-day operational lead across creator workstreams, enabling strategists to focus on planning, innovation, and client consulting

title: Survey or Engineering Rotational Aspire
description:
The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

The rotational program provides valuable opportunities to become immersed in three aspects of our business:

  • Engineering
  • Survey
  • Technology

The combination of cross-functional work assignments and action learning projects help to develop the skills and capabilities needed to build your career path toward leadership. Program participants will receive feedback during the program in the form of evaluations at the midpoint and completion of each rotation. Rotations will be in the United States.

Program Benefits:

  • Combines on-the-job experience with business, leadership and personal development training.
  • Requires your accountability and delivery of actual business results.
  • Opportunity to expand technical capabilities, leadership skills, and business knowledge that provides a strong foundation for you to leverage and drive your career growth.
  • Exposure to a broad range of experiences and subject matter experts.

What You Will Need:

The rotational program is highly selective, and space is limited. To be considered, at a minimum, candidates must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Industrial, Materials Science) or maritime-related (Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture) field
  • Strong interest in exploring assignments within our Class Operations: Engineering, Technology, and Survey
  • Demonstrated leadership ability.
  • Ability to adapt to a dynamic, ever-changing environment.
  • A self-starter mentality committed to learning new things and taking ownership.
  • Ability to interface with customers, which requires strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Academic achievement as demonstrated by an overall GPA of 2.75 or higher (3.0 preferred)
  • Ability to multi-task without faltering on attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Prior internship experience in maritime or related industry strongly preferred.
  • Current authorization to work in the U.S. or permanent resident.
  • Ability to relocate to Spring, Texas (Greater Houston Area) for employment by July 2027.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required.
  • Basic knowledge of engineering fundamentals, including proficiency in programs such as Python and AutoCAD.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Less than one-year of professional industry experience.
  • Ability to learn the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships:

The incumbent (Aspire) will report to a senior-level engineer or technical manager. This position has no direct reports.

Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

title: Data & Migration Engineer
description:
Planet Depos ships enterprise software for the legal industry, and the certified record is our product: if the data is wrong, the business is wrong. This role owns the data layer of our platform, and that is three jobs in one. Design: the data models and data contracts that our product teams, our low-code estate, our integrations, and our analytics all build against. Migration: we are replacing the legacy system the business runs on, which means moving two decades of operational data out of an undocumented database safely and provably while the business keeps running on it. Quality: the feeds, reconciliation, and monitoring that make the data trustworthy every day, not just on cutover day.


ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the target data model in partnership with the Group Architect: the canonical entities the platform is built around, identity and access-bearing structures, and the boundaries with systems that own their own truth (CRM, finance)
  • Own the data workstream of the legacy-platform replacement end to end: profiling, mapping, extraction, transformation, load, verification, and a staged, rehearsed cutover
  • Build and operate the ongoing synchronization that keeps the new platform current through the transition, engineered for a fragile legacy source: rate limits respected, timeouts and retries handled, silent feed breaks made impossible by monitoring
  • Design the data contracts our integrations run on: the supported surfaces and interchange formats that let customer systems and partner tools consume our data without bespoke plumbing
  • Give the low-code estate a safe foundation: supported data surfaces for the citizen-developer applications and flows the business runs on, replacing direct database access over time
  • Build the reconciliation and data-quality evidence: automated counts and checksums, exception queues, and human-readable verification reports
  • Create and maintain sanitized and synthetic datasets from production, and manage dataset promotion across environments, so non-production work never requires production data
  • Lay the analytics foundation with the platform team: safe read paths (replicas, sanitized exports) and data structures the business can query without touching production
  • Steward database design standards with the platform team: DevOps owns infrastructure operations; this seat owns how data is modeled, accessed, and kept trustworthy
  • Document the models, mappings, and pipelines so they are auditable and transferable, readable by both humans and agents


REQUIRED WORK OPERATING STANDARDS:

  • Evidence over assertion. The number is right because the reconciliation proves it, not because the script ran.
  • You make your work legible: entity models, mapping documents, runbooks, and pipelines someone else could operate.
  • You raise solutions alongside your objections, with an owner and a date.
  • You have worked in a fast-moving environment and stayed effective when priorities shifted under you.
  • You can disagree, and then commit wholeheartedly once a call is made.
  • You treat access to sensitive data as a responsibility to design around, not a convenience to accumulate.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCES:


You have moved production data between live systems without losing any.


You have executed at least one legacy-to-modern migration of a business-critical system, with the discipline that implies: reverse-engineering an undocumented source schema, building the field-level crosswalk from what the data actually contains, staged runs, parallel verification windows, documented reconciliation, and a rollback plan you could actually invoke. You know a migration is done when the evidence says so, not when the script exits zero.


Evidence looks like: "Migrated the operational database of a revenue-carrying system with row-level reconciliation and zero unexplained variance," or the mapping document for a several-hundred-table legacy schema that became the build contract for the replacement. In an interview, you can walk through the migration that went sideways, what the reconciliation caught, and what you changed.


You have designed data models and data contracts that a whole estate runs on.


You have owned an operational data model with many consumers: product applications, low-code and citizen-developer workloads, third-party integrations, and analytics, each pulling in a different direction. You know how to define the canonical entities, decide which system is the source of truth for what, and draw the boundary where another system's model stops being yours. You design the supported surfaces (views, APIs, contracts) that let those consumers build safely instead of reaching into tables directly, and your models outlive the applications that first used them.


Evidence looks like: "Designed the core entity model a company's next three products were built on," or "replaced direct database access for a sprawl of internal tools with governed, supported data surfaces without breaking the business." In an interview, you can defend a source-of-truth boundary you drew and describe the consumer you said no to, and why.


You treat data quality as an engineering discipline, with evidence.


Verification is your deliverable, not an afterthought: automated reconciliation (counts, checksums, exception queues), drift monitoring on ongoing feeds so a silent break is impossible, and verification reports a non-engineer can read and trust. The same discipline extends past the migration: the daily synchronization, the analytics foundation, and the data the business reads every morning. You handle confidential data like it matters, because here it does: litigation material under client data-protection commitments, least-privilege access, sanitized data everywhere outside production. And you have built that yourself: created sanitized or synthetic datasets from production systems and managed which datasets live in which environment, so non-production work never needs production data.


Evidence looks like: "Built the reconciliation harness that ran nightly during a nine-month parallel run and caught every variance before the business did," or "built the sanitized-dataset pipeline that let every non-production environment drop real customer data."


COMPENSATION RANGE:

  • $150,000 – $205,000 annual base compensation, commensurate with experience.
  • Benefits include Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage; Life insurance (Voluntary Term and Whole Life); Voluntary Long Term Disability; paid time off and paid holidays; 401(k); Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and Maternity Leave.

title: Senior Technical  Project Manager- Paris, France
description:
Senior Technical Project Manager

Software & Application Delivery | Data and AI/ML Programs

Job Title Senior Technical Project Manager
Department Technology / Program Delivery
Reports To Director of Program Management / Head of Delivery
Experience 8–12 years, including 4+ years managing technical programs
Location Onsite
Employment Type Full-time
ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team technical programs spanning application engineering and data/AI-ML platforms. You will be the connective tissue between engineering, product, data science, architecture, QA, and business stakeholders — turning ambiguous goals into sequenced, resourced, measurable plans, and then driving them to production.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a status-reporting one. You are expected to read an architecture diagram, challenge an estimate, understand why a model is failing validation, and make credible trade-off recommendations. Success is measured by predictable delivery, healthy engineering teams, and outcomes stakeholders can point to.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Program & Delivery Ownership

  • Own end-to-end delivery for two or more concurrent technical programs, including scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, risks, and release readiness.
  • Build and maintain integrated delivery plans with clear milestones, critical path, capacity assumptions, and explicit entry/exit criteria per phase.
  • Identify and manage cross-team dependencies across squads, vendors, and platform teams; drive resolution before they become schedule slips.
  • Run structured risk and issue management with mitigation owners and dates; escalate early with options rather than problems.
  • Manage release and launch readiness — go/no-go reviews, cutover plans, rollback criteria, hypercare, and post-launch stabilisation.

Software & Application Engineering

  • Partner with Engineering Managers and Product Owners for Agile squads — backlog readiness, sprint planning, estimation, velocity, and definition of done.
  • Review technical designs and solution approaches with engineering and architecture; ensure non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability, observability) are planned, not retrofitted.
  • Drive engineering discipline — CI/CD adoption, environment readiness, test automation coverage, and code quality gates — to reduce cycle time and defect leakage.
  • Track and challenge technical debt and represent delivery impact in prioritisation discussions.

Data and AI/ML Programs

  • Manage delivery of data and AI/ML initiatives — data ingestion and pipeline builds, platform migrations, analytics products, and ML model development through deployment.
  • Understand the ML lifecycle — problem framing, data acquisition, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining — and plan realistically for experimentation cycles, data readiness gaps, and non-deterministic outcomes.
  • Coordinate across data engineering, data science, and MLOps teams, ensuring handoffs between them are defined and instrumented.
  • Ensure model performance, drift monitoring, and responsible-AI review gates are addressed as first-class delivery requirements, alongside data governance, lineage, privacy, and compliance obligations.
  • Translate technical outcomes into business metrics; support ROI and value-realisation tracking for data and AI investments in partnership with product and finance.

Stakeholder Management & Governance

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for program communication — status, forecasts, and decisions — for executive, business, and technical audiences at the right altitude for each.
  • Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, and architecture/change boards; drive decisions to closure with documented rationale.
  • Build and maintain delivery dashboards and reporting reflecting real signal, not vanity metrics.
  • Support resource forecasting, vendor engagement, and SOW/change-order discussions; and manage third-party or offshore delivery partners against SLAs and quality expectations.

Process & Team Leadership

  • Coach teams on Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid models as appropriate; improve delivery practices, templates, and metrics across the portfolio.
  • Mentor junior project managers and scrum masters and act as a force multiplier for the delivery function.
  • Lead retrospectives and post-incident reviews and drive measurable corrective actions.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8–12 years of total professional experience, with at least 4–5 years managing technical software delivery programs.
  • Demonstrated ownership of at least one complex, multi-team program delivered to production with measurable business impact.
  • Hands-on experience delivering both application/product engineering work and data or AI/ML initiatives.
  • Strong working knowledge of modern software delivery: Agile/Scrum, CI/CD, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, microservices, and test automation.
  • Working familiarity with the data and ML stack — data pipelines and warehousing, model training and evaluation concepts, and MLOps practices such as model versioning and monitoring.

description:
What you’ll do:

You are the key to home ownership. As an escrow officer, you’re the human link between our process and people. You’re there at the beginning, reviewing contracts and following instructions. You’re there in the middle, ensuring that all the associated paperwork is completed efficiently and accurately. You’re working with agents and their clients to keep the process moving forward, verifying that titles are clean, taxes are paid, and loans are funded. Finally, you’re there at the end, to assure that no funds or property will change hands until all terms have been carried to completion.

Who you are:

  • People reader, recognizing and adapting to an agent’s or homebuyer’s personality and mood to make them feel comfortable, even when delivering bad news; showing empathy to ease their frustration and give them confidence that you’re in their corner.
  • Multi-tasker, highly organized, being able to work a large number of contracts with numerous agents, buyers, and sellers simultaneously under deadline pressure.

Your responsibilities:

  • Jack – or Jill – of all trades: Knowing the intricacies of the contract from beginning to end, ensuring that it is closed in a timely, efficient, and error-free manner.
  • Devoted to detail: Verifying all paperwork is complete so that escrow closes on time and correctly.
  • Following the money: Working with lenders and underwriters to ensure that all the I’s are dotted and T’s are crossed to fund and complete transactions.
  • Relationship building: Establishing and maintaining relationships with essential industry players – agents, attorneys, lenders, surveyors, and government agencies – that enable you to smoothly manage transactions.
  • Business builder: Reaching out to new agents, earning their confidence and trust, and creating opportunities to market our business; retaining agents by providing them with white-glove service.
  • Talent builder: Training escrow assistants to open opportunities for advancement; delegating, auditing work, answering questions, and giving direction.
  • Sealing the deal: Being present at closing and making it a positive, memorable experience for agents and buyers.

Qualifications:

What you must have:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent; take continuing education courses as required.
  • Experience: Two to three years of escrow experience, both front- and back-end experience.
  • Certification: Notary public and escrow officer licenses.
  • Industry awareness: Technical knowledge of closing process.
  • Computer skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite.
  • Communications skills: Strong written and verbal skills to keep agents, buyers, sellers, and all other parties up to date with the process and work with them to resolve issues.

What we’d like you to have:

  • One year of escrow closing experience.
  • An existing client base that will follow them to our company.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow-MSH-21015-024
description:
Physician-Scientist Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Multimodal AI for Prostate Cancer Imaging (Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, New York, NY)

The Radiology AI & Informatics Group is seeking a Postdoctoral Physician-Scientist Research Fellow in the Department of Diagnostic, Molecular, and Interventional Radiology at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai.

This position will focus on multimodal AI for prostate cancer imaging. The research fellow will contribute to federally funded and institutionally supported research programs that develop and validate AI-driven tools to improve prostate cancer detection, characterization, and treatment guidance. This is an excellent opportunity to conduct innovative AI research powered by large-scale, real-world clinical data and to work directly with a team of AI scientists and world-renowned clinicians in radiology, pathology, and urology, gaining cross-disciplinary expertise that accelerates translational AI research from bench to bedside.

The clinically trained Physician-Scientist Research Fellow will serve as the clinical anchor of our AI research, working alongside computer scientists, engineers, biostatisticians, and radiologists to ensure that the datasets, models, and validation studies are clinically meaningful and positioned for real-world impact. Responsibilities include:

(1) curating and quality-controlling multimodal imaging and clinical datasets from PACS and the EHR; (2) defining study cohorts through chart review and clinical phenotyping and linking imaging to reference standards such as biopsy and whole-mount pathology; (3) developing annotation protocols/pipeline and establish ground truth; (4) designing clinical validation and reader studies with appropriate endpoints and analysis plans; (5) and coordinating and managing radiology fellows and attending radiologists in multi-reader studies. The candidate will also analyze diagnostic-performance results and lead manuscripts, abstracts, and grant applications.

The qualifications are: (1) an MD or MD/PhD; (2) a strong interest in medical AI and translational research; (3) excellent skills at the interface of clinical and technical teams; (4) radiology training, familiarity with prostate mpMRI and PI-RADS, and clinical-research methodology experience are preferred (programming is a plus but not required). To apply, candidates should send the following materials to Dr. Yan Zhuang (yan.zhuang@mssm.edu) with the subject line "Physician-Scientist Postdoc Fellow Application - FirstName LastName": (1) a CV; (2) a brief statement of interests; (3) the earliest start date; (4) a list of three references.

Compensation Statement

The Mount Sinai Health System (MSHS) provides salary ranges that comply with the New York City Law on Salary Transparency in Job Advertisements. The salary range for the role is $72,500.00 - $80,000.00 Annually. Actual salaries depend on a variety of factors, including experience, education, and operational need. The salary range or contractual rate listed does not include bonuses/incentive, differential pay or other forms of compensation or benefits.

  • Preventative and Predictive Maintenance - Interprets machine and tool maintenance records and data to develop and execute preventative and predictive management strategies to drive continuous improvement within the manufacturing process.
  • Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.
  • Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Experience:

title: Coding Audit Coordinator
description:
The Corp Coding Audit Coord reviews documentation and coding of hospital records to patients to ensure compliance with federal and state laws and regulations. Also performs audits of coding quality and maintains spreadsheets for coding area statistics and process flow.

  1. Medical Coding Review
    1. Assist in the development, performance and maintenance of a long term comprehensive, clinical coding audit program for inpatient and outpatient coding. Conducts coding compliance and charge-based coding audits, inpatient and outpatient coding reviews.
    2. Performs quarterly complex coding quality audits on each coder. Reviews 100% of coding performed by new staff until preset quality standards are met. Audits clinics with autocoding feature for accuracy of documentation and correct diagnosis assignment.
    3. Designs and implements additional coding and billing audits on items of focus and vulnerability based on RACs, OIG workplan, public profile sites and other areas considered high-risk from a compliance standpoint.
    4. Prepares reports based on audit results (including recommendations for improvement); analyzes coding data to identify coding variations and determine cause for variation. Presents findings to Corporate Coding leadership. Provides input to coding manager on quality of coding for each coder at yearly evaluation.
    5. Assists FMOLHS in reviews related to internal or external investigations.
  2. Quality/Compliance Review
    1. Performs code-based charge audits to assure compliant claims data and monitors adherence to government and third-party billing requirements to optimize revenue generation. Researches and appeals payment denials received from payers as necessary within designated timelines. Analyzes any identified patterns in NCCI edits and assists FMOLHS facilities with implementing process improvement initiatives to prevent claim failures.
    2. Works with compliance officer to ensure that FMOLHS entities comply with coding/billing laws and guidelines.
    3. Identifies opportunities for documentation improvement and/or process changes.
  3. Collaboration & Partnership
    1. Collaborates with coding manager and coding educator to identify educational opportunities from results of quarterly audits. Assists coding educator in development of education specific to issues/opportunities identified during auditing/monitoring of coding.
    2. Ientifies any medical staff training needed from issues/opportunities found during audits, notifying coding manager and coding educator of educational needs. Assists in providing training to coders, hospital staff and physicians for ICD-10-CM/PCS future implementation.
    3. Assists in compiling information as needed for various Medical Staff, Medical Records and Quality meetings.
    4. Serves as a resource to Internal Audit staff/RMD on coding and chargemaster-related issues.
  4. Other Duties As Assigned
    1. Performs other duties as assigned or requested.
    2. Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field of coding by attending educational programs, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and maintaining certification. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • 5 years IP and OP coding experience
  • Bachelors degree with RHIA and CCS; Associates degree with RHIT and CCS (if not current CCS, position contingent on CCS within 3 months of hire)
  • Extensive knowledge of coding to include proficiency in coding of inpatient, outpatient, ambulatory surgery and ER visits using knowledge of ICD-9 and CPT coding; assignment of DRGs, APCs and official coding guidelines.
  • CCS
