title: Program Manager 3
description:
We are seeking an IC3 Technical Program Manager to support inventory control activities for data center build projects within an assigned site, country, or regional area. This role will focus on build material deployment, inventory accuracy, logistics coordination, and third-party logistics (3PL) support, ensuring local data center programs maintain operational readiness and audit compliance.

This position carries a strong level of responsibility and requires the ability to manage day-to-day execution while escalating risks, blockers, and process gaps where needed. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to coordinate material lifecycle activities, support accurate inventory execution, and partner effectively with internal teams, vendors, and regional stakeholders.

  • Key Responsibilities
  • Inventory Tracking & Deployment: Support execution of material deployment activities across assigned site, country, or regional builds, ensuring inventory accuracy, timely material movement, and governance against DCICM standards.
  • 3PL / Vendor Coordination: Work with third-party logistics providers to support Oracle’s chain of custody requirements, service level expectations, and quality standards. Escalate vendor performance concerns where appropriate.
  • Build Support: Partner with construction, engineering, logistics, operations, and regional inventory teams to align material flow and inventory readiness with local build schedules.
  • System Accuracy & Compliance: Ensure inventory transactions, movements, reconciliations, and deployments are captured accurately within Oracle systems; maintain records to support audit and compliance requirements.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify material, inventory, or logistics risks that may impact site or country-level build timelines. Support mitigation plans and escalate issues to regional or global DCICM leadership when needed.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as an inventory control point of contact for assigned site or country-level activities, providing updates to regional DCICM leadership, project teams, and vendor partners.
  • Process Support & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to process improvements, reporting enhancements, and standardization efforts within the region. Support adoption of global DCICM processes at the local level.
  • Governance Support: Apply global inventory policies and regional operating procedures while ensuring compliance with security, safety, audit, and operational standards.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Program / Project Coordination: Experience supporting cross-functional projects or programs with measurable outcomes in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Inventory Management Knowledge: Good understanding of material flow, inventory accuracy, reconciliation, stock control, and audit requirements.
  • 3PL / Vendor Support: Experience working with logistics providers, warehouse teams, or vendors to support SLA adherence, inventory movement, and operational execution.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to review inventory data, identify discrepancies or trends, and support corrective actions.
  • Risk & Issue Awareness: Able to identify risks early, communicate blockers clearly, and support mitigation activities to maintain project alignment.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with regional peers, site teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
  • Technical Systems Knowledge: Familiarity with ERP, WMS, inventory management, or ticketing tools. Oracle Fusion or similar system experience is a plus.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic build environment with shifting priorities, tight timelines, and coordination across multiple local or regional stakeholders.
  • Experience: Typically 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Planning & Scheduling, Inventory Control, Logistics, Warehouse Management, Supply Chain, or a related operational function.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in data center, infrastructure, construction, logistics, warehouse, or large-scale operations environments.
  • Knowledge of material governance, chain of custody, inventory reconciliation, and audit compliance practices.
  • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or other process improvement methodologies is a plus.
  • Ability to influence and coordinate across teams without direct authority.

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business administration, operations, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.

  • Certification in inventory, supply chain, or project management, such as APICS, CPIM, CSCP, or PMP, is preferred but not required.

title: Customer Engineer, Voice
description:
About Open

Open.cx is the AI customer experience platform, automating support, outbound, sales, and customer understanding, built for enterprises that cannot afford slow, expensive, or mediocre support. We automate over 80% of interactions for companies like MoneyGram, Mollie, TicketSwap, and More.com handling voice, email, and web at massive scale with AI that thinks fast and feels human.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, X by Unifonic. We recently raised $7M+ and are accelerating from a startup into a global scale-up. Our customers replace entire stacks of legacy tools, cut support costs by up to 12×, and deliver dramatically better experiences to their own customers.

We are a small, high-output team that ships fast, works directly with customers, and genuinely cares about the product we are building.

The Role

We are hiring a Customer Engineer to serve as the direct technical bridge between our enterprise customers and the Open.cx product. This is a hands-on engineering role with heavy customer exposure not pure support, and not pure internal development.

This role focuses on our voice stack: helping enterprise customers launch, debug, and scale AI phone agents. You will respond quickly to customer queries via Slack or video calls, lead onboarding and implementation, debug complex issues including third-party integrations, and ship fixes or enhancements directly in our Node.js + TypeScript codebase. Prompt engineering is a significant part of the role you will help customers get the most out of our AI agents capabilities every day.

What You'll Do

  • Primary Technical Point of Contact: Respond fast to customer queries, join video calls, and own resolution end-to-end.
  • Lead Technical Onboarding: Guide enterprise customers through setup, configuration, and integration with tools like Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, and others.
  • Debug & Troubleshoot: Diagnose and resolve complex issues in live customer environments.
  • Ship Code: Implement fixes, integration enhancements, and small features directly in the Node.js / TypeScript codebase.
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering: Share customer context, escalate systemic problems, and help prioritise what the team builds next.
  • Develop Platform Expertise: Build deep knowledge of our AI agents and prompt engineering so you can effectively advise customers on optimising their support operations.
  • Document & Scale Knowledge: Document recurring issues, solutions, and integration patterns to strengthen internal knowledge and customer resources.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with telephony or voice systems (SIP, WebRTC, or similar) is a big plus.
  • 2-3+ years of experience Strong software engineering experience with Node.js and TypeScript you will be writing and shipping production code.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and prompt engineering (Open.cx is AI-native; this is core to the role).
  • Previous customer-facing technical work: onboarding, debugging integrations, or similar in a SaaS environment.
  • Good understanding of (or fast ability to learn) helpdesk APIs: Zendesk, Intercom, HubSpot, etc.
  • Excellent English communication clear writing and confident speaking on video calls with enterprise stakeholders.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving startup: speed, customer impact, and getting things done.
  • Able to be working with customers across US, EU, MENA and GCC time zones.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • YC-backed with real traction we are in-market, growing, and trusted by enterprise names you know.
  • Outsized career trajectory early team members grow into leadership as we scale globally.
  • Real ownership your work will be seen, felt, and talked about company-wide.
  • High-trust team no politics, no bureaucracy; we move fast and support each other.
  • Competitive compensation top-of-market salary plus equity and full benefits.

description:

Location: Anaheim, CA (On-site)

The Electrical Assembly Technician will be responsible for assembling products to blueprint specifications while adhering to strict quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong attention to detail, the ability to work independently and within a team, and a commitment to maintaining a safe and clean work environment.


What You’ll Do

  • Use hand tools and equipment to perform various assembly tasks, ensuring accuracy and precision.

  • Follow all relevant quality systems and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) protocols to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.
  • Maintain an organized, clean, and efficient work area, ensuring proper care and handling of materials and tools.
  • Collaborate with team members to complete projects efficiently and effectively.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to meet production goals and deadlines.


Who You Are

  • This position requires the ability to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing, to complete inspection reports and understand safety and quality standards.
  • High School Diploma or GED, with a minimum of 1 year of Aerospace or Automotive industry experience. Graduation from an Aerospace or Automotive technical program can substitute for experience.
  • Ability to interpret and work from technical drawings and assembly instructions.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively within a team, taking direction from experienced peers, leads, and supervisors.
  • Ability to stand, bend, stoop, and lift materials regularly.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods during the assembly process.

title: Lead Consultant - Analytics Engineering (Model Environments)
description:
About us

Analytium is a boutique UK data and analytics consultancy - 14 people, 150 projects delivered for 50 clients. We are embedded in a UK tier-one bank, modernising one of the largest SAS estates in the country, because we build our own accelerators and we work AI-first.

Why this role exists

Banks are increasingly asking us a harder question than "can you migrate this" - they are asking "can you make our modelling environment governed, repeatable and defensible". This role focuses primarily on the ungoverned script estate and bringing governance to it. That means walking into a credit risk estate nobody fully understands and producing conclusions that survive a model validation review. The person will do estate discovery, own lineage and evidence capture, bring model lifecycle discipline, industrialise data pipelines, evidence rationalisation decisions so they survive audit, and work directly with credit risk, modelling and model risk stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Strong practical SAS capability across Base SAS, macro language, PROC SQL, and Enterprise Guide, including the ability to reverse-engineer undocumented code.
  • Working-strength Python experience, with the software engineering discipline to take notebooks or scripts to production-grade.
  • Hands-on Databricks experience, including Delta Lake, notebooks, and cluster behaviour.
  • Credit risk modelling knowledge including IFRS 9, IRB, PD, LGD, EAD, capital, stress testing, or model monitoring.
  • Track record of shipping work where an AI coding tool did most of the typing, with the ability to explain what you needed to fix.
  • Experience automating part of your own work using AI-assisted ways of working.
  • Client-facing experience, including running workshops and writing outputs clients will act on, together with strong written English for client-facing assessment output.
  • Able to travel occasionally to the Hampshire base and for possible European client travel.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience conducting formal estate assessment, discovery, or technical due diligence work.
  • Experience with MLOps or model lifecycle tooling such as MLflow, model registries, or feature stores.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Databricks Workflows.
  • Experience with data product or data mesh operating models.
  • Knowledge of European banking or EU regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with Teradata and/or PySpark.

Benefits

  • Discretionary annual bonus scheme

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Information Management Branch oversees how data is collected, organised, distributed, and utilised across schools, early childhood education, corporate offices, and the Department. Work involves using repetitive motions: substantial movements of the wrists, hands, and or fingers while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard.

Work involves being able to perceive the nature of sound at normal speaking levels with or without correction; the ability to make fine discriminations in sound. Work requires close visual and acuity and the ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus, i.e. shift gaze from viewing a computer monitor to forms/printed material that are closer to compare data at close vision.

Attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in complex situations is required. Must have the ability to maintain collaborative and respectable working relationships throughout SRHS and other organizations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Principal Supply Chain Engineer
description:
The Principal Supply Chain Product Engineer is a recognized technical leader responsible for ensuring that products are designed, validated, and manufactured with robust, scalable, and cost-effective test solutions. This role serves as a key advisor across Product Engineering, Test Engineering and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production activities within Manufacturing, ensuring seamless transition from design to high-volume production. The role partners closely with design, quality, and external partners to deliver high-quality, reliable products while optimizing test coverage, yield, and cost.

Key Responsibilities


Strategic Product Leadership

  • Define and drive enterprise-level product and test strategies aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and operational goals.
  • Lead NPI readiness and manufacturing ramp strategies to ensure successful product launches.
  • Partner with executive leadership to identify test risks and opportunities that impact business performance.

Test Product Engineering & Validation

  • Lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test strategies, including functional, parametric, environmental, and reliability testing.
  • Lead product engineering activities supporting manufacturing, including generating test requirement documents, engineering change implementation, driving root cause analysis and resolution of product related issues in production and field.
  • Optimize test coverage, cycle time, and cost while maintaining product quality and compliance.
  • Oversee test equipment design, validation, calibration, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement advanced test technologies, automation, and data analytics to improve efficiency and insight.
  • Establish KPIs to test performance monitoring, efficiency and manufacturing readiness.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Partner with design to ensure smooth product transfers from development to manufacturing.
  • Establish robust validation processes and pilot builds.
  • Drive readiness reviews, risk assessments, and launch performance tracking.

Manufacturing & Operational Excellence

  • Lead test initiatives across manufacturing operations to improve process capability, yield, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify and eliminate production inefficiencies and test bottlenecks
  • Establish test requirements and validation strategies for new manufacturing processes and technologies.
  • Provide technical leadership during critical manufacturing escalations and quality containment events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations to ensure alignment on product requirements and execution.
  • Support supplier selection and qualification for test equipment and capabilities.
  • Act as a key liaison between engineering and manufacturing teams globally.

Complex Problem Solving & Risk Management

  • Lead investigation and resolution of high-impact quality issues affecting manufacturing, suppliers, customers, or field performance.
  • Utilize advanced statistical analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies, and risk assessment techniques to identify root causes and drive sustainable corrective actions.
  • Establish escalation frameworks and risk mitigation strategies for critical quality events.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Serve as a mentor and coach for Product Engineers and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Lead development of test engineering standards, methodologies, and training programs.
  • Influence organizational culture through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, product engineering or test engineering roles.
  • Significant experience within electronics, hardware, semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or complex supply chain environments.
  • Proven track record of supporting high volume manufacturing and complex product portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale test initiatives and cross-functional programs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline required. Master's degree preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of product lifecycle management (PLM), configuration control, and engineering change processes.
  • Strong expertise in manufacturing test methodologies, test system design, and validation processes.
  • Experience with DFM, DFT, DFR, and reliability engineering principles.
  • Familiarity with automation, data acquisition systems, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
  • Background in test automation, software-driven testing, and data analytics platforms.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation abilities.
  • Ability to manage complex programs and competing priorities.
  • Track record of successful product launches and manufacturing scale-ups.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and adaptability.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Combination of office, lab, and manufacturing environments.
  • Travel required (~25%) depending on product lifecycle and location

title: C Lineman - Overhead (Blue Ridge Co-op)
description:
Position Summary

The Class C Lineman is an entry level line work position to construct and repair electrical overhead distribution systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized overhead distribution systems while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead power lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights, in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of overhead line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines, including troubleshooting and fault locating.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Two (2) years of relevant field experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

title: Product Development Coordinator
description:
Location: On-Site — Santa Ana, CA (this is not a hybrid or remote role)
Compensation: $55,000 – $72,000

About Us

eJam is a bootstrapped consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands — all without ever taking a dollar of outside capital. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly — taken products from zero to eight figures, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small team, no bureaucracy, massive ownership.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine — sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail — all under one roof. If you want to learn how consumer products actually get built and shipped at scale, there is no faster education than this.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Development Coordinator to drive new product development across our portfolio. This is a hands-on role at the center of our product pipeline — you'll research new SKU opportunities, evaluate categories and competitive landscapes, coordinate with manufacturers (including overseas), manage packaging development with our design team, and present progress to leadership weekly.

You'll be the person who takes a product from idea through production-ready — owning the research, vendor coordination, sample management, design approvals, and timeline tracking that make it happen. You'll work directly with the CEO and cross-functionally across multiple brands from day one.

Mandarin (Chinese) fluency is a strong plus, as you will communicate with overseas manufacturers and suppliers in China and our Shanghai office on a regular basis.

What You'll Do Everyday

Research New Product Opportunities

  • Use tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, and similar platforms to identify high-potential SKUs and category opportunities across Amazon, DTC, and retail
  • Conduct competitive research — pricing, features, positioning, packaging, reviews, and gaps in the market
  • Compile category analyses and present findings to leadership with clear recommendations
  • Maintain organized files of benchmarks, specs, market data, and reference materials

Manage the Product Development Pipeline

  • Own the product pipeline in ClickUp — Kanban boards, project lists, status updates, and timelines across all active SKUs
  • Track all active development projects and keep deliverables on schedule
  • Surface blockers early, flag slippage before it becomes a fire, and keep cross-functional teams aligned
  • Own the accuracy of project documentation — if it’s in the system, it’s correct and current

Coordinate with Manufacturers & Vendors

  • Communicate directly with manufacturers in China on pricing, samples, specs, timelines, and production issues
  • Manage the RFQ process: solicit quotes, organize vendor responses, maintain comparison documents
  • Coordinate sample shipments, evaluate quality, and manage the feedback loop with manufacturers
  • Track compliance documentation and product testing requirements
  • Maintain vendor communication logs and track progress across SKUs

Drive Packaging & Design

  • Work with the design team on packaging concepts, dielines, and creative assets
  • Manage the design approval process — route concepts through stakeholders, collect feedback, push to final approval
  • Coordinate with printers and packaging vendors on specs, proofs, and production timelines

Present to Leadership Weekly

  • Prepare and deliver a weekly product development presentation to management
  • Make sure decision-makers have what they need to make calls — not scrambling for data in the room
  • Cover project status, milestones hit, blockers, timeline changes, and key decisions needed
  • Distribute meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups — everyone knows what they owe and when

Be the Communication Hub

  • Coordinate with designers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams to keep every deliverable on track
  • Work with external partners on samples, proofs, timelines, and production schedules
  • Follow up relentlessly — you are the person who makes sure things get done

Requirements

YOU'RE A FIT IF

  • You have 2–4 years of experience in product development, sourcing, or product coordination in consumer products, CPG, eCommerce, or DTC
  • You’ve worked with overseas manufacturers — ideally in China — and understand the sourcing and production workflow
  • You’re experienced with Amazon product research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar)
  • You’ve used project management tools daily — ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, or similar
  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person — no one has to chase you for updates
  • You’ve coordinated across multiple teams or departments (sourcing, design, marketing, external vendors)
  • You have high attention to detail — a messy project board or an incorrect spec keeps you up at night
  • You’re comfortable presenting to leadership and holding the room accountable on timelines

BONUS POINTS (NOT REQUIRED)

  • Experience with packaging development — dielines, print specs, materials, and vendor coordination
  • Familiarity with compliance or regulatory documentation (FDA, FTC, EPA, etc.)
  • Knowledge of PIM systems or product information management
  • Previous experience at a brand incubator, Amazon aggregator, or multi-brand portfolio company
  • Experience with retail buyer requirements and retail-ready packaging
  • Mandarin (Chinese) fluency

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

  • You want to own the product roadmap or lead product strategy — this role executes the roadmap, it doesn’t set it
  • You’re looking for a remote or hybrid position — this is fully on-site in Santa Ana, CA
  • You’re coming from software product management and expect to write user stories or run sprints — this is physical product development
  • You’d rather be “thinking big” than managing details — this role IS the details

WHAT YOU’LL GET

  • Full product lifecycle. Real exposure to how CPG products get built.
  • CEO access. Direct access to the CEO. No layers, no politics. You’ll learn how product decisions get made at the top.
  • Growth path. As eJam scales, this role scales. Clear path into product development leadership.
  • $55,000–$72,000 base salary. Range based on experience.

Benefits

  • Health, Dental & Vision
  • 401k Plan
  • Amazing, Pet-Friendly Office Environment
  • Doordash Friday Lunches

title: Principal Software Engineer (IoT)
description:
As a Principal Software Engineer (IoT), you will be a key player in designing, developing, and maintaining software systems related to electronic devices and hardware. Your expertise will bridge the gap between software and hardware, ensuring seamless integration and optimal performance.

This position will serve Rheem North America Division, located in Indianapolis, IN (Hybrid). This role follows our hybrid work arrangement, with team members working in the office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays. Relocation assistance is available.

  • Work with systems engineering, product engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and others to capture electronic controls requirements for specific water heating applications.
  • Work collaboratively with Lead Software and Systems Architecture Engineer to develop and extend software architecture and design for software applications.
  • Develop software and associated documentation for embedded applications, following team design conventions.
  • Provide a comprehensive self-review and test of the software.
  • Work with hardware, systems, R&D, product, and validation engineers to support the validation of the software in the product application, with a focus on identifying and resolving any software, hardware, or system anomalies.
  • Work with manufacturing and service on the implementation and validation of software features to support construction and field support.
  • Support the development of tools for PC, handheld, and other devices that could be used for development, testing, manufacturing, service, and/or other applications.
  • Work with cross-functional teams through direct interactions and team meetings in developing and translating new concepts into applications.
  • Develop performance and qualification test methods, coordinate the implementation of experiments, and evaluate test results.
  • Lead and participate in formal design reviews of electronic controls requirements, schematics, layouts, and software, as well as FMEA, DFM, DFT, and other related analyses.
  • Prepare and support the review and release of formal requirements, design, and qualification documentation.
  • Continue to develop professionally. Represent the company as requested in technical societies and keep the company advised of pertinent developments, new concepts, and opportunities.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience developing production embedded software for microprocessor-based controls in C/C++ and assembly.
  • Strong experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including:
  • Requirements elicitation and decomposition (system → software)
  • Architecture and design
  • Implementation and code reviews
  • Verification, validation, and qualification
  • Launch support (manufacturing, field readiness)
  • Sustaining engineering, defect resolution, and field issue support
  • Proven experience developing real-time, multi-threaded embedded systems.
  • Expertise with embedded peripherals and interfaces such as SPI, QSPI, UART, RS485, and Ethernet.
  • Experience with secure embedded platforms, including secure boot chains, image authentication, anti-rollback protection, and secure key handling.
  • Experience supporting firmware update mechanisms (including OTA or field update strategies) across development, launch, and sustaining phases.
  • Experience working closely with cross-functional teams including systems engineering, hardware, product, manufacturing, validation, and service.
  • Strong debugging and failure analysis skills using hardware/software tools (emulators, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, test instrumentation).
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and hardware documentation.
  • Experience producing clear software design, requirements, and test documentation to support development and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Experience participating in or leading design reviews, FMEA, DFM/DFT, and technical reviews.
  • Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

HOW TO STAND OUT

  • Experience with connectivity technologies and protocols, including:
  • Wireless: BLE, Wi-Fi, Thread, Matter, Amazon Sidewalk
  • Wired/Protocols: BACnet, Modbus, TCP/IP
  • Experience with security features such as Secure Boot, X.509 certificates, TLS, and encrypted file systems.
  • Experience implementing OTA over wireless or cloud-connected systems.
  • Experience with model-based development tools (MATLAB, LabVIEW).
  • Familiarity with statistical methods or Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Experience supporting connected or IoT-enabled products in consumer or industrial environments.

At Rheem, how you achieve results is as important as the results you achieve. While LEADING OTHERS, you will be expected to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:

title: Broadcast Channels Operator Team Leader
description:
Broadcast Channels Operator Team Leader

Auckland | On-site | Full time | Competitive pay & great perks

Lead a specialist broadcast operations team across Ladbrokes, neds and Trackside.

Why This Matters

At Entain, you’ll join a global sports betting, gaming and entertainment business behind well-known brands such as Ladbrokes and neds in Australia, and TAB, betcha, Trackside and Sport Nation in New Zealand. We’re an ambitious, customer-focused organisation where our talented people move fast, think boldly and create experiences that excite millions of customers.

This role sits at the centre of our broadcast operation, supporting the delivery of timely, accurate and engaging broadcast output within a 24/7 operation. You’ll lead a team of nine Broadcast Channels Operators while remaining hands-on in the daily coordination and operation of our channels.

From managing rosters and supporting team development to responding to live broadcast issues, you’ll help maintain the quality, consistency and reliability of our on-air product. It’s a role for a calm, practical and customer-focused leader who cares about getting the details right, supporting their team and keeping things running smoothly when the pressure is on.

Your Impact

As our BCO Team Leader, you’ll lead a specialist team and play a hands-on role in delivering high-quality broadcasts across Ladbrokes, neds and Trackside. You’ll strengthen team capability, improve operational consistency and help ensure reliable broadcast delivery across every shift.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of nine Broadcast Channels Operators, building capability, confidence and accountability
  • Coordinate and participate in the operation of Ladbrokes, neds and Trackside broadcast channels
  • Create fair and effective rosters that support 24/7 coverage, sustainable working practices and legally compliant breaks
  • Work closely with Production, Directors, Scheduling, Master Control, external providers and other stakeholders to deliver seamless, accurate and reliable broadcasts

This is an Auckland-based, on-site role working an 80-hour fortnight. As our channels operate 24 hours a day, seven days a week, rostered shifts will include a combination of days, overnights, weekends and public holidays.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in a formal people-leadership role, including developing team capability and managing performance in a fast-paced operational environment
  • Relevant experience in live broadcasting, broadcast channel operations or a similar control room environment
  • Strong knowledge of broadcast workflows, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on timing, accuracy and presentation quality
  • Experience preparing and managing team rosters, shift coverage or leave arrangements
  • Experience developing and delivering training, procedures or operational documentation
  • A calm and collaborative approach, with the confidence to make timely decisions, provide clear feedback and hold people accountable when required

Nice to Have

These are a bonus, so if you don’t have them all, we’d still like to hear from you.

  • Experience rostering or managing coverage in a 24/7 or continuously operating environment
  • Knowledge of racing, sports broadcasting or wagering-related content
  • Experience using AI or other tools to improve workflows, training resources or operational documentation

What You’ll Gain

  • Impact: Help deliver the broadcast experience customers rely on across Ladbrokes, neds and Trackside
  • Leadership: Lead a specialist team while building your experience across coaching, performance, capability and workforce planning
  • Growth: Develop deeper expertise in live broadcast operations, quality assurance, reporting and continuous improvement
  • Exposure: Work closely with Production, Directors, Master Control, Scheduling, Betting, Marketing and external broadcast partners
  • People: Join a connected, hands-on team where shared standards, support and accountability drive performance
  • Perks: Enjoy competitive pay, retailer discounts, wellbeing support, personal days off, free breakfast and snacks, and a modern office with pool tables and sport on the TVs

There’s nothing like it.

Your Next Move

Apply now or contact careers@entaingroup.com.au if you’d like more information.

Once you’ve applied, our Talent team will assess your application and keep you updated. If your application progresses, next steps may include a Talent team conversation, hiring team interviews or a role-related task. This gives us the chance to get to know each other, talk through the role and answer your questions.

We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.

Powered by next-generation technology and a vertically integrated supply chain, Veho gives brands and their customers unprecedented control over their deliveries and removes the pain from the ecommerce post-purchase experience. We make delivery the ‘extension of the brand’ and leverage it to create deeper loyalty and trust between brands and their customers, driving customer retention and lifetime value. Our rapidly growing client list includes leading consumer brands like Hello Fresh, Zara, Macy’s, Sephora, and more.

To truly build an iconic company, we strongly believe that our people and values must be aligned with our mission. As such, we take pride in our championship team, merit-based culture. $22.50 per hour

As a Ground Operations Lead at Veho, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth operation of our logistics activities. You will be at the forefront of daily interactions with cross-functional teams, orchestrating efforts to maintain safety standards while achieving operational excellence. Your leadership will be crucial in guiding a shared shift to guarantee successful launches and sorts, in collaboration with both the Veho team and our valued driver partners.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment that demands quick thinking and physical agility, embracing the challenge of physically tasking work with enthusiasm and resilience.

  • Quickly navigate technology platforms to manage operational changes, re-routes, and other logistical challenges with ease and efficiency.

  • Assess operational needs swiftly and work cross-functionally to orchestrate seamless operations, prioritizing safety, and driving success.

  • Operate a forklift and potentially a box truck with skill and precision, ensuring the safe and efficient movement of goods and materials as needed.

Veho is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. No matter the location, or the role, every Veho teammate shares one galvanizing mission: driving commerce forward with a customer-centric delivery experience that's built for the modern era. We live by our leadership principles. We're looking for team members who are: obsessed over the customer, first-principles thinkers, builders at heart, intrinsically driven to win, and owners biased toward action.

Join us in building the future of ecommerce logistics and in doing the work of our lifetime!

title: Supply Chain Snr Director - Power & Interconnect Sourcing
description:
Oracle is seeking an experienced Supply Chain Senior Director to lead strategic sourcing across critical Power and Interconnect categories supporting our infrastructure platforms.

This senior leadership role will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies that ensure the timely, cost-effective availability of production materials while supporting requirements across cost, capacity, inventory, quality, and supply continuity. The position will lead strategic supplier selection, negotiations, business awards, supplier development, and performance management across power systems, printed circuit boards (PCBs), cabling, and interconnect technologies.

The Supply Chain Senior Director will lead a team of Sourcing Managers, provide broader leadership across related mechanical sourcing activities, and work closely with Engineering, Finance, Planning, Quality, and other organizations to support new platforms and scalable infrastructure growth. This role requires strong functional expertise, commercial judgment, executive influence, and demonstrated leadership and people management skills.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic sourcing strategies across Power categories, including power supply units (PSUs), PowerShelf, power distribution units (PDUs), and power converters, as well as Interconnect categories including PCBs and cabling.
  • Lead supplier assessment, selection, negotiations, business awards, supplier development, and ongoing supplier performance management.
  • Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships that support competitive commercial outcomes, capacity requirements, quality, and continuity of supply.
  • Partner across Engineering, Finance, Planning, Quality, and other organizations to align sourcing and supplier decisions with business and infrastructure requirements.
  • Ensure the timely and cost-effective availability of production materials while maintaining appropriate inventory levels.
  • Develop and implement sourcing policies, procedures, material controls, and scalable solutions that reduce costs and streamline execution.
  • Coordinate global sourcing and procurement activities and engage internal and external stakeholders on complex commercial, supply, and supplier matters.
  • Lead, develop, and evaluate Sourcing Managers while creating an organization capable of effectively executing across multiple strategic categories.
  • Provide broader leadership across related mechanical sourcing activities.
  • Interact with internal and external executive management and lead negotiations on difficult and complex matters.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, or a related function, with demonstrated leadership of complex sourcing categories.
  • Strong category, product, and supplier-market knowledge within Power, Interconnect, or related hardware technologies.
  • Experience with supplier selection, supplier relationship management, contracting, commercial negotiations, supplier development, and performance management.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop sourcing strategies that balance cost, capacity, quality, inventory, and continuity of supply.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience navigating complex supplier and business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across technical, operational, and financial organizations and influence senior and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated leadership and people management skills, including experience leading and developing sourcing or supply chain teams.
  • Functional expertise and broad business knowledge with the ability to translate business and technology requirements into sourcing strategies.

title: Revenue Strategy & Operations, Sr. Analyst
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Baseten is building the infrastructure layer for AI — and we're now building the team that will scale how we take it to market. This is a foundational hire on our GTM Strategy & Revenue Operations team, sitting at the intersection of strategic planning and field execution.

You'll work directly with the CRO, Head of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Finance, field leadership, and our Central Ops team. On any given week, you might be refining our pipeline generation model, building a territory coverage analysis, designing a new GTM motion, or partnering with a regional leader to understand what's driving a trend in their pipeline. This role requires someone who can think rigorously, build things from scratch, and operate with speed and judgment in an environment where the playbook is still being written.

This is a rare opportunity to be an early GTM strategy and operations hire at one of the fastest-growing companies in AI infrastructure — and to help define how we scale.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

GTM Planning, Target Setting & Market Intelligence

  • Contribute to the annual and quarterly GTM planning process in partnership with Finance, including headcount modeling, ramp assumptions, and revenue target-setting

  • Build and maintain coverage models aligned to 2-year growth projections, incorporating territory design, account segmentation, and capacity planning

  • Support quota framework development, helping translate top-down targets into field-level plans that are credible and motivating

  • Develop and maintain Baseten's segmentation logic: how we carve the market by industry, company profile, consumption potential, and AI maturity

  • Contribute a point of view on competitive dynamics, regional expansion priorities, and whitespace opportunities

  • Partner with Central Ops on ICP and TAM database strategy to ensure segmentation is grounded in clean, enriched data

  • Translate data into a clear business narrative for leadership and the field; democratize insights so the revenue org can self-serve

Pipeline Generation & Forecast

  • Contribute to the design of the pipeline generation model: coverage ratios, qualified pipeline definitions, and input assumptions

  • Support the PG cadence: track actuals vs. model, surface gaps early, and partner with field leadership to course-correct

  • Play an active role in the weekly forecast process, helping build the business narrative that connects leading indicators to revenue outcomes

  • Build and maintain the analytics layer that powers GTM decision-making, from pipeline dashboards to cohort analyses to efficiency metrics

Field Execution & Plan Refinement

  • Partner with the field to identify gaps in the business and develop structured plans to address them, supporting real-time actions as well as insights to guide QBRs, pipeline reviews, etc.

  • Analyze regional pipeline health, win/loss trends, and rep productivity to proactively surface insights that feed back into refining the GTM plan

  • Contribute to execution optimization projects: improving the sales process, post-sale journey, and conversion at key funnel stages

  • Close the loop between what's happening in the field and what needs to change in the plan

New Motions & Experimentation

  • Support the design and execution of structured experiments to test new GTM approaches: new segments, new channels, new acquisition or expansion motions

  • Help build the measurement framework to evaluate what's working and create a clear path to scaling what wins

  • Partner with RevOps and Central Ops to operationalize successful experiments into repeatable playbooks

REQUIREMENTS

Experience

  • 3-5 years in GTM strategy, revenue operations, sales strategy, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS or infrastructure company

  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-based business models strongly preferred; you understand the difference between ARR and revenue, and how to think about drawdown, expansion, and net retention

  • Exposure to a company scaling through a Series B-D inflection point a plus; you have a sense of what good looks like and what breaks as you grow

  • Background in consulting and/or banking / finance a plus

Skills

  • Exceptional analytical chops: you can build a coverage model, a cohort analysis, and a leadership-ready forecast narrative, and you know which one the moment calls for

  • Strong business judgment: you don't just surface data, you tell people what it means and what to do about it

  • Structured thinker and clear communicator: you can take a complex GTM problem, break it down, and present a crisp recommendation to a senior audience

  • Hands-on builder: comfortable working in AI coding tools, spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL, and CRM systems; you don't wait for someone else to pull the data

  • Collaborative operating style: you work across functions (Finance, field leadership, Central Ops, Enablement) and know how to get things done without formal authority

  • AI Fluency: you actively use AI tools to drive your own productivity, in how you analyze data, structure problems, draft communications, and accelerate your work

Mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity; you can define the problem before solving it

  • Bias toward action — you'd rather ship something good and iterate than wait for perfect

  • Curious about the AI infrastructure market; you want to understand what we sell, who buys it, and why

WHY BASETEN:

  • Be a foundational member of the GTM team at one of the most important companies in the AI infrastructure space

  • Work on problems that are genuinely hard and genuinely new — consumption-based GTM at AI scale doesn't have an existing playbook

  • High ownership, high visibility, direct access to leadership

  • Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits

BENEFITS

  • Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity.

  • 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

  • Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

  • Company-facilitated 401(k)

  • Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

title: Director, Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Engineering Hub Team. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA

In this role, you'll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead a portfolio of FDE engagements across business and platform domains; set priorities, allocate engineering capacity, and ensure engagements are scoped to deliver measurable value within time-boxed windows.
  • Serve as the senior technical voice in discovery with executive sponsors and business leaders; translate ambiguous, high-stakes opportunities into feasible, production-ready delivery plans.
  • Own and evolve the FDE playbook: define discovery-to-production standards, engagement entry and exit criteria, handoff protocols, and working norms that govern how the team operates.
  • Drive the reuse-first mandate across the FDE team: establish patterns for when to build, extend, or standardize; ensure field learnings are converted into firm-wide reference architectures and platform contributions.
  • Set quality and governance standards for the FDE function: secure-by-default practices, observability, testability, and operational readiness expectations applied consistently across all engagements.
  • Define the institutionalization model for forward deployment: ensure every engagement ends with a clear handoff, documented ownership, and a capable owning team — not a dependency on FDE.
  • Represent the FDE function to architecture, control, security, compliance, and senior technology leadership; shape firm-wide AI and platform strategy based on production delivery evidence.
  • Identify capability gaps and platform investment opportunities surfaced through FDE field work; translate these into actionable recommendations for platform and engineering leadership.
  • Build and grow the FDE team: recruit, develop, and retain senior engineers; set a high technical bar and a culture of disciplined, evidence-backed delivery.
  • Stay at the frontier of AI, platform engineering, and regulated delivery practices; bring that knowledge back into the function and the broader technology organization.

To be successful in this role, we're seeking the following:

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required; advanced degree is beneficial.
  • 14+ years of software development and technical leadership experience, including direct accountability for production systems and cross-functional delivery programs; experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.
  • Strong foundational understanding of modern AI and agentic application patterns, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and agent-based system design.
  • Hands-on experience building backend services, APIs, and production systems.
  • Experience working across architecture, data, and platform concerns rather than only within a narrow layer.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of building or scaling a delivery capability (e.g., solutions engineering, forward deployment, platform engineering) within a large enterprise or regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering AI, data, or workflow-heavy solutions at scale in regulated environments, with accountability for production outcomes.
  • Strong systems-thinking and architecture judgment across services, data, and infrastructure; able to evaluate and influence technology choices at a divisional level.
  • Experience defining and operating delivery standards, playbooks, or center-of-excellence functions.
  • Experience balancing speed with governance, security, and operational rigor across a team or portfolio.
  • Deep familiarity with reusable platform patterns, internal developer platforms, and productized infrastructure.

Technical Skills

  • Strong software engineering skills in one or more of: Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python.
  • Experience with APIs, service integration, and secure-by-default engineering practices.
  • Ability to work across data, AI, workflow, and platform layers as needed.
  • Comfort using modern AI tooling pragmatically without confusing prototypes for production systems.
  • Familiarity with application frameworks and containerization.

Non-Technical Skills

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to advise and influence senior business and technology executives.
  • Strong strategic and product judgment: knows which opportunities are worth pursuing and which are not.
  • Proven ability to lead across matrixed organizations and build alignment without formal authority.
  • Structured tradeoff thinking at portfolio scale, balancing risk, speed, and long-term platform health.
  • Bias toward action with disciplined follow-through and strong artifact discipline.

People Leadership

  • Leads, grows, and retains a team of senior engineers; sets technical standards and delivery culture for the FDE function.
  • Develops talent pipelines and mentors engineers toward greater technical and delivery autonomy.
  • Influences technology implementation and forward-deployed delivery standards across large IT divisions.

More and Tangerine are fast-growing Australian-owned telecommunications brands delivering high-quality NBN, mobile, voice, and business connectivity solutions to customers across Australia. Our mission is simple: to make connectivity easy to understand, so customers can spend more time enjoying their services and less time navigating the complexities of telco.

Guided by our values of Start with the Customer, Simplicity for Speed, Community of Individuals, and Collaborate to Win, we’re building a culture where people can contribute new ideas, make a meaningful impact, and help shape the future of telecommunications in Australia.

About the opportunity:

You’ll be part of the PMO team responsible for establishing delivery governance, ensuring projects are executed consistently, and providing visibility and control across the project portfolio. The PMO acts as the bridge between strategy and delivery, helping the organisation successfully implement business, technology, compliance, and operational change initiatives.

Reporting to the Head of PMO, we are seeking a Project Manager who is passionate about delivering complex compliance projects and managing multiple workstreams in a fast-paced Telco environment. Working closely with Business Analysts, stakeholders and other Project Managers, you will lead project planning, governance and delivery, ensuring projects remain on track, risks are managed effectively and outcomes are successfully achieved.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Lead, direct, and oversee activities to manage and implement various compliance and IT projects, from ideation through final operational stage, to business benefit realisation and a business-as-usual state.
  • Plan, schedule, monitor and report on project activities, milestones and deliverables to ensure successful delivery across multiple workstreams.
  • Take full responsibility for the definition, documentation and successful delivery of projects, managing business impacts, dependencies and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Facilitate project kick-offs, weekly project status meetings and fortnightly governance meetings, presenting progress, risks, issues and decision points to support successful project delivery.
  • Initiate, develop and maintain strong and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, driving outcomes through collaboration and influence.
  • Perform risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies, proactively managing risks, issues and dependencies throughout project delivery.
  • Ensure realistic project, quality and change control plans are maintained, providing regular and accurate status reporting to stakeholders and governance forums.
  • Ensure project objectives are achieved and business outcomes realised, while supporting and embedding project governance and delivery methodologies across the organisation

About you:

We don’t expect you to tick every box, but we’re looking for someone with strong analytical capability, commercial curiosity, and the confidence to work through complex issues from start to finish:

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Project Manager
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall and Hybrid delivery environments
  • Proven experience creating and maintaining business cases, benefits tracking, reporting and executive-level status updates
  • Working knowledge of delivery disciplines including requirements gathering, solution design, solution delivery, release and change management
  • Demonstrated experience delivering both business and technology projects of varying size and complexity
  • Previous experience in the telecommunications industry is advantageous

Key focus areas in your first few months:

  • Take ownership of a portfolio and translating regulatory requirements into clear delivery plans and outcomes.
  • Build strong relationships across cross functional teams to drive alignment, accountability and delivery.
  • Drive delivery of system, process and customer experience enhancements, balancing regulatory deadlines with business priorities.
  • Establish effective governance, reporting and risk management practices to provide visibility, control and delivery confidence.
  • Oversee business readiness activities, including training, communications and change management, to support successful adoption.
  • Ensure solutions are audit-ready, with appropriate controls, evidence and compliance reporting in place.
  • Proactively manage dependencies across internal teams, vendors, industry partners and regulators to keep delivery on track.

What we offer:

  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements that support work-life balance, wellbeing, and collaboration.
  • 14 weeks paid parental leave as per the parental policy.
  • Free internet and mobile plan.
  • An additional day of paid leave to celebrate your birthday, plus a gift voucher.
  • Free access to confidential counselling and 24/7 wellbeing support through our EAP.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
  • Supportive leaders and teams that value initiative, accountability, and success.

What’s Next?

We’re committed to providing a positive and transparent candidate experience. Our recruitment process includes

  • Phone Screen: An initial conversation with our Talent Specialist to learn more about your experience, career goals and interest in the role.
  • 1st Interview: A discussion with the hiring team to learn more about your experience, skills and approach to work.
  • 2nd Interview: A conversation with key stakeholders to explore your experience further and discuss your working style and overall fit for the role.

Our People & Culture

Our people are at the heart of our success. As we continue to grow, we’re building a collaborative workplace where people feel valued, supported, and encouraged to share new ideas. Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of telecommunications while helping Australians stay connected.

Inclusion & Accessibility

Everyone’s different, and that’s something we value at More. We believe diversity of thought helps us build stronger teams and deliver better experiences for our customers. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and assess candidates based on their skills, capabilities and potential. We’re committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience and providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace. If there’s anything we can do to support you, please let us know as part of your application.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
About the Role

Our client, a top IT consultancy, is partnering with a leading financial services organisation, to build a dedicated Generative AI hub in Valencia. This new unit will serve as the engine for organisation's AI-driven transformation, designing and delivering intelligent solutions that modernise financial processes, automate decision-making, and unlock new value across the organisation.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to be one of the founding engineers of this hub. You will help define the technical foundations of an Agentic AI platform built on Azure, contributing from day one to architecture decisions, infrastructure setup, and the delivery of production-grade AI-powered services for the financial sector.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build the backend services and APIs that power the organisation's Generative AI platform, using Node.js or .NET 8 (ASP.NET Core / EF Core)
  • Implement data ingestion, chunking, cleaning and quality checks pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Azure Document Intelligence
  • Build and maintain vector indexing and semantic search capabilities via Azure Cognitive Search and LightRAG
  • Develop embedding generation pipelines using Azure OpenAI
  • Design and manage multi-layer data storage: Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB (agent memory), Azure Blob Storage
  • Build and integrate agent tooling using Langchain, Langgraph, FastAPI, A2A, AG-UI and MCP
  • Implement the AIDA orchestration and coordination layer using Mastra (Multi-Agentic Orchestrator)
  • Ensure platform observability and alerting via Azure Monitor and Azure Log Analytics
  • Implement evaluation pipelines for LLM outputs using Azure ML
  • Apply guardrails and output validation using Azure OpenAI and Azure Machine Learning
  • Implement authentication and RBAC using Azure Active Directory
  • Manage secrets and configuration securely via Azure Key Vault
  • Contribute to the technical culture of the hub: code reviews, documentation, architecture decisions, and engineering best practices


Technology Stack

Backend Core

  • Node.js or.NET 8 (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
  • RESTful API design ·Event-driven architectures


Azure Data & AI Services

  • Azure Data Factory — ingestion, chunking, cleaning, DQ checks
  • Azure Document Intelligence — document parsing and understanding
  • Azure Cognitive Search — vector indexing and semantic search
  • Azure OpenAI — LLM access, embedding generation, guardrails and output validation
  • Azure Machine Learning — model evaluation and ML guardrails
  • LightRAG — retrieval engine for RAG pipelines


Storage & Databases

  • Azure SQL ·PostgreSQL — relational data and metadata storage
  • Azure Cosmos DB — short-term and long-term agent memory
  • Azure Blob Storage — file and document storage


Agent Infrastructure

  • Langchain & Langgraph — agent orchestration and chaining
  • FastAPI — lightweight API layer for agent tooling
  • A2A, AG-UI, MCP — agent-to-agent communication and UI protocols
  • Mastra — Multi-Agentic Orchestrator (non-Azure, self-hosted)


Platform & DevOps

  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) — agent runtime hosting
  • Azure Active Directory — authentication & RBAC
  • Azure Key Vault — secrets and keys management
  • Azure Monitor · Azure Log Analytics — observability
  • Azure App Service · Azure Static Web Apps — UI/UX deployment


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of backend development experience in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js OR .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core (or both)
  • Solid hands-on experience with Azure cloud services: ADF, Cognitive Search, OpenAI, SQL, Cosmos DB
  • Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices in regulated or high-availability environments
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings and RAG-based architectures
  • Understanding of Agentic AI patterns: multi-agent systems, tool use, orchestration, memory layers
  • Experience with containerisation (Docker / Kubernetes / AKS)
  • Proficiency in SQL (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Strong understanding of security best practices: authentication, RBAC, secrets management
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices on Azure
  • Ability to work autonomously in a greenfield, fast-paced environment
  • Fluent English — working language for all technical documentation and ceremonies
  • Location - preferably Valencia, but open to other locations with availability to travel occasionally to Valencia; remote in that case.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python / FastAPI for agent tooling layers
  • Knowledge of Langchain, Langgraph or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A or AG-UI protocols
  • Prior experience in a hub or centre-of-excellence environment
  • Background in financial services, banking or fintech
  • GitHub certification
  • Spanish language skills


Why Join This Team

  • Founding engineer role — shape the architecture and culture of a brand-new GenAI hub from day one
  • Work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI applied to real financial services use cases
  • Backed by the organisation's global engineering community, tooling and career development programmes
  • Valencia-based hub with a collaborative, senior-weighted team
  • Direct exposure to the company's transformation agenda and senior stakeholders

Job Title: Quality Inspector - Level 2

Job Summary
This role involves operating CMMs, gear analyzers, and other measurement equipment to conduct in-process inspections and First-off approvals. Ensure all products meet strict company and customer specifications while maintaining accurate inspection records. Success in this fast-paced environment requires strong collaboration with internal departments to uphold and enhance quality standards.

Responsibility
  • Conduct inspections of parts using appropriate gauging or measuring equipment to ensure product aligns with customer standards through various process, including:
  • First off inspections: Inspect part specifications and authorize full production.
  • Receiving Inspections: Assess incoming material based on product specifications to ensure required standards.
  • In process Inspections: Monitor and inspect parts during production process to ensure ongoing compliance with quality standards.
  • Product Audits: Conduct full dimensional layout of part by measuring all part features to ensure compliance with drawing specifications.
  • Final release inspections: Evaluate parts and authorize shipment of parts to the customer.
  • Capability Studies: Use data from samples to predict the ability of process to produce parts conforming to customer specifications.
  • Operate CMM and special purpose gauges (i.e. Gear Analyzer, Vision System Scanner etc.) with basic understanding of programming.
  • Apply IATF standards for handling non-conforming material, including identification and inspection procedures.

title: Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics
description:
The University of Tennessee Foundation, Inc (UTFI) invites applications and nominations to fill the position of Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics for the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. Reporting to the Chief Advancement Information Officer, the Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics is responsible for leading a team responsible for transforming advancement data into actionable insights that drive strategy, performance, and philanthropic growth.

Strategic Leadership and Data Governance: Develops and executes UTK Advancement's data and analytics strategy, aligning it with the division's fundraising and engagement goals. Partners with Central Services and campus leadership to define reporting priorities while championing a culture of data trust and stewardship. Oversees the integrity, quality, and governance of advancement data, collaborating with UTFI's BI team to maintain consistent standards and practices. Ensures compliance with institutional, legal, and privacy requirements, and builds secure, role-based data access frameworks for internal and campus stakeholders.

Team and Operational Leadership: Leads the UTK Advancement BI team, providing strategic and operational direction across reporting, data science, and data architecture. Elevates the team's use of data visualizations to make insights more accessible and actionable. Fosters professional growth through mentoring, training, and leadership development opportunities for team members. Defines and tracks performance metrics that measure both program effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Analytics Innovation and Executive Collaboration: Leads the development of dashboards, predictive models, and analytic tools that deliver forward-looking insights into donor behavior and campaign performance. Drives the integration of advanced analytics, AI, and data visualization to fuel continuous improvement and innovation. Modernizes data architecture and collaborates with campus teams and vendors to expand analytics capabilities division-wide. Delivers high-impact data insights for donor stewardship, campaign planning, and strategic decision-making, keeping all deliverables aligned with the division's goals.

Required Education and Experience

The candidate who fills the Executive Director of Business Intelligence and Analytics position is required to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible experience in business intelligence, analytics, or enterprise data strategy within complex organizations

  • 2 years of supervisory experience including volunteers, interns and students

  • Proven success leading teams responsible for BI development, data modeling, data warehousing, and analytics enablement

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into strategic recommendations for executive audiences

  • Skilled at building relationships and influencing stakeholders across all levels

  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate data into compelling stories that inform strategy

  • Commitment to innovation, collaboration, and the advancement of UTK's mission through data-driven excellence

Preferred Education and Experience

In addition to meeting the required qualifications, the preferred candidate will have:
