title: Field Service Engineer – Separation and Homogenisation Equipment
description:
GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Guided by a strong sense of purpose, our more than 18,000 dedicated employees work to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally.

Responsibilities / Tasks

GEA is seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Service Engineer to support servicing of our installed base of homogenisers and centrifugal separation equipment across the United Kingdom. This field-based role is responsible for delivering expert maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting, commissioning, and technical support services to customers within the dairy, food, beverage, brewing, pharmaceutical, chemical, and industrial processing sectors.

The successful candidate will be a self-sufficient engineer with strong mechanical and electrical fault-finding skills, capable of working independently at customer sites while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and customer service. To ensure effective coverage of our customer base, candidates should ideally be geographically based in the North of England.

Due to the nature of the role, extensive travel and regular overnight stays will be required. The role will also require participation in an on-call rota, covering one weekend in every eight.

Service & Maintenance

Perform preventative maintenance, inspections, and servicing of GEA homogenisers and centrifugal separation equipment.

Carry out planned maintenance contracts in accordance with GEA service procedures and customer requirements.

Conduct mechanical overhauls and rebuilds of rotating equipment, including:

  • Bowl assemblies

  • Spindles

  • Gear drives

  • Pump systems

  • Hydraulic systems

  • Homogenising valves and associated components

  • Replace worn or defective parts and ensure equipment is restored to optimal performance.

  • Produce detailed service reports documenting findings, repairs completed, and recommendations.

Fault Finding & Repairs

  • Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and process-related faults.

  • Respond to customer breakdowns and emergency service requests.

  • Analyse equipment performance issues and provide practical solutions to maximise reliability and uptime.

Customer Support

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through professional service delivery.

  • Provide technical advice and operational guidance to customers.

  • Identify opportunities for service agreements, upgrades, spare parts, and additional support services.

  • Act as a technical ambassador for GEA at customer sites.

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with GEA and customer health and safety policies.

  • Carry out risk assessments and comply with site-specific safety procedures.

  • Maintain company-issued tools, equipment, vehicles, and documentation to a professional standard.

Availability Requirements

  • Some overtime and occasional weekend work to meet customer needs.

  • Participation in regular engineering team meetings.

  • Flexibility to support changing workloads in a fast-paced environment.

Your Profile / Qualifications

  • Qualified to a minimum City & Guilds standard in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).

  • Proven experience servicing industrial processing equipment within food, beverage, dairy, pharmaceutical, or process industries

  • Strong mechanical knowledge is essential, with electrical knowledge considered a distinct advantage.

  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.

  • Solid understanding of health and safety practices within the workplace.

  • Experience servicing and upgrading high-pressure homogenisers, with typical pressure ranges from 100 to 2000 bar.

  • Ideally familiar with the dairy, food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries.

  • Ability to work carefully, methodically, and safely, both independently and as part of a team.

  • A full UK drivers licence is required for this role.

  • Must have a valid Right to Work in the UK. Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: Principal Supply Chain Product Engineer
description:
The Principal Supply Chain Product Engineer is a recognized technical leader responsible for ensuring that products are designed, validated, and manufactured with robust, scalable, and cost-effective test solutions. This role serves as a key advisor across Product Engineering, Test Engineering and New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production activities within Manufacturing, ensuring seamless transition from design to high-volume production. The role partners closely with design, quality, and external partners to deliver high-quality, reliable products while optimizing test coverage, yield, and cost.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Define and drive enterprise-level product and test strategies aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and operational goals.
  • Lead NPI readiness and manufacturing ramp strategies to ensure successful product launches.
  • Partner with executive leadership to identify test risks and opportunities that impact business performance.

Test Product Engineering & Validation

  • Lead the development and deployment of manufacturing test strategies, including functional, parametric, environmental, and reliability testing.
  • Lead product engineering activities supporting manufacturing, including generating test requirement documents, engineering change implementation, driving root cause analysis and resolution of product related issues in production and field.
  • Optimize test coverage, cycle time, and cost while maintaining product quality and compliance.
  • Oversee test equipment design, validation, calibration, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement advanced test technologies, automation, and data analytics to improve efficiency and insight.
  • Establish KPIs to test performance monitoring, efficiency and manufacturing readiness.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Partner with design to ensure smooth product transfers from development to manufacturing.
  • Establish robust validation processes and pilot builds.
  • Drive readiness reviews, risk assessments, and launch performance tracking.

Manufacturing & Operational Excellence

  • Lead test initiatives across manufacturing operations to improve process capability, yield, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify and eliminate production inefficiencies and test bottlenecks
  • Establish test requirements and validation strategies for new manufacturing processes and technologies.
  • Provide technical leadership during critical manufacturing escalations and quality containment events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations to ensure alignment on product requirements and execution.
  • Support supplier selection and qualification for test equipment and capabilities.
  • Act as a key liaison between engineering and manufacturing teams globally.

Complex Problem Solving & Risk Management

  • Lead investigation and resolution of high-impact quality issues affecting manufacturing, suppliers, customers, or field performance.
  • Utilize advanced statistical analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies, and risk assessment techniques to identify root causes and drive sustainable corrective actions.
  • Establish escalation frameworks and risk mitigation strategies for critical quality events.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Serve as a mentor and coach for Product Engineers and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Lead development of test engineering standards, methodologies, and training programs.
  • Influence organizational culture through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, product engineering or test engineering roles.
  • Significant experience within electronics, hardware, semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or complex supply chain environments.
  • Proven track record of supporting high volume manufacturing and complex product portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale test initiatives and cross-functional programs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related technical discipline required. Master's degree preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of product lifecycle management (PLM), configuration control, and engineering change processes.
  • Strong expertise in manufacturing test methodologies, test system design, and validation processes.
  • Experience with DFM, DFT, DFR, and reliability engineering principles.
  • Familiarity with automation, data acquisition systems, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
  • Background in test automation, software-driven testing, and data analytics platforms.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation abilities.
  • Ability to manage complex programs and competing priorities.
  • Track record of successful product launches and manufacturing scale-ups.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, and adaptability.

Work Environment & Travel

  • Combination of office, lab, and manufacturing environments.
  • Travel required (~25%) depending on product lifecycle and location

title: Executive Vice President - Client Services (Private Assets)
description:
About Citco

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 50 office locations worldwide. With more than $1.8 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end-to-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.

For more information about Citco, please visit

About the Team & Business Line:

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a core member of our Private Equity team, you will be working with some of the industry’s most accomplished professionals to deliver award-winning services for complex fund structures that our clients can depend upon.

Citco is seeking an accomplished Executive Vice President to lead Client Service and Fund Accounting for Private Equity clients within our growing Dallas operation. This is a strategic leadership opportunity for an experienced industry professional who can combine deep technical expertise with exceptional client relationship management and organizational leadership.

Your Role:

The successful candidate will play a key role in expanding Citco's presence in Dallas, helping shape the future of our private assets business while supporting some of the industry's most sophisticated and high-profile clients. This position offers the opportunity to influence the growth of a developing business footprint and build a team capable of delivering best-in-class service:

  • You will be responsible for client Relationship Management for some prestige Private Equity Clients.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, developing long-term partnerships and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance service and client satisfaction.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a growing team of professionals supporting private assets clients.

  • Support the successful integration and development of teams while fostering a collaborative and client-centric culture.

  • Maintain and enhance client relationships by monitoring and developing client service level agreements providing a full service/ product offering

  • Leverage existing client relationships to secure new business, offering our products and services

  • Be responsible for monitoring and owning gross margins for clients and will be measured on increase of client wallet share

  • Work closely and participate with Business Development and Senior Management teams on marketing pitches and other client presentations

  • Work in partnership with the Senior Vice Presidents and wider Citco team to oversee the resolution of complex client issues

  • Visit clients on periodic basis to evaluate service quality and identify client priorities, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with agreed KPIs, SLAs, and Fund Documents

  • Work alongside our integration team to establish plan for new client setup and transitions, and assist to develop best operating models for optimal service delivery to clients

  • Maintain a pro-active customer focus at all times

  • Enhance current servicing levels and deliver beyond client expectations

  • Coordinate with various stakeholders, including other operational and ancillary service groups to ensure client deliverables are met timely and accurately

  • Assist in the resolution of complex client issues

  • Review private equity fund client’s partnership agreements, PPMs and other materials

  • Develop and implement best practice standards and drive towards efficiencies

  • Maintain pristine compliance with local regulators and internal/external auditors

  • Establish and document business contingency plans for all areas of responsibility

  • Participate in and lead projects that may be defined from time to time in connection with the continuing expansion and evolution of the business

  • Review departmental procedures and policies and supervise Vice Presidents to ensure adherence to these procedures

  • Set challenging team goals & empower people to achieve them

  • Keep people focused on critical goals and deadlines through frequent and consistent communication

  • Motivate people by creating a high performance environment that is both challenging & exciting

  • Actively contribute to corporate initiatives as part of the management team

  • Manage and oversee staffing requirements, coordinate and oversee staffing, hiring, coaching, and development of team members

About You:

  • You have 10 – 15 years private equity experience working at a fund administrator or fund manager

  • Experience in managing client relationships and/or with the controllership function of an alternative asset manager

  • Deep technical expertise in private assets fund accounting, fund structures, and related operational processes.

  • Demonstrated success managing complex client relationships and executive-level stakeholder engagement.

  • Strong leadership skills and supervisory experience of other professionals with proven experience leading teams and developing high-performing talent.

  • Skills in negotiation, business planning and budgeting, margin analysis, rating agency relations and technical accounting

  • Knowledge of US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles and other comprehensive basis of accounting

  • Knowledge of waterfall structures, modeling and calculations desirable

  • Project management skills with attention to detail and proven ability to multi-task

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Advanced computer skills (Microsoft Excel)

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or related field

  • CPA designation a plus

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, short and long-term disability benefits, a retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, mental health and wellness support, parental leave, and more. Additional details about our total rewards package will be shared during the hiring process.

At Citco, we take pride in fostering an inclusive culture by prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation, mutual respect, and collaboration. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. If you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer, Citco adheres to making all employment and personnel decisions without discriminating based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, physical disability, mental disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national or ethnic origin, or any other protected status. We believe that an inclusive workforce not only enriches our company but also drives us towards greater success.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Our employees may perform other job-related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of our organization.

title: Kaupunginjohtaja
description:
Kotkan kaupunki julistaa haettavaksi kaupunginjohtajan seitsemän (7) vuoden määräaikaisen viran.

Haemme kaupunginjohtajaksi vahvaa ja modernia johtajaa, jolla on uudistava ja ihmisläheinen ote johtamiseen. Etsimme henkilöä, joka innostuu rakentamaan Kotkan menestystarinaa yhdessä henkilöstön, luottamushenkilöiden, kaupunkilaisten ja sidosryhmien kanssa. Kotka on vahva ja elinvoimainen kaupunki - etsimme johtajaa, joka vie Kotkaa kaupungin arvojen mukaisesti Rakkaudella, Reilusti ja Rohkeasti eteenpäin.

Kaupunginjohtajan keskeisiin tehtäviin kuuluvat kaupunkikonsernin kokonaisvaltainen johtaminen sekä organisaation kehittämisen ja uudistumisen edistäminen. Toivomme, että uusi kaupunginjohtaja yhdistää strategisen näkemyksen käytännön tekemiseen. Arvostamme kykyä rakentaa luottamusta henkilöstön, päättäjien ja muiden sidosryhmien välille sekä valmiuksia valmistella, toimeenpanna ja seurata päätöksiä. Etsimme kaupunginjohtajaa, joka on aidosti läsnä kuntalaisten, yritysten, päättäjien ja henkilöstön arjessa.

Kaupunginjohtajan viran kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on ylempi korkeakoulututkinto sekä hyvä perehtyneisyys kunnallishallintoon. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen vaativista johtamistehtävistä ja konsernijohtamisesta sekä talousjohtamisen vahvan osaamisen.

Arvostamme kiinnostusta ja kykyä strategiseen johtamiseen, kaupungin elinvoiman ja yritysmyönteisyyden kehittämiseen, edunvalvontakokemusta, elinkeinoelämän tuntemusta, verkostoitumistaitoja ja olemassa olevia verkostoja sekä erinomaisia viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Myös muu kielitaitoa katsotaan eduksi.

Valintaprosessissa voidaan tarvittaessa käyttää soveltuvuusarviointeja.

Virassa noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Johtamisen edellytyksistä sovitaan kuntalain mukaisessa johtajasopimuksessa. Virka täytetään sopimuksen mukaan. Virkaan valitun on ennen viran vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä selvitys terveydentilastaan.

Tehtävää haetaan 24.9.2026 kello 15.00 mennessä ensisijaisesti sähköisesti, osoitteessa www.kotka.fi kohdassa Avoimet työpaikat.
Hakemusasioissa apua saa numerosta 040 352 4737 (ma-pe klo 7-14). Paperihakemus ja ansioluettelo (CV) on mahdollista lähettää osoitteeseen Kotkan kaupunki, Kirjaamo, PL 205, 48101 Kotka. Kaupunginjohtajan virkaan voi myös ilmoittautua.

Puistopääkaupunki Kotka on elinvoimainen, kansainvälinen satama- ja kulttuurikaupunki, jossa ihmiset, yritykset ja luonto menestyvät rinnakkain. Kotka houkuttelee uusia asukkaita, yrityksiä ja matkailijoita tarjoamalla turvallisen, sujuvan ja viihtyisän arjen sekä ainutlaatuisen ympäristön elää, työskennellä ja yrittää. Kotka-konserni rakentaa kaupungin tulevaisuutta edistämällä asukkaiden hyvinvointia ja yritysten kasvua taloudellisesti ja ekologisesti kestävällä tavalla

Kotkassa on noin 50 000 asukasta. Kaupunki on vetovoimainen työnantaja, joka panostaa henkilöstönsä osaamiseen ja hyvinvointiin varmistaakseen laadukkaat palvelut kuntalaisille. Kaupungin palveluksessa työskentelee yli 1 800 ammattilaista.

description:
The Floorhand position is a rig crew member whose primary work station is on the rig floor, however the duties and responsibilities are prominent in every aspect of drilling the well, manual handling of tubular and tools, making up or breaking out during making connections or tripping pipe. The position is responsible for the processes of rigging up/down, drilling and completing the well. Also, maintaining circulating, rotating, hoisting and well control systems.

Location: Prudhoe Bay, Alaska
Rotation: 14x14 or 21x21 (days or nights, including weekends and holidays) - schedule subject to change

  • Operate tongs, slips, and other drill floor equipment to make and break connections on drill pipe, casing, tubulars, and other tools.
  • Assist in rig up/down operations, including handling and assembling the Blowout Preventer (BOP) stack and related components.
  • Maintain a clean and hazard-free drill floor through consistent housekeeping (washing, chipping, painting, etc.).
  • Monitor and operate shaker units to ensure proper function and drilling fluid processing.
  • Support the Derrickhand in mud systems, including the mud pit, mud pump, and chemical storage areas.
  • Work with the Motorman in loading/unloading supplies, pipe, and other rig materials.
  • Perform preventative maintenance and minor repairs on rig floor equipment.
  • When trained and authorized, assist or relieve the Derrickhand in the derrick.
  • Observe equipment closely to detect unusual sounds or behaviors that may indicate issues requiring maintenance.
  • Adhere to all Nabors safety policies and procedures at all times.
  • High school diploma or equivalent 3-5 Years of experience.
  • Ability to perform essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodations
  • Ability to wear respiratory protective devices
  • Ability to successfully complete of Floorhand Training at the NDUSA Training Center
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Work a full 12-hour shift while remaining alert and focused, even during repetitive tasks.
  • Must be able to stand and walk for up to 4 hours at a time, including on steel decks, board roads, gravel, snow, and ice.
  • Frequently lift and carry objects weighing 60+ lbs, including 100 lb sacks and tools.
  • Regularly swing 20 lb sledgehammers and apply torque up to 160 lbs when operating wrenches or valves.
  • Repetitively bend, stoop, kneel, twist, and crawl, often while in Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Ability to work outdoors in extreme Arctic conditions, including subzero temperatures, snow, and ice.
  • Must be able to understand and follow both verbal and written instructions.
  • Must pass all required pre-employment and site-specific drug and fitness-for-duty testing.
  • Must possess a valid Driver’s License in good standing – Real ID compliant, suitable for travel to Alaska and the North Slope.

title: Lead AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer
description:
Department:

Information Technology

Job Description:

The Lead AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer is responsible for enabling, operating, and continuously improving the infrastructure and operational capabilities required by production AI solutions.

As TMG expands its AI capabilities, AI CoE will develop large language model, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based, machine-learning, and other AI-enabled use cases. This role will work within the Infrastructure team to help those teams define and coordinate their infrastructure, environment, connectivity, observability, security, capacity, and production-readiness needs.

The engineer in collaboration with other Infrastructure resources will focus on the AI application, platform, and operational layers. TMG’s managed services provider operates the underlying AWS cloud infrastructure. This role will translate AI solution requirements, coordinate infrastructure services and changes, monitor delivery, diagnose issues, and validate that environments meet reliability, security, performance, and operational expectations.

This is a hands-on role that works closely with AI engineering, application development, data, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure operations, and external managed-services partners.

Work Arrangement:

  • Employees who live within 30 miles of the TMG home office are expected to follow a hybrid or in-office schedule. The initial training period may require additional in‑office days.

Accountabilities:

Enable AI Infrastructure and Environments

  • Partner with AI engineering, application, data, security, architecture, and platform teams to understand the infrastructure and operational needs of new AI use cases.

  • Translate AI solution designs into requirements for environments, compute, storage, networking, connectivity, identity, security, observability, capacity, and supporting cloud services.

  • In Collaboration with other Infrastructure resources and managed service provider, coordinate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, access, and changes with TMG’s AWS managed-services provider and other technology partners.

  • Support operational readiness for AI solutions transitioning into production.

  • Identify infrastructure dependencies, constraints, risks, costs, and lead times early in the delivery lifecycle.

  • Establish reusable infrastructure patterns, operational standards, dashboards, runbooks, and production-readiness requirements across AI use cases.

  • Validate that environments and supporting services are appropriately configured, monitored, secured, scalable, and ready for production use.

  • Implement new cloud functionality requirements in collaboration with architecture and AI engineering within approved architecture and guardrails.

  • Follow and enforce established security, compliance, and operational controls across AI platforms and infrastructure.

Operate and Improve Production AI Solutions

  • Work with managed services to Implement and maintain observability, logging, tracing, monitoring, dashboards, and alerting for production AI applications.

  • Define and track operational metrics covering AI quality, reliability, latency, cost, utilization, adoption, and business outcomes.

  • Work with AI engineering team to diagnose production issues across AI applications, models, prompts, retrieval systems, data, integrations, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Support root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with AI engineers, application teams, platform teams, and managed-services providers.

  • Support AI-related incident management, problem management, operational reviews, release validation, and production-readiness activities.

  • Create and maintain service-health dashboards, runbooks, troubleshooting guidance, support procedures, and escalation paths.

  • Define and track service health indicators, SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs for production AI solutions.

  • Use telemetry, evaluations, and production data to validate fixes, releases, configuration changes, and system improvements.

Support AI Risk and Operational Governance

  • Partner with AI and IT governance team to operationalize applicable controls and monitoring requirements.

  • Operationalize evaluation processes and support AI Governance team to monitor AI performance, regressions, drift, grounding, retrieval quality, and overall effectiveness.

  • Support the collection and retention of operational evidence, including model and prompt versions, evaluation results, incidents, exceptions, and corrective actions.

  • Identify material changes in AI behavior and help ensure they are evaluated, documented, and appropriately addressed.

  • Analyze trends and proactively identify degradation, drift, capacity constraints, reliability risks, and quality issues before they become production incidents

Key Outcomes

  • AI teams receive timely and consistent infrastructure and operational support.

  • AI use cases move efficiently from experimentation to reliable production operation.

  • Reusable infrastructure and operational patterns are applied across AI initiatives.

  • End-to-end visibility exists across AI applications and supporting services.

  • AI quality, reliability, cost, usage, and business impact are consistently measured.

  • Production issues are detected, diagnosed, and resolved more quickly.

  • Releases result in fewer regressions and operational disruptions.

  • Secure, compliant, and audit-ready AI platforms meeting enterprise governance and risk requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of overall information technology experience, including 5+ years in infrastructure operations, cloud operations, site reliability engineering, DevOps, platform operations, application operations, or production engineering.

  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted, distributed, data-intensive, or AI-enabled production applications.

  • Experience implementing and supporting observability, logging, tracing, monitoring, dashboards, alerting, and operational reporting.

  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, APIs, integrations, identity and access management, security, and data pipelines.

  • Experience coordinating infrastructure services, changes, dependencies, and issue resolution across internal teams, technology partners, and managed-services providers.

  • Familiarity with AWS services and capabilities related to monitoring, logging, networking, security, identity, and infrastructure operations.

  • Experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and release-management practices.

  • Experience operating or supporting LLM, generative AI, machine-learning, RAG, or agent-based applications in production is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI observability, evaluation, model monitoring, hallucination detection, grounding, retrieval quality, model or data drift, and prompt-related risks.

  • Familiarity with vector databases, model APIs, AI gateways, prompt-management platforms, or agent orchestration frameworks.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across concurrent technology initiatives.

  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, along with relevant AWS, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, security, or AI certifications, is preferred.

Pay Range:

Anticipated Hiring Range:

  • $130,000 - $150,000 annual base salary depending on experience, qualifications, and geographic location

Benefits:

We are proud to offer our full-time regular employees a robust benefits suite that includes:

  • Competitive base salary plus incentive plans for eligible team members

description:

They are expected to wait on customers at the front counter and answer the phone, along with any of their responsibilities, in a professional manner that will optimize the cooperative’s market share and savings, improve the cooperative’s efficiency, help achieve the cooperative’s mission and goals, and provide outstanding customer service.   1. Current knowledge of Point of Sale and Point of Scale software.
  2. Current knowledge of Ag-trax software pertaining to agronomy billings.
  3. Knowledge of seed, chemicals, fertilizer products and store inventory.
  4. Able to work independently with minimum supervision.
  5. Must be accurate and detail oriented.
  6. Computer and data entry skills.
  7. Ability to react to change productively and handle other essential tasks as assigned.
  8. Ability to deal with emotional customers and help resolve complaints.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to taste or smell. The employee must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds and frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.



PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT:

Appropriate personal protective equipment in restrictive areas.


REQUIRED EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

A high school degree with two years of college level accounting or equivalent experience.

title: Advisor - Workforce Data Management & Governance
description:
About Us

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

About the Role

As an Advisor - Data in our Organisation Design & Implementation Process & Optimisation team, you’ll play a key role in supporting reliable, consistent and practical data management across OD&I. You’ll help bring OD&I’s data management strategy to life by supporting data governance, data quality, optimisation and automation initiatives that improve how we deliver workforce transformation outcomes.

You’ll work closely with the Lead – Data Management, OD&I Process Engineer, service owners and delivery practitioners to embed consistent data practices, maintain operational tools and artefacts, support testing and rollout of improvements, and build team capability through practical guidance, training and user resources.

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

Role Type: Permanent
Role Location: Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane or New Zealand
Work Hours: Full time

What could your day look like?

As an Advisor - Data Management, you will be:

  • Supporting the implementation and maintenance of OD&I data governance standards, controls and ways of working.
  • Monitoring data quality, identifying issues or anomalies, and coordinating remediation actions to improve accuracy, completeness and integrity.
  • Maintaining and improving OD&I data templates, trackers, reporting tools and operational artefacts.
  • Partnering with the Lead – Data Management, OD&I Process Engineer, service owners and practitioners to embed data management improvements into day-to-day delivery.
  • Supporting the delivery of data optimisation and automation initiatives, including documenting requirements, coordinating testing, validating outcomes and helping embed new solutions.
  • Developing process documentation, training materials and user resources to support adoption of data management practices, tools and process improvements.
  • Supporting rollout activities for new data practices and automation tools, including training, walkthroughs and practical guidance for users.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

What will you bring?

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  • Experience working with data management, reporting, administration or data quality activities.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain high levels of data accuracy, completeness and integrity.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and other data management tools to analyse, maintain and report on data.
  • Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes and support practical remediation activities.
  • Experience developing and maintaining process documentation, training materials and operational resources.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to support and guide users through new processes and ways of working.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience supporting process improvement, standardisation or automation initiatives.
  • Experience working with workforce, HR or organisation design data would be well regarded.
  • Experience with Excel VBA, Power Query, Power BI, Power Automate or similar reporting, automation and workflow tools would be advantageous.
  • Relevant university qualifications will be well regarded but are not a barrier to entry.

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

So why join us?

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. You'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.

At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and encourage you to talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you're a candidate with a disability or access requirement, and have an enquiry about the support provided, please let us know on your application or visit ANZ Accessibility and Inclusion Programs for alternate contact methods.

To find out more about working at ANZ, visit https://www.anz.com.au/careers. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 121691 .

description:
About Open

Open.cx is the AI customer experience platform, automating support, outbound, sales, and customer understanding, built for enterprises that cannot afford slow, expensive, or mediocre support. We are a small, high-output team that ships fast, works directly with customers, and genuinely cares about the product we are building.

The Role

Product Engineers at Open.cx own problems end-to-end: from spotting an opportunity, to talking directly with users, to shipping the feature in production with no layers in between, no hand-off culture. You are a full-stack owner.

This role focuses on our voice AI agents: real-time speech, low-latency pipelines, and the runtime behind enterprise phone conversations. You will work on a genuinely hard product, AI customer experience infrastructure used by enterprises at scale across Europe, the US, and the GCC. The codebase is React + TypeScript throughout. The problems are real, the users are live, and the impact is measurable and scalable.

If you want to work somewhere that trusts engineers to think, decide, and ship then look no further!

What You'll Do

  • Identify product opportunities: Spot gaps or improvements before anyone asks you to. Bring proposals, not just execution.
  • Talk to users directly: Understand problems by speaking with the people experiencing them. No layers, no filtered requirements.
  • Ship features end-to-end: Plan, prioritise, and implement full-stack features (React + TypeScript) from concept to production.
  • Own quality: Code reviews, testing, performance, reliability this is your product as much as anyone's.
  • Collaborate closely: Work with the Customer Engineering team to incorporate real user feedback into what you build next.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with real-time audio, speech pipelines, or LLM-powered agents is a big plus.
  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping software products.
  • Strong TypeScript and React you are comfortable owning a full-stack feature without hand-holding.
  • Product instinct you can look at a workflow and know what to fix, not just implement what you are told.

  • Willingness to talk to customers and let reality shape your priorities.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Top-of-market compensation.
  • Full health insurance.
  • Equity participation we want you building this like you own it.
  • Direct collaboration with world-class engineers at a YC-backed company with real enterprise traction.

We are a small team. Every engineer here matters enormously. If you are the type who thrives with real ownership and real impact, Let’s talk.

Job Description:
This job is responsible for the execution of data architectural solutions for complex initiatives that span multiple Lines of Business and control functions. Key responsibilities include facilitating solution driven discussions, working with stakeholders to support adherence to the enterprise data management policy and standards, and supporting architecture design reviews to ensure integration of data architecture principles in technology solutions. Job expectations include educating data management teams on enterprise data architectural principles and data management processes and routines.

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Data Architect with deep expertise in AI Controls, Responsible AI, & enterprise data governance to architect secure, compliant, and trustworthy AI ecosystems. This senior role is responsible for designing technical guardrails, assessing AI control capabilities across platforms and tools, and ensuring the safe adoption of AI technologies enterprise‑wide.

The ideal candidate combines advanced data/AI architecture experience with an expert understanding of AI risks, model governance, & the technical control frameworks required in regulated environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Partners with various technology teams to establish data solutions and architecture for large, complex initiatives that align with the enterprise data architecture strategy and strategic technology and platform decisions
  • Develops clear and concise responses to questions from senior management and control partners regarding the enterprise data architecture strategy
  • Manages multiple priorities in a matrixed environment with attention to detail and accuracy
  • Communicates effectively to influence agreement between partners and escalates items, as needed, to ensure execution activities remain on track
  • Ensures all relevant risk, financial, and compliance policies and standards are met
  • Manages relationships with business and technology partners and creates an inclusive and healthy working environment to resolve organizational impediments and blockers
  • Educates data management teams on enterprise data architectural principles, processes, and routines
  • AI Controls Architecture & Governance
  • Design & maintain the architectural framework for AI/ML controls, ensuring alignment with enterprise risk & compliance requirements.
  • Establish standardized control patterns for data protection, access management, content filtering, prompt governance, and safeguard monitoring.
  • Evaluate & implement tools for explainability, interpretability, redteaming, bias detection, drift monitoring, and auditability.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Model Risk Management, and InfoSec to harmonize AI architectural controls with enterprise governance frameworks.
  • Assessment of AI Control Capabilities
  • Conduct formal assessments of AI platforms, tools, and frameworks to determine their control maturity, gaps, and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Evaluate vendor AI capabilities (e.g., model APIs, LLM platforms, vector databases, AI orchestration tools) against security, privacy, and operational control requirements.
  • Lead control readiness evaluations for new AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, agents, LLM components, and MLOps/LLMOps platforms.
  • Develop structured assessment criteria for AI guardrails

AI Controls Architecture & Governance

  • Design & maintain the architectural framework for AI/ML controls, ensuring alignment with enterprise risk & compliance requirements.
  • Establish standardized control patterns for data protection, access management, content filtering, prompt governance, and safeguard monitoring.
  • Evaluate & implement tools for explainability, interpretability, red‑teaming, bias detection, drift monitoring, and auditability.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Model Risk Management, and InfoSec to harmonize AI architectural controls with enterprise governance frameworks.

Assessment of AI Control Capabilities

  • Conduct formal assessments of AI platforms, tools, and frameworks to determine their control maturity, gaps, and alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Evaluate vendor AI capabilities (e.g., model APIs, LLM platforms, vector databases, AI orchestration tools) against security, privacy, and operational control requirements.
  • Lead control readiness evaluations for new AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, agents, LLM components, and MLOps/LLMOps platforms.
  • Develop structured assessment criteria for AI guardrails such as:
  • Data governance controls
  • Model monitoring & explainability tooling
  • Hallucination mitigation
  • Prompt/response filtering
  • Access and identity management
  • Logging, auditability, & model lineage
  • Provide recommendations, risk mitigation strategies, and architectural guidance based on assessment outcomes.

Responsible AI, Model Controls & Lifecycle Governance

  • Embed Responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, transparency, robustness) into all AI architectural designs.
  • Architect the full model lifecycle with built-in controls, including documentation, validation, approvals, testing, monitoring, and retirement.
  • Develop controlled environments for training and deploying models, including versioning, lineage, reproducibility, isolation, and audit trails.
  • Implement continuous monitoring frameworks for compliance, drift, bias, hallucinations, and performance degradation.

Leadership & Influence

  • Serve as the enterprise expert for AI controls, helping shape policy, standards, and long-term architecture strategy.
  • Influence and guide senior leaders, engineers, and data scientists toward controlled, compliant AI adoption.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in data architecture, ML/AI engineering, or enterprise architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing AI control capabilities, including evaluating vendors, platforms, and internal systems.
  • Deep expertise in AI/ML governance, risk management, and Responsible AI frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, governance, lineage, metadata, and privacy controls.
  • Hands‑on experience with modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, etc.).
  • Proficiency with AI infrastructure (vector databases, LLM orchestration platforms, embeddings pipelines).
  • Strong programming and data engineering skills (Python, SQL, Spark).
  • Experience architecting secure cloud-native solutions (Azure preferred).

Desired Qualifications:

  • Prior involvement with model risk governance or AI ethics programs.
  • Certifications in cloud architecture, data engineering, or AI governance.
  • Experience designing RAG architectures, LLMOps workflows, and GenAI guardrail frameworks.

Core Competencies

  • Enterprise data and AI architecture
  • Risk-based decision making and technology governance
  • Clear communication with executives, auditors, and technical teams
  • Leadership and ability to influence cross-functional groups

Success Measures

  • Measurable reduction in AI-related risks

  • Delivery of scalable, secure, and responsible AI architectures

title: Sprinkler Service Fitter
description:
SUMMARY

The Sprinkler Technician – Fire Protection is responsible for inspection, testing, maintenance, and repair of fire sprinkler, standpipe, and related fire suppression systems across multiple client facilities. This role ensures compliance with all applicable codes and standards including NFPA, provincial fire codes, and building regulations.

The technician will conduct system assessments, troubleshoot deficiencies, prepare compliance reports, and collaborate with property management and tenants to ensure life‑safety requirements are met. Strong knowledge of wet, dry, pre‑action, deluge, and fire pump systems is essential. CFAA certification is considered an asset.

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Inspection, Testing & Verification

  • Conducts inspections, testing, and maintenance (ITM) of fire sprinkler systems, standpipes, fire pumps, valves, and related equipment in accordance with NFPA 25 and provincial requirements.
  • Performs system flow tests, pressure tests, pump churn and run tests, and valve supervisory checks.
  • Identifies system impairments, deficiencies, leaks, corrosion, faulty components, and takes corrective action or escalates when required.
  • Completes inspection reports, service tags, and compliance documentation accurately and on time.

Troubleshooting & Repairs

  • Diagnoses issues with sprinkler heads, piping, valves, backflow preventers, and fire pumps.
  • Performs repairs or replacement of system components, including valves, o-rings, hangers, sprinkler heads, gauges, and related parts.
  • Responds to emergency service calls involving sprinkler activation, system failures, and water-related incidents.

Compliance & Code Assurance

  • Ensures all work aligns with applicable fire codes, building codes, and NFPA standards.
  • Advises clients of deficiencies and provides recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Supports development and implementation of fire protection improvement plans.

Client Communication & Support

  • Acts as a liaison with tenants, property managers, and internal teams to address life‑safety questions.
  • Provides clear communication regarding inspection results, system conditions, and required repairs.
  • Assists in coordinating fire protection work with other trades when required.

Reporting & Administration

  • Prepares inspection forms, deficiency reports, cost estimates, and service summaries.
  • Documents system conditions and maintains accurate service records.
  • Participates in operations meetings and provides expertise on fire suppression systems.
  • Other duties as required.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILSS

  • Completion of a recognized Sprinkler Fitter apprenticeship or equivalent training.
  • 3–5 years of experience working with fire sprinkler, standpipe, and fire pump systems.
  • Strong understanding of NFPA 13, NFPA 25, NFPA 20, and applicable provincial codes.
  • Ability to interpret drawings, hydraulic calculations, and system schematics.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical information clearly.
  • Ability to work independently and assess risk in operational environments.
  • Experience in commercial, industrial, or institutional facilities is considered an asset.

LICENSES & PROFESSIONAL ACCREDITATIONS

Required:

  • Valid Sprinkler Fitter journeyperson certification (provincial).
  • Valid driver’s license.

Assets:

  • CFAA certification (Canadian Fire Alarm Association) or equivalent.
  • Experience with backflow testing or fire pump maintenance.
  • Additional fire protection or suppression system training.

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range as per collective agreement.

description:
CRS JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Technical Advisor II, Shelter & Settlement - Venezuela Reports to: Technical Advisor II/South America & with a dotted line to the HRD Shelter and Settlements Team Lead
Department: Humanitarian Response Department Grade: 10

Job Summary

EMPOWER (Empowering Partner Organizations Working in Emergency Response) is a CRS program under the Humanitarian Response Department (HRD) that strengthens local humanitarian actors’ leadership, coordination, institutional capacity, and access to humanitarian funding. In Venezuela, EMPOWER will support a six-month, DHR-funded emergency response led by CRS and Cáritas Venezuela following the June 2026 earthquakes, which caused significant damage, displacement, and urgent needs across affected areas. The response will provide life-saving assistance in WASH, food assistance, Shelter, and protection/MHPSS, while building on CRS and Cáritas Venezuela’s existing partnership, parish-based structures, volunteer networks, and emergency response systems. The Technical Advisor II provides technical advice, guidance, and support to a wide range of program design and implementation issues with a focus on larger projects in the area of Shelter and Settlements in line with Catholic Relief Services (CRS) program quality principles and standards, donor guidelines, and industry best practices to CRS and Caritas Venezuela teams as part of the Venezuela Earthquake Emergency response to advance the delivery of high-quality programming to the poor and vulnerable. The incumbent’s technical knowledge, advice and guidance will contribute to determining how effective, adaptive and innovative CRS and Caritas’ Shelter and Settlements programming is across the globe.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of response-wide strategies, standards, tools, and best practices in Shelter and Settlements that effectively engage partners, Cluster, donors and governments. Help ensure a cross-sectoral approach integrating gender, protection mainstreaming, and disaster risk reduction.
  • Provide technical solutions to CRS and Caritas Venezuela teams, , for strategic planning and how to best apply program design and implementation standards, best practices, partnership principles, tools, and M&E, ensuring high-quality implementation.
  • Contribute to EMPOWER and Venezuela response efforts to pre-position CRS for growth opportunities in Shelter and Settlements. Lead or contribute to the development of the technical design for large and/or complex proposals, including defining appropriate monitoring systems and indicators. Advise project teams on integrating donor strategies, priorities and technical requirements into CRS’ approach.
  • Contribute to capacity strengthening initiatives in Shelter and Settlements programming for Caritas Venezuela through helping develop learning and training strategies and agendas/curriculums, conducting trainings and workshops, and mentoring and coaching to partner staff.
  • Support Caritas Venezuela’s overall shelter, settlements and WASH/Infrastructure response, including assessments, development of designs and BoQs, program planning, implementation follow-up, and technical quality assurance.
  • Provide close accompaniment to Caritas Venezuela staff and, when needed, temporarily support day-to-day sector coordination and project management functions to ensure timely and high-quality delivery. Contribute to knowledge management and learning through collecting and analyzing program data, evaluating strategic projects, assisting with measuring program impact, capturing and sharing lessons learned and best practices, and research and internal reports.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with donors, peer organizations, research and other institutions. Participate in forums in the area of Shelter and Settlements to collect and share best practices and promote CRS’ work. Participate in and contribute to the Shelter, Land and Site Coordination Cluster, including actively supporting technical working groups.

  • Be the focal point for CRS Shelter and Settlements scale and system change initiatives.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Architecture or related field.
  • Minimum of eight years’ relevant international working experience in an advisory or management role with progressive responsibilities, ideally with an international NGO. Experience in humanitarian or rapid-onset emergency response is highly relevant.
  • Minimum of three years working for programming interventions in Shelter and Settlements.
  • Experience providing technical assistance and developing successful proposals for external donor funding is required.
  • Experience in business development, project design and proposal development in Shelter and Settlements, including technical writing.

  • Experience with program monitoring and evaluation, including applying data collection tools and methodologies, data analysis, and data presentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Engineering, Architecture or a related field.

title: Presales Solutions Architect - Security Operations
description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Presales Solutions Architect – Security Operations at SHI International is responsible for being SHI’s Subject Matter Expert on all aspects of Security Operations Center design and optimization, including SIEM/SOAR architecture, EDR/XDR strategy, incident response frameworks, and security automation and orchestration.

In this role, you will split your time between presales client engagements and internal practice development. On the presales side, you’ll take a consultative approach, leading technical discovery sessions with clients to assess their security operations maturity, designing target-state SOC architectures, and delivering compelling demos, POCs, and technical presentations. On the internal side, you’ll build reusable collateral such as reference architectures, battle cards, and enablement content; evaluate and qualify new vendor partnerships; and conduct training sessions that keep our engineering and sales teams current on emerging threats, platform capabilities, and best practices.

Your credibility and technical depth will make you a trusted advisor to both SHI’s most strategic customers and our internal stakeholders, driving meaningful security outcomes and revenue growth across the SecOps practice.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Design and deliver product demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical presentations focused on enterprise SOC solutions including SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and threat intelligence platforms

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to assess clients’ security operations maturity across detection, response, threat hunting, and security automation capabilities

  • Translate complex SecOps concepts – such as alert triage optimization, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and automated response playbooks – into business-relevant value propositions for both technical and executive audiences

  • Design and present target-state SOC architectures covering log ingestion, correlation rules, threat detection logic, incident response workflows, and integration with broader security stacks (CNAPP, IAM, zero trust)

  • Develop and maintain internal practice collateral including reference architectures, battle cards, competitive analyses, technical briefs, and vendor evaluation frameworks

  • Evaluate and qualify new vendor technologies and product capabilities; make recommendations on partner adoption, platform consolidation, and legacy solution retirement

  • Conduct internal enablement sessions for engineering and sales teams on emerging threats, product updates, use cases, and SOC best practices

  • Drive revenue growth within the presales team by identifying new security operations opportunities and optimizing service offerings

  • Collaborate with SHI stakeholder partner teams to create synergistic security operations service solutions that integrate across SHI’s broader portfolio

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention through product briefings, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer

  • Stay current with new SecOps technologies, frameworks, and regulatory developments; track adversary TTPs and evolving threat landscape to inform architectural recommendations

  • Contribute to practice development by identifying areas for growth, leading innovation initiatives, and creating and maintaining practice standards to ensure high-quality service delivery



Behaviors and Competencies

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Adaptability: Can lead others through change, help teams adapt to new directions, and create a culture open to change.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Teamwork: Can build and lead multiple teams, fostering a cooperative environment and ensuring effective communication between team members.

  • Self-Motivation: Can take ownership of complex personal or professional initiatives, collaborate with others when necessary, and drive results through self-motivation.



Skill Level Requirements

  • Proficiency in overseeing and directing projects to completion, ensuring goals are met, resources are utilized efficiently, and stakeholders are satisfied - Intermediate

  • Ability to systematically identify, document, and manage the technical needs and specifications of a project by engaging with stakeholders and analyzing business objectives to ensure successful project outcomes - Intermediate

  • Ability to define, design, build, and maintain robust security operations architectures and SOC solutions by leveraging enterprise security platforms and infrastructure effectively - Intermediate

  • Ability to write, debug, and maintain code in various scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, KQL, SPL) and their application to detection rules, response playbooks, and integration workflows is a plus - Intermediate

  • Ability to understand and manage various infrastructure components (firewalls, load balancers, hypervisors, storage, monitoring, security) and use orchestration tools to develop comprehensive technical solutions - Intermediate

  • Ability to develop detailed opportunity engagement scoping documents that accurately define deliverables and requirements - Intermediate

  • Deep understanding of SOC operational workflows including triage processes, incident response runbooks, threat hunting methodologies, and continuous improvement frameworks - Intermediate



Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, SOC architecture, or security engineering roles with hands-on SIEM/SOAR/EDR/XDR design and implementation

  • Demonstrated experience in presales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting within the cybersecurity domain

  • Willingness to travel occasionally up to 20%

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications preferred but not required:

  • CISSP, CCSP, or CISM

  • CompTIA Security+, CySA+, SANS GIAC (GCIA, GCIH, GSOM), or CEH

  • SIEM platform certification (vendor-specific)

  • ITIL Foundation or ITIL Specialist (for service operations alignment)

  • Cloud Security Specialty Certification

  • Certified SOC Analyst (CSA) or equivalent

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
At Indeep AI, we are an applied AI research laboratory working at the intersection of natural language processing, linguistics, and human cognition. Our work is grounded in a simple conviction: the tools we use to write and understand documents should make communication clearer and more trustworthy, not less. That research powers Typewiser, our document intelligence platform. Typewiser helps people produce and understand high-stakes documents with greater clarity and rigour, analysing how information is communicated, surfacing where meaning breaks down, and supporting the writer in real time. It is backed by European research funding and built on peer-reviewed scientific foundations. We are a small, multidisciplinary team of linguists, engineers, scientists, and operators. We are at the stage where the way we present ourselves to the world is still being built. That is where you come in.


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack AI Engineer to join our team at Indeep Artificial Intelligence (IAI) at our office in Barcelona. We need someone who can support our technical efforts across the board. Working closely with and directly supporting our CTO, you will move fluidly across the whole stack — from backend and platform engineering, to the LLM and AI pipelines at the core of our product, to the infrastructure that runs it, to the frontend that users touch. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who is happiest when they can pick up almost any part of the system and make progress on it. We are not looking for a specialist in a single layer. We need a strong generalist: someone who can context-switch, learn quickly, and be trusted to deliver across whatever the week demands. You won’t own the architecture, but you will be the person who helps turn it into working, reliable software, and your judgement will carry real weight.


We need someone with a strong startup attitude: sharp problem-solving skills, the ability to manage priorities and deliverables autonomously without rigid timeframes, and the capacity to handle diverse task assignments. If you thrive in ambiguity, move fast without sacrificing quality, and can pivot when priorities shift, you’re exactly who we’re looking for. This role is for someone energised by wearing multiple hats and making an impact without needing a detailed playbook. If that sounds like you, we’d be excited to hear from you.


  • Contract Type: Permanent
  • Full Office-Based Work Modality: Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00 at WeWork Glòries Barcelona


Duties & Responsibilities


Backend & Platform Engineering


  • Build, extend, and maintain the backend services and platform logic that power Typewiser.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and contribute to the overall health of the codebase.
  • Implement features end-to-end, from data layer through to API, in collaboration with the CTO.


LLM & AI Pipeline Work


  • Develop and integrate the LLM-driven pipelines at the core of the product, including prompting strategies, orchestration, structured outputs, and RAG and validation layers.
  • Integrate and evaluate third-party AI models and APIs, balancing quality, latency, and cost.
  • Help build the tooling and evaluation needed to keep AI-driven features reliable and reproducible.


Infrastructure & Deployment


  • Set up, maintain, and improve our deployment pipelines, infrastructure, and environments.
  • Handle the operational side of running the platform: CI/CD, monitoring, and keeping things stable and secure.


Frontend & Full-Stack


  • Contribute to the frontend and deliver full-stack features as needed, ensuring a coherent experience from interface to backend.
  • Collaborate on the product’s UI where engineering and design meet.


Qualifications Required:


  • 5 to 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrable full-stack breadth.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, with proficiency in Python (our primary backend language).
  • Hands-on experience integrating and working with LLMs or other AI/ML models in production, including prompt engineering.
  • Working experience with frontend development and modern web frameworks.
  • Practical experience with infrastructure, deployment, and DevOps practices (CI/CD, cloud environments, containerisation).
  • A genuine generalist mindset: comfortable owning a problem across the entire stack rather than a single layer.
  • C1-level proficiency in English.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup/scale-up environment and understand the specific challenges of early-stage companies.


Preferred:


  • Experience with AWS.
  • Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM evaluation.
  • Experience in an early-stage startup, owning broad surface area with limited support.
  • Exposure to NLP or document-processing systems.
  • Working proficiency in other EU languages, particularly Spanish and Italian.


What We Offer


  • €50,000–€80,000 yearly gross salary depending on demonstrable experience and breadth of skills.
  • A high-impact engineering role with broad ownership across the entire stack of a live AI product.
  • Close, direct collaboration with the CTO and visibility across the whole company.
  • Early-stage team member at a high-potential EIC-funded startup.


How to Apply


To apply, send your CV through LinkedIn along with links to work we can look at — a portfolio, GitHub, or projects you’ve shipped. We’re less interested in a cover letter than in seeing what you’ve actually built and how you approach problems across the stack. A short note on a project you’re proud of and your role in it is welcome. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so don’t wait to apply.

This role is responsible for driving operational excellence, financial performance, practice growth, and patient experience across assigned regions and service lines.

The Director leads a team of Managers of Clinic Operations, ensuring alignment with INTEGRIS Health’s mission, vision, and values while executing strategic plans and performance objectives.

The Director Physician Operations responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
• Provides oversight of day-to-day operations across multiple divisions and clinic sites, ensuring efficient, standardized, and high-performing practice operations.
• Translates organizational strategy into operational plans, ensuring alignment with INTEGRIS Health goals.
• Partners with physicians and administrative leadership to establish and achieve operational, quality, and patient experience targets.
• Leads implementation of key initiatives including practice start-ups, acquisitions, and integration of new service lines or providers.
• Directly supervises Manager of Clinic Operations; provides coaching, development, and performance management.
• Ensures effective management of clinic practice managers and staff through direct and indirect leadership.
• Oversees workforce planning, recruitment support, onboarding, and retention strategies for clinic leadership and staff.
• Fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement across all teams.
• Develops and oversees divisional budgets, ensuring fiscal accountability and achievement of financial targets.
• Monitors financial performance including revenue cycle metrics, cost management, and physician compensation alignment with INTEGRIS Health benchmarks.
• Leads development and execution of annual business plans for multiple clinics and service lines.
• Identifies operational and financial improvement opportunities and drives corrective action plans.
• Establishes and monitors performance metrics for clinic operations, including patient satisfaction, access, throughput, and efficiency.
• Oversees implementation of site-specific performance goals and improvement initiatives.
• Recommends and supports facility improvements, including new construction, renovations, and equipment procurement.
• Ensures effective front-line operations through leadership of Managers of Clinic Operations.
• Leads development of new clinic sites, service lines, and physician start-ups; including operational planning, staffing, budgeting, and infrastructure coordination.
• Supports physician and APP recruitment, onboarding, and manpower planning across divisions.
• Facilitates integration and transition of new acquired practices.
• Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and regulatory requirements, including The Joint Commission (TJC) standards as applicable.
• Maintains confidentiality and ensures appropriate handling of sensitive operational and physician-related information.
• Ensures adherence to National Patient Safety Goals and organizational policies.
• Serves as a key liaison between clinic operations, physician leadership, hospital leadership, and system departments (HR, Finance, IT, Revenue Cycle, etc.).
• Participates in enterprise-wide committees and initiatives to support organizational priorities.
• Provides regular updates and reporting on operational, financial, and strategic performance.
• Supports effective use of EMR and practice management systems to drive operational efficiency.
• Partners with IT and operational teams to optimize workflows, reporting, and system utilization.
• Serves as a resource to managers and physician leadership to complex operational, financial, and human resource issues.
• Leads resolution of escalated challenges across clinics and divisions.
• Serves as the primary operational liaison to community and hospital leadership teams within assigned markets, ensuring alignment between IHMG operations and local hospital/community priorities.
• Actively participates in community leadership meetings, including hospital executive councils, operational leadership teams, and market-based strategy sessions.

title: Peruskoulun luokanopettaja
description:
Kotkan opetustoimessa on haettavana peruskoulun luokanopettajan viransijaisuus määräajaksi 25.11.2026-5.6.2027.

Viransijaisuus sijoittuu Karhulan kouluun. Karhulan koulu toimii syyslukukauden 2027 alkuun saakka kolmessa toimipisteessä. Koulussa on noin 700 oppilasta vuosiluokilla 6-9. Yleisopetuksen ryhmien lisäksi Karhulan koulussa on liikuntaan ja musiikkiin painotettua opetusta, joustavan perusopetuksen ryhmä sekä erityisluokkia. Karhulan koulu on osa valtakunnallista urheiluyläkoulujen verkostoa. Urheiluluokkien valmennus toteutetaan yhdessä Etelä-Kymenlaakson Urheiluakatemian (EKA) kanssa koulupäivien aikana.

Haemme innostavaa, kehityshakuista ja yhteistyökykyistä opettajaa, jolla on hyvät tiimityö- ja opetustaidot, hyvät tietotekniset valmiudet ja halu oppia uutta. Arvostamme kykyä tulla toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa. Edellytämme halukkuutta kehittää ja toteuttaa joustavia opetusjärjestelyjä ja yhteistyötä yli oppiaine- ja vuosiluokkarajojen OPS:n tavoitteiden mukaisesti, sekä toivomme valmiutta opettaa eri kieli- ja kulttuuritaustoista tulleita oppilaita.

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/98 mukaisesti. Kelpoisuuden osoittavat todistukset tarkastetaan mahdollisessa haastattelutilanteessa.

Valitun on ennen valinnan vahvistamista toimitettava hyväksyttävä selvitys terveydentilastaan sekä esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen ote.

Viransijaisuudessa noudatetaan kahden (2) kuukauden koeaikaa. Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen opetusalan virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Haettuun tehtävään kelpoisen opettajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka Kotkan opetustoimessa on 3356,68 €/kk ilman mahdollisia ylitunteja ja vuosisidonnaisia lisiä.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti kirjautumalla rekrytointijärjestelmään. Apua hakemuksen jättämiseen saat numerosta 040 352 4737 (ma-pe klo 7-14). Paperihakemus ja CV on mahdollista lähettää osoitteeseen Kotkan kaupunki, Kirjaamo, PL 205, 48101 KOTKA. Haastattelut voidaan aloittaa hakuaikana.
