title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
hackajob is collaborating with AXA to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

About AXA:

AXA is a global leader in insurance and financial services, dedicated to helping customers protect what matters most to them. As the sixth-largest insurance company in the world, we provide a wide range of services, including health, car, home, and business insurance. We support millions of customers worldwide, helping them navigate life's uncertainties with confidence.

AXA UK Support Functions look after our three customer-facing business units, providing the infrastructure and expertise to make sure we can be there for our customers.

Job overview:

We’re seeking a talented Lead Data Scientist to work on some of our most exciting and complex challenges, developing innovative data science solutions that really make a difference. You'll get to work with our state-of-the-art, cloud-based data lake, build sophisticated machine learning and Agentic AI models, and mentor a squad of talented data scientists. Having a real say in how the business understands and uses data, you’ll help shape the future of AXA. It’s an exciting time to join us and make a tangible impact!

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead and deliver data science projects from start to finish, that provide valuable insights and benefits for the business.
  • Create data science solutions, making sure models are developed, deployed, and monitored effectively using strong MLOps practices.
  • Find opportunities and problems where data science can make a real difference.
  • Stay informed about the latest trends and advancements in AI, data science and machine learning through reading, conferences, and industry news.
  • Share knowledge and ideas by researching best practices, testing new concepts, and working with industry experts.
  • Build connections with universities and contribute to open-source projects to keep the team innovative.
  • Help develop and promote the team’s data science strategies and standards.
  • Manage and support a team of data scientists, helping them grow and develop their skills.

Work arrangements:

At AXA we work smart, empowering our people to balance their time between home and the office in a way that works best for them, their team and our customers. You'll work at least two days a week (40%) away from home, moving to three days a week (60%) from December 2026. Away from home means attending the office, visiting clients or attending industry events. We’re also happy to consider flexible working arrangements, which you can discuss with Talent Acquisition.

Your skills & experience:

  • Proven expertise in data science techniques and machine learning models, with hands-on experience in developing and deploying ML solutions in a business setting.
  • Practical knowledge of MLOps practices to facilitate seamless model development, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of Agentic and Generative AI and their usage within regulated environments, such as Financial Services.
  • Experience with Databricks model serving on the Azure cloud platform.
  • Previous experience with mentoring junior team members within a data science environment.
  • Demonstrated success in leading end-to-end data science projects that deliver measurable business value.
  • Proficiency in Python, including familiarity with machine learning libraries, data visualisation tools, and version control systems.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of engaging effectively with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders.

As a precondition of employment for this role, you must be eligible and authorised to work in the United Kingdom.

How to apply:

To apply, click on the ‘apply now’ button, you’ll then need to log in or create a profile to submit your CV. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and don’t discriminate against employees or potential employees based on protected characteristics. If you have a long-term condition or disability and require adjustments during the application or interview process, we’re proud to offer access to the AXA Accessibility Concierge. For our support, please send an email to leanne.white@axa-insurance.co.uk.

We encourage you to apply for this opportunity as soon as possible, as we may close this advert earlier than the listed closing date.

title: Product Engineer, Telephony
description:
About Open

Open.cx is the AI customer experience platform, automating support, outbound, sales, and customer understanding, built for enterprises that cannot afford slow, expensive, or mediocre support. We automate over 80% of interactions for companies like MoneyGram, Mollie, TicketSwap, and More.com handling voice, email, and web at massive scale with AI that thinks fast and feels human.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, X by Unifonic. We recently raised $7M+ and are accelerating from a startup into a global scale-up. Our customers replace entire stacks of legacy tools, cut support costs by up to 12×, and deliver dramatically better experiences to their own customers.

We are a small, high-output team that ships fast, works directly with customers, and genuinely cares about the product we are building.

The Role

Product Engineers at Open.cx own problems end-to-end: from spotting an opportunity, to talking directly with users, to shipping the feature in production with no layers in between, no hand-off culture. You are a full-stack owner.

This role focuses on our telephony platform: phone numbers, SIP, call routing, and keeping enterprise voice traffic reliable at scale. You will work on a genuinely hard product, AI customer experience infrastructure used by enterprises at scale across Europe, the US, and the GCC. The codebase is React + TypeScript throughout. The problems are real, the users are live, and the impact is measurable and scalable.

If you want to work somewhere that trusts engineers to think, decide, and ship then look no further!

  • Identify product opportunities: Spot gaps or improvements before anyone asks you to. Bring proposals, not just execution.
  • Talk to users directly: Understand problems by speaking with the people experiencing them. No layers, no filtered requirements.
  • Ship features end-to-end: Plan, prioritise, and implement full-stack features (React + TypeScript) from concept to production.
  • Own quality: Code reviews, testing, performance, reliability this is your product as much as anyone's.
  • Collaborate closely: Work with the Customer Engineering team to incorporate real user feedback into what you build next.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with telephony or real-time communication systems (SIP, WebRTC, or similar) is a big plus.
  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping software products.
  • Strong TypeScript and React you are comfortable owning a full-stack feature without hand-holding.
  • Product instinct you can look at a workflow and know what to fix, not just implement what you are told.
  • Speed and quality in balance you ship fast without leaving messes.
  • Willingness to talk to customers and let reality shape your priorities.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Top-of-market compensation.
  • Full health insurance.
  • Equity participation we want you building this like you own it.
  • Direct collaboration with world-class engineers at a YC-backed company with real enterprise traction.

We are a small team. Every engineer here matters enormously. If you are the type who thrives with real ownership and real impact, Let’s talk.

Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

Continuous Learning:

Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

Continuous Improvement:

title: Quality Assurance Technician
description:
Job Description:

The Quality Assurance Technician II supports AAON’s commitment to delivering high-quality HVAC products by performing inspections, tests, and audits throughout the manufacturing process. This entry-level role ensures that components and finished units meet internal and external standards. The technician works closely with production teams to identify defects and recommend corrective actions. Attention to detail and a strong understanding of quality principles are essential.

Primary Duties

The Quality Assurance Technician II is responsible for executing quality control procedures and supporting continuous improvement efforts across production lines. Duties include:

Primary duties may include, but are not limited to:

  • Conducting inspections of incoming materials, in-process components, and finished products to ensure compliance with specifications.
  • Documenting inspection results and maintaining accurate records in accordance with company standards.
  • Reporting non-conformances and assisting in root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.
  • Collaborating with production and engineering teams to resolve quality issues and improve processes.
  • Using measurement tools such as calipers, micrometers, and multimeters to verify product dimensions and performance.
  • Supporting internal audits and participating in quality training sessions.
  • Ensuring compliance with AAON’s quality management system and applicable industry standards.
  • Promoting a culture of quality and accountability on the production floor.

Job Requirements

Education and Experience Requirements:

Requires a high school diploma or GED. Technical training or coursework in quality assurance, manufacturing, or HVAC systems is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Basic understanding of quality control principles and inspection techniques.
  • Familiarity with mechanical and electrical components used in HVAC systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical documents.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Basic computer skills, including data entry and use of Microsoft Office.
  • or any combination of education and experience, which would provide an equivalent background.

Essential Mental and Physical Functions:

This role requires consistent focus, precision, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Physical demands include standing for long periods, walking between workstations, and handling small tools and components.

Key Functions:

  • Ability to identify defects and inconsistencies in products.
  • Manual dexterity for operating inspection tools and equipment.
  • Visual acuity for detailed inspections and reading technical documents.
  • Ability to lift up to 30 lbs occasionally and work in a fast-paced environment.

Work Environment:

The Quality Assurance Technician II works in a manufacturing setting with exposure to HVAC equipment, moderate noise levels, and varying temperatures. PPE is required in designated areas. The role may involve rotating shifts and occasional overtime based on production needs.

title: Food Services Rep
description:
Join our team as a full-time, Food Services Rep, at INTEGRIS Health Baptist Portland Ave Oklahoma City, OK.

Get to Know Your Team

  • INTEGRIS Health, Oklahoma’s largest not-for-profit health system, is seeking a dedicated caregiver to join us in our mission to partner with people to live healthier lives.

  • Benefits of being an INTEGRIS Health caregiver include front-loaded PTO, medical benefits through the extensive INTEGRIS Health network, financial assistance for continued education, 24/7 mental health support and more.

  • Take the first step toward growing your career by joining us.

Responsibilities:

The Food Services Rep oversees all daily activities that take place in the tray-line, dish-room, and patient care areas necessary in the preparation and serving of all patient meals and nourishments. Adheres to National Patient Safety Goals as appropriate based on the level of patient contact this position requires.

The Food Service Rep responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Ensures all food items, supplies and serving utensils are obtained as necessary for tray assembly * Assembles trays per patient menu selections and standard portions as specified
  • Delivers trays and food carts within the established time frames
  • Supervises delivery and retrieval of patient meals, including late trays
  • Communicates with nursing staff concerning any issues relevant to patient meal service and takes appropriate action

The Service Associate reports to Food Service Operations Lead. This position may have additional or varied physical demand and/or respiratory fit test requirements. Please consult the Physical Demands Project SharePoint site or contact Risk Management/Employee Health for additional information. Exposure to wet surfaces, hot equipment, and chemicals. Must follow standard precautions.

  • Requires sufficient education to read, write, comprehend, and carry out directions
  • 6 months of work experience related to menu categories, tray checking, equipment, and operation procedures preferred

INTEGRIS Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will receive consideration regardless of membership in any protected status as defined by applicable state or federal law, including protected veteran or disability status.

title: Helper 2
description:

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

With easy downtown access, Mandarin Oriental, Shenzhen, has a total of eight restaurants and bars, including a gourmet Cantonese outlet helmed by acclaimed celebrity Chef Fei, as well as a best-in-class Spa and Wellness facilities including a dramatic indoor swimming pool. Well known for its uncompromising levels of personalised and bespoke services, Mandarin oriental, Shenzhen was recognised as the first Forbes travel guide five-star hotel of the city.

About the job

Based at the Mandarin Oriental, Shenzhen within the Food & Beverage Division in Shenzhen, Helper 2 is responsible for all aspects of the assigned kitchen section and to be proactive, creative and results driven. The Helper 2 reports to the Head Helper.

As Helper 2, you will be responsible for the following duties:

  • Assist the Chef De Partie with the production and quality control of all foods prepared in his/her respective area section
  • Minimize wastage and spoilage by monitoring business forecasts and work practices
  • Inspect all refrigerated and non-refrigerated food storage areas to ensure appropriate stock rotation. Ensure any out-of-stock items are being immediately reported

As Helper 2, we expect from you:

Our commitment to you

  • Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
  • Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.

We’re Fans. Are you?

title: Underwriting Assistant - Personal Lines
description:
RT Specialty, a division of Ryan Specialty, is a leading wholesale distributor of specialty insurance products and services. Our experienced brokers are specialized in property, casualty, professional lines, transportation and workers’ compensation, providing creative solutions to retail brokerage firms. We define ourselves through our superior execution on behalf of our clients, which has established us as a leader in the industry.

Position Summary

The Underwriting Assistant is responsible for the binding process of insurance policies, ensuring adherence to underwriting guidelines and regulatory standards. The role includes inputting necessary information into underwriting applications for accurate policy rating, documentation, and issuance. They act as a liaison between underwriters and brokers, responding to inquiries, collecting information for quoting, and providing revised quotes. They also serve as backup for underwriters and underwriting assistants during their absence.

What will your job entail?

Job Responsibilities:
• Assists the process of binding insurance policies, ensuring accuracy and compliance with binding underwriting guidelines and regulatory requirements.
• Administers underwriting applications with the information necessary to rate, document and issue accurate and compliant policies.
• Assists with new business submission with directions from the Binding Underwriter to prepare and market to carrier.
• Coordinates between Underwriters and brokers by responding to inquiries, works with brokers to obtain information needed to quote, and provides revised quotes as requested.
• Processes and issues policy endorsements, including changes to coverage, limits, or policy terms, ensuring accuracy and timely implementation and tracks cancellation notifications, non-renewal, and renewal solicitation notifications.
• Maintains comprehensive and organized records of all binding transactions and related documentation, including policy details, endorsements, and client information.
• Communicates with clients to collect required information, explains policy terms and conditions, and addresses any questions or concerns related to the binding process.
• Executes the work assigned by underwriters and underwriting assistants when they are out of the office or otherwise unavailable.
• Prepares reports related to policy binding metrics, performance, and compliance, providing insights for process improvement.
Work Experience:
• Minimum of 6 months of work experience in Insurance Industry or Binding Underwriting or related field.
Licenses & Certifications:
• Preferred: Minimum requirements for state P&C and/or surplus line licenses
• Preferred: Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (Preferred)

title: Executive Director, Data Product Owner, Global Markets
description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

STRATEGIC BUSINESS UNIT DESCRIPTION

The Quant Solutions Group (QSG) is a global, cross-asset team that builds the software, analytics, data products and AI-enabled tooling that underpin the Global Markets business. The analytical software and data solutions developed by QSG are widely used across CIBC, helping Distribution to price trades and serve clients, Trading to manage risk, Structuring to identify new client opportunities, and Risk and Finance partners to improve transparency, governance and control. The team is split between London, Toronto and New York, with this role based in London.

JOB PURPOSE

In this role, you will serve as Data Product Owner for Global Markets within QSG. You will define and drive the strategic direction of data products across core Capital Markets domains such as client, trade, market and risk data; champion adoption of governed data and analytics products; and ensure that solutions align with business priorities, regulatory expectations and technology strategy. The role acts as the bridge between trading, risk, quant, distribution, data governance and technology teams, translating abstract business requirements into scalable, production-grade data, analytics and AI-enabled solutions.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Data Product Strategy and Commercial Value

• Define target-state data products and semantic layers for key Global Markets domains, including client, trade, market, position, risk and reference data.

• Identify use cases where governed data, analytics and automation can improve pricing, risk transparency, client engagement, revenue generation or cost reduction.

• Champion data-driven decision-making and self-service analytics across the group, ensuring products are usable, trusted and aligned with front-office workflows.

• Partner with stakeholders to shape differentiated internal and client-facing data insights where appropriate.

Stakeholder Management and Product Leadership

• Engage senior business stakeholders across Trading, Distribution, Structuring, Risk, Quants and Technology to understand data needs, business value and adoption barriers.

• Own and communicate the data product roadmap, translating strategic priorities into clear outcomes, milestones and measurable OKRs.

• Facilitate prioritisation of data initiatives based on business impact, risk transparency, regulatory readiness, client value and operational efficiency.

• Lead cross-functional delivery discussions and ensure alignment between business intent, data governance requirements and technology implementation.

Business Requirement Analysis and Technology Solutioning

• Translate core, abstract business requirements into actionable product requirements, data models, delivery backlogs and acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with technology teams to select and shape appropriate technologies for scalable analytics, trading strategy development, tick or time-series data, workflow automation and AI/ML-enabled use cases.

• Prefer Databricks, Spark and modern lakehouse patterns for scalable analytics where suitable, while recognising transferable experience with Snowflake and other enterprise data platforms.

• Ensure delivery choices balance speed, maintainability, governance, lineage, security and production robustness.

Data Modelling, Governance and Controls

• Work closely with technical and quant teams on domain data modelling, canonical views, silver-layer enterprise views, data catalogues, lineage, metadata and critical data elements.

• Provide product-owner challenge to ensure data models are fit for business purpose, support cross-asset analytics, and can scale to production risk and trading workflows.

• Drive strong data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship, quality controls, metadata management, lineage and controlled data sharing.

• Ensure compliance with CIBC policies, standards, regulatory expectations and industry good practice.

Strategic Data Source Determination

• Identify, assess and recommend strategic internal and external data sources for business, analytics, risk and AI use cases.

• Oversee data-source selection and prioritisation, including clarity on ownership, quality, licensing, controls and downstream consumption patterns.

• Work with governance and technology partners to ensure strategic data sources are discoverable, well documented and suitable for enterprise use.

Analytics, AI and Agentic Strategy Prioritisation

• Prioritise data access, tooling and platform capabilities required to support advanced analytics, AI/ML, NLP, intelligent automation and agentic strategies for the group.

• Identify opportunities to deploy production-grade analytics and AI-enabled solutions that improve decision-making, risk transparency, operational efficiency and front-office productivity.

• Work with quants and engineering teams to turn analytical prototypes into robust production workflows, dashboards, APIs, semantic layers or automated controls.

• Promote responsible AI and model-aware delivery, ensuring appropriate governance, explainability, monitoring and control considerations are addressed.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

This role will involve close collaboration with trading desks, distribution, structuring, risk management, quantitative analysts, technology partners, data governance teams and relevant external data or technology vendors across CIBC Global Markets. The successful candidate will be expected to operate credibly with senior stakeholders while remaining sufficiently hands-on to shape practical delivery with engineering and quant teams.

COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls. The role is expected to promote sound data governance, appropriate data usage, platform controls and responsible deployment of analytics and AI-enabled capabilities.

AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS

• Authority to set and communicate priorities for data product development, enhancement and adoption within the agreed QSG and Global Markets strategy.

• Authority to make recommendations regarding strategic data sources, data-product design, semantic-layer priorities and technology selection.

• Authority to steer data governance practices within QSG, including ownership, prioritisation, metadata, lineage and controls.

• Authority to challenge requirements, delivery approaches or platform choices where they do not meet business value, governance, scalability or production-readiness expectations.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong interpersonal, analytical, product and technical leadership skills. The following attributes are a useful guide to the level of performance expected:

• Degree in a quantitative discipline, computer science, data science, engineering, mathematics, physics or related field; advanced degree preferred.

• Significant experience in data product ownership, data strategy, analytics, quant strategy, risk analytics or related roles within financial services, ideally Global Markets or Capital Markets.

• Strong understanding of capital-markets products and workflows across one or more of rates, equities, securities finance, FX, commodities, derivatives, risk or portfolio analytics.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage senior stakeholders, define OKRs, shape roadmaps and deliver enterprise data or analytics products.

• Hands-on understanding of data technologies and modern analytics platforms, preferably Databricks/Spark and lakehouse patterns; Snowflake experience is relevant and transferable but Databricks experience is preferred.

• Experience with Python, SQL and production analytics workflows; familiarity with big-data engineering, Kafka, Power BI, dashboards, APIs or workflow automation would be advantageous.

• Experience in data modelling, semantic layers, canonical data views, data catalogues, data quality, lineage, metadata, critical data elements and data governance frameworks.

• Understanding of AI/ML, NLP, intelligent automation, agentic AI concepts or production-grade analytics, with the ability to distinguish credible business use cases from experimentation.

• Proven ability to translate abstract business problems into clear product requirements, technical options and delivery plans.

• Excellent communication, influencing and client/stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to operate from executive-level strategy through to delivery detail.

• Genuine passion for data-driven innovation, practical problem-solving and building elegant, governed, scalable solutions for front-office and risk users.

WORKING CONDITIONS

• This role operates within a normal office environment in London, with regular interaction across global teams in London, Toronto and New York.

What you need to know

  • CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com
  • You need to be legally eligible to work at the location(s) specified above and, where applicable, must have a valid work or study permit

Job Location

150 Cheapside, 1st Flr,London

Employment Type

Regular

Weekly Hours

35

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Analytics, Business, Customer Engagement, Data Analysis, Data Insights, Data Strategies, Financial Modeling, Global Market, Investments, Leadership, Market Trading, Process Improvements, Python (Programming Language), Researching, Solution Strategies

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
The Logistics Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the efficient movement of outbound materials from multiple aggregate locations throughout the Lake Erie region and Northern Virginia. Working collaboratively with a dedicated logistics team, this position is responsible for maintaining a strong understanding of the company's outbound materials strategy, daily sales activity, inventory and stockpile management, and regional transportation networks.

This role focuses on implementing transportation strategies that ensure exceptional customer service, meet market demand, and optimize freight costs. The Logistics Coordinator will also develop and strengthen relationships with transportation providers, identify new service opportunities, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement throughout the supply chain.

Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Coordinate customer orders and dispatch transportation resources to ensure timely and efficient delivery of products to meet customer requirements.

  • Create, update, and manage SAP sales and shipment orders to support accurate and seamless execution of outbound deliveries.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with transportation providers while proactively identifying and onboarding new carrier partners as needed.

  • Oversee the freight payment process, ensuring accurate and timely review, reconciliation, and processing of transportation invoices.

  • Drive optimization of Carmeuse retail yard operations through effective collaboration and communication with Sales, Operations, and transportation partners.

  • Serve as a key contributor to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying and implementing enhancements to site load-out capabilities, transportation efficiency, and operational processes.

  • Monitor daily transportation activity and proactively resolve service issues to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and operational performance.

  • Support cost-effective transportation strategies that balance customer demand, service expectations, and freight expense management.

Basic Requirements:

  • Degree in related field preferred

  • 3-5 years’ experience in transportation and/or logistics. Preferably dispatching in a trucking environment

  • Seasonal demands may include longer hours during the busy season

  • Strong analytical skills

  • SAP experience desired

  • Ability for periodic travel to CLS plants, vendor facilities and customer operations

Knowledge:

  • Understanding the dispatching of trucks in a highly dynamic and fast paced environment

  • Highly self-motivated

  • Strong analytical and evaluation skills and be a clear strategic and systematic thinker as well as a strong tactical leader

  • Demonstrated strong organizational and time management capabilities

  • Must present a professional personal image and have good relationship management skills

  • Knows appropriate negotiating tactics and is able to negotiate win/win agreements without compromising principles

Skills:

  • Must have exceptional interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships both internally and externally

  • Possess strong written and verbal communications skills (Emphasis: telephone, text, and email)

  • Proficient in computer work, with an emphasis on Excel

  • Demonstrate the ability to succeed both as an individual and as part of a team

  • Effectively deals with difficult situations and resolves conflicts

  • Effectively deals with competing priorities to accomplish work responsibilities in a timely manner

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Paid holidays and vacation time
  • Group medical/pharmacy insurance options with company funded health care spending accounts
  • Dental insurance & Vision insurance
  • A 401k account with company matching contribution
  • Company-paid life insurance and short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Options to purchase additional life insurance (employee, spouse, and child) and additional employee long-term disability insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Tuition benefits including professional certifications

title: Salesforce Administrator (ICT)
description:
Could you be Incommunities new Salesforce Administrator? We’re embarking on an ambitious digital transformation, and this role sits right at the heart of it. You’ll help shape the future of how we work, building smarter processes, empowering users and unlocking the full potential of our platform. This is an exciting opportunity to influence meaningful change and make a visible impact across the organisation.

About us

We are a social housing landlord and one of the largest housing providers in the region with over 22,000 social and affordable homes, mainly in the Bradford district. We employ a talented workforce of nearly 1,000 people.

In 2024 we launched our five-year Corporate Strategy, which runs to 2029. Our purpose is to provide high quality homes, services, and support to our customers, so we’ve worked with colleagues and customers to find out what’s important to them. Our customers sit at the heart of what we do, and our colleagues are the people who’ll help us achieve our vision, which is to create the best customer experience to improve everyday lives.

Duties include:

  • Work with IT Project Analysts and subject matter experts to create, test, continuously improve and support Salesforce processes inline with best practice policies.
  • Provide support and training to users to ensure effective use of Salesforce.
  • Maintain user accounts, roles, profiles, and permissions
  • Configure Salesforce objects, fields, page layouts, workflows, validation rules and automation tools (e.g., Flow, Process Builder) to meet business requirements.
  • Oversee data imports, exports, deduplication and cleansing to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with data governance policies.
  • Create and maintain custom reports and dashboards.
  • Monitor system performance, support any scheduled maintenance, and stay up-to-date with Salesforce updates to implement new features and ensure platform stability.

Requirements

  • Experience of Salesforce administration within a production environment.
  • Experience of working with customers to deliver technology change, demonstrating strong communications skills as well as the ability to be able to determine how best to meet the customers needs.
  • Demonstratable problem solving skills and analytical thinking that show how you translate customer requirements into an effective Salesforce solution.
  • Attention to detail and data integrity, ensuring high-quality data management practices and adherence to data governance standards.
  • Enjoy managing projects from origin to successful conclusion.
  • A proactive approach to learning, staying current with Salesforce updates and continuously seeking opportunities to improve system performance and user experience.
  • Minimum of 2 days per week in the office - dependent on project delivery.
  • Right to work in the UK, visa sponsorship isn't available.
  • A basic DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) check will be required for the successful candidate as part of the pre-employment process - Criminal Conviction Checks

Benefits

  • Salary ranges from £43,017 up-to £47,819 depending on experience
  • Social Housing Pension Scheme with up-to 10% employer contribution
  • 28 days annual leave that increases with service plus bank holidays
  • Option to buy and sell annual leave
  • Training, development, and qualification opportunities
  • Our Hub: our wellbeing and benefits site, with exclusive access to discounts and savings (at over 800 retailers)
  • Corporate health scheme membership
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Local gym membership discounts.
  • A team of trained Mental Health First Aiders who are available for colleagues to contact for support

Join Our Team!

We’re looking for great people to join us! At Incommunities, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, included, and supported. We actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences—because we know that diverse perspectives make us stronger.

Based in Bradford, a city known for its rich cultural diversity, we serve vibrant communities. As a social housing provider, we’re passionate about making a real difference by providing safe, affordable homes and improving lives.

Our recruitment process is designed to support you every step of the way. If you need any adjustments or assistance, just let us know.

We’re proud to be a Mindful Employer, committed to mental health and wellbeing. We also hold the ‘Committed’ Menopause Friendly Accreditation, recognising the importance of support in the workplace.

Apply early! We review applications as they come in and may close the advert before the deadline.

Ready to make an impact? Come work with us!

title: Assistant Director, Clinical Operations
description:
Schedule: Full-time, Monday-Friday 8am-430pm

Your experience matters

Rainer Springs is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. As an Outpatient Therapist joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve.

How you’ll contribute

The Assistant Director of Clinical Operations is responsible for the oversight of all clinical treatment programs of patients receiving treatment for psychiatric and substance abuse issues in both inpatient and outpatient settings as delegated by the Director. The Assistant Director ensures that high-quality clinical care is provided and that clinical functions are integrated. The Assistant Director supervises individual and group counseling and develops and implements a variety of therapeutic treatment modalities/processes. The Assistant Director oversees discharge planning to ensure an optimal post hospital transition and is responsible for ensuring that clinical documentation is current and accurate and meets all regulatory and other standards.

Essential Functions: To perform this job, an individual must perform each essential function satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Responsible for ensuring that company approved programs are implemented and being provided consistently.
• Provides oversight to the therapists and provides feedback, training, supervision, coaching, and support.
• Ensure that all interventions are performed and documented according to professional clinical standards.
• Actively participates in survey activities under the direction of the director.

title: Product Engineer, Core Engine
description:
About Open

Open.cx is the AI customer experience platform, automating support, outbound, sales, and customer understanding, built for enterprises that cannot afford slow, expensive, or mediocre support. We automate over 80% of interactions for companies like MoneyGram, Mollie, TicketSwap, and More.com handling voice, email, and web at massive scale with AI that thinks fast and feels human.

We are backed by Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, X by Unifonic. We recently raised $7M+ and are accelerating from a startup into a global scale-up. Our customers replace entire stacks of legacy tools, cut support costs by up to 12×, and deliver dramatically better experiences to their own customers.

We are a small, high-output team that ships fast, works directly with customers, and genuinely cares about the product we are building.

The Role

Product Engineers at Open.cx own problems end-to-end: from spotting an opportunity, to talking directly with users, to shipping the feature in production with no layers in between, no hand-off culture. You are a full-stack owner.

This role focuses on the core engine: the agent runtime, workflows, and APIs that every conversation runs through. You will work on a genuinely hard product, AI customer experience infrastructure used by enterprises at scale across Europe, the US, and the GCC. The codebase is React + TypeScript throughout. The problems are real, the users are live, and the impact is measurable and scalable.

If you want to work somewhere that trusts engineers to think, decide, and ship then look no further!

What You'll Do

  • Identify product opportunities: Spot gaps or improvements before anyone asks you to. Bring proposals, not just execution.
  • Talk to users directly: Understand problems by speaking with the people experiencing them. No layers, no filtered requirements.
  • Ship features end-to-end: Plan, prioritise, and implement full-stack features (React + TypeScript) from concept to production.
  • Own quality: Code reviews, testing, performance, reliability this is your product as much as anyone's.
  • Collaborate closely: Work with the Customer Engineering team to incorporate real user feedback into what you build next.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Experience designing backend systems at scale (APIs, queues, data models) is a big plus.
  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping software products.
  • Strong TypeScript and React you are comfortable owning a full-stack feature without hand-holding.
  • Product instinct you can look at a workflow and know what to fix, not just implement what you are told.
  • Speed and quality in balance you ship fast without leaving messes.
  • Willingness to talk to customers and let reality shape your priorities.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Top-of-market compensation.
  • Full health insurance.
  • Equity participation we want you building this like you own it.
  • Direct collaboration with world-class engineers at a YC-backed company with real enterprise traction.

We are a small team. Every engineer here matters enormously. If you are the type who thrives with real ownership and real impact, Let’s talk.

and/or control-plane platforms.

design, code generation, testing, troubleshooting, and process automation while maintaining strong
engineering judgment.
• Strong API design skills, including RESTful service design and OpenAPI/Swagger or comparable

ORACLE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE | ENGINEERING
Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer — DNS Control Plane
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration automation, especially Terraform and tools

• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across
organizational boundaries.

services.
• Familiarity with modern CI/CD platforms such as OCI DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD,
and engineering productivity tools including Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence.

What Success Looks Like
• You deliver control-plane capabilities that make DNS changes safer, faster, and easier for

AEMO at the Heart of Energy

AEMO is Australia’s independent energy system and market operator and system planner. AEMO’s purpose is to ensure safe, reliable and affordable energy today, and enable the energy transition for the benefit of all Australians. Australian governments are now committed to a net zero economy for Australia by 2050 and our vision is to enable this. We have the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to co-design the future of our energy systems, and our core values revolve around character, commitment, and connection. Join us as we contribute to this significant transition in the energy sector.

About the role

AEMO's Energy Market Cyber Coordination (EMCC) team leads programs which strengthen cyber resilience across the energy sector, coordinate cyber incident response for incidents which may impact the secure and reliable operation of Australia's electricity and gas systems and markets, analyse emerging cyber risks and promote a shared understanding of the threat environment. To support this responsibility, AEMO develops and delivers cyber security exercises that test, validate and improve the preparedness of industry, government and internal stakeholders.

As a Senior Analyst – Energy Market Cyber Exercises, you will support the design, delivery and continuous improvement of AEMO's cyber exercise program. You will develop exercise content, coordinate stakeholders, facilitate activities, evaluate outcomes and manage findings to improve cyber preparedness across AEMO and the broader energy sector. This role combines cyber security, incident response, exercise delivery and stakeholder engagement to strengthen the sector's ability to respond to and recover from cyber incidents.

This is a 24-month Fixed Term Contract and its location is flexible.

Please note that to be eligible for this role you require Australian citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a national security clearance.

  • Support the design, planning, delivery and reporting of AEMO's cyber incident response exercise program.
  • Lead the delivery of cyber incident response exercises and exercise workstreams, including the planning and delivery of sector, national and international tabletop, functional or live-fire exercises.
  • Coordinate stakeholder participation in cyber incident response exercises across industry, government and AEMO.
  • Develop exercise scenarios, reports and other exercise artefacts, including the analysis of exercise outcomes and recommendations to support continuous improvement.
  • Document, consult, track and support the completion of post-exercise improvement actions and activities.

What you will bring to the role

  • Tertiary or post graduate qualifications in IT, cyber security or related fields, and experience in the energy sector, or other critical infrastructure organisations, preferably supporting cyber security or resilience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or delivering cyber incident response exercises, including tabletop, functional or live-fire exercises, and is capable of analysing exercise outcomes, identifying lessons learned and supporting continuous improvement activities.
  • Demonstrated understanding of cyber incident response, crisis management, business continuity, or operational resilience practices.
  • Knowledge of contemporary cyber threats, adversary techniques, defensive cyber security operations and incident response frameworks.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to engage effectively with industry, government and executive stakeholders.

description:

Job Description:

Current Global is an award-winning global communications agency that believes in the power of real connections—between people, brands, and culture. We mix human insight, culture, and media to spark ideas that move people and create lasting impact.

Our diverse, inclusive team thrives on creativity, collaboration, and a shared drive to do meaningful work. At Current, diversity isn’t just a priority—it’s who we are and how we build better ideas.

POSITION PROFILE

Our agency thrives on creativity, data-driven insights, and a deep understanding of human behavior. Our pursuit of culture fuels our strategic approach, sparking inclusive and imaginative work that delivers business impact. The Director, Strategic Planning role is an exciting opportunity for an experienced strategic leader to guide and deliver actionable insights and strategic expertise across our diverse practice areas and world-class clients.

Our ideal candidate will see business problems from the eyes of real people, using data, observation, cultural perspective and experience to create strategies that will benefit a client’s brand and business by connecting with audiences and delivering measurable value. This person will be a culture maven, passionate about the way people experience the world and the trends that are shaping conversation and coverage. With an emphasis on developing compelling insights, this person will be an active counselor across client teams and a major contributor to new business opportunities. The ideal candidate will have experience building brand and creative strategies that deliver ideas across channels, tactics, and content, and possessing the ability to guide measurement that is aligned with strategy is a must.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver effective and inspiring strategic output including briefs, strategic narratives and POVs.

  • Help foster a culture of insight and innovation, ensuring the practice is embedded into our client delivery and that the broader agency is educated on brand and communication strategy fundamentals.

  • Collaborate with Strategy and Client Experience leads to serve as a trusted client counselor and advisor, providing consistent thought leadership.

  • Partner with our powerhouse Creative discipline to translate strategic briefs into compelling creative ideas.

  • Collaborate with the Integrated Media community to ensure seamless integration of strategic plans across various communications channels, tactics, and content types.

  • Support in new business development process by supporting the development of pitch strategies, delivering impactful presentations, and demonstrating the agency’s strategic capabilities.

  • Support and pursue the methods by which teams uncover insights and measure results, consistently challenging the status quo and inspiring teams to explore new approaches to problem-solving.

  • Serve as an opinion leader by sharing best practices, case studies and thought leadership.

  • Potential to represent the agency at industry events.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic planning, brand development, and/or communication strategy, preferably within a public relations agency or related industry.

  • Knowledgeable about the PR industry, including earned media, social media, and influencer engagement.

  • Exceptional ability to translate complex data and consumer insights into actionable strategies that unlock creative ideas designed to earn attention and connect with target audiences.

  • Adept at challenging conventional thought and providing a neutral, objective point of view to drive effective decision-making.

  • Persuasive presenter and speaker, able to tell a story based on data and hypothesis.

  • Demonstrated leadership skills; experience managing and mentoring direct reports.

  • Entrepreneurial and resourceful self-starter passionate about selling work and winning new business.

  • Collaborative work style while juggling multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Detailed-oriented with a commitment to improving processes and outcomes.

About Current Global

Current Global is a human-centered creative communications agency. That is marketing mumbo jumbo for: we eat, play, and dream in culture, so we can help brands stay ahead of the trends to forge deeper and more authentic connections with their consumers.

Our portfolio of iconic brands is a creative person’s dream, offering endless opportunities to work across a wide range of assignments and sectors. The diversity of our client roster reflects our inclusive team structure and collaborative process. We believe the most powerful creative ideas are sparked by bringing together people with different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

At Current Global, the best ideas come from a diverse mix of minds, backgrounds, and experiences—a fusion of creatives, strategists, media and marketing specialists, and client experience experts, all working together to deliver highly effective, award-winning work. This winning formula has earned us 41 Cannes Lions, along with numerous other accolades, including Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas in 2021 and 2024, and recognition in The Valuable 500 in 2023.

Current Global is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Current recruits qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, protected veteran status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or citizenship status.

Current Global recognizes that your health and wellbeing are a priority. We offer a full suite of benefits including medical; dental; vision; 401k (with employer match); tuition reimbursement; $60 monthly reimbursement to be used towards nourishing your health; flexible time off policy; flexible holiday schedules; short-term disability; paid employee family leave; family building benefit.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
description:
Job Title

Postdoctoral Research Associate

Agency

Texas A&M Agrilife Research

Department

Entomology

Proposed Minimum Salary

Commensurate

Job Location

College Station, Texas

Job Type

Staff

Job Description

About Texas A&M AgriLife

Texas A&M AgriLife is comprised of the following Texas A&M University System members:

  • Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service

  • Texas A&M AgriLife Research

  • College of Agriculture and Life Sciences at Texas A&M University

  • Texas A&M Forest Service

  • Texas A&M Veterinary Medical Diagnostic Laboratory

As the nation’s largest most comprehensive agriculture program, Texas A&M AgriLife brings together a college and four state agencies focused on agriculture and life sciences within The Texas A&M University System. With over 5,000 employees and a presence in every county across the state, Texas A&M AgriLife is uniquely positioned to improve lives, environments and the Texas economy through education, research, extension and service.

Click here to learn more about how you can be a part of AgriLife and make a difference in the world!

Position Information

Position Description:

In collaboration with others at Texas A&M and Texas Tech, our team will rapidly formulate a field-ready treatment for screwworm-caused myasis into three formats: a wound-conforming foam for high-retention coverage, a bio-adhesive spray for rapid application, and an immersion-wash for high-throughput treatment. The team will also perform veterinary safety and residue testing generating final formulations for dairy and beef cattle to measure active ingredient concentrations in milk, plasma, and edible tissues to determine the exact time required for the active ingredients to clear the body. We are seeking an enthusiastic, driven, and independent individual to join our team as a Postdoctoral Research Associate to rapidly lead research efforts focused on quantifying larvicidal performance against C. macellaria as a proxy and C. hominivorax prior to final confirmation, reporting LC90, LC99, and time-to-kill metrics. The successful candidate will measure dose-sparing efficacy by determining the reduction in synthetic active ingredients required to effectively kill larvae when combined with botanicals as compared to single product active baselines. Due to the state of emergency of C. hominivorax re-emergence, this is a research leadership role requiring independent scientific research skills primarily including an organized efficiency for planning and scheduling experiments with live organisms, a demonstrated ability to effectively collaborate with multi-institutional/multidisciplinary mentor supportive personnel, and a strong publication record.

Responsibilities:

- Support blow fly colony maintenance.

- Lead larvicidal efficacy baseline dose–response and time-to-kill benchmarks for single active ingredients and combinations of active ingredients against secondary screwworms.

- Effectively communicate and collaborate with chemical engineers, veterinarians, microbial ecologists, and entomologists to execute and complete a five-objective project within two years. 

- Managing data pipelines, ensuring data integrity, and leading quantitative analyses. 

- Producing peer-reviewed manuscripts, quarterly technical reports, and presentations for annual scientific and sponsor-required monthly meetings. 

- Mentoring supportive personnel (i.e., research technicians and undergraduate research assistants) providing leadership and quality control for all data collection, data organization, and project execution to publication.

- Be an engaged and active community member of the Kaufman lab by participating as a respectful team player of the lab group.

Required Qualifications:

- A PhD in entomology, chemistry, animal science, toxicology, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Strong background in pesticide formulation generation and/or efficacy testing experience with arthropods.

- Strong background in arthropod handling and/or rearing experience.

- Strong background in livestock handling or working in those systems experience.

- Experience and eagerness in finding, curating, submitting, and obtaining research grants or fellowships. 

- Experience in mentoring researchers in training. 

- Experience in Extension or outreach. 

- Experience working with arthropods. 

- Experience working with live-animals in a research or medical setting. 

- Experience with invertebrates colony rearing or vertebrate husbandry in a research setting. 

- Capacity to work effectively in challenging field conditions (temperature extremes, wind, rain, biting insects, mud) while maintaining rigorous data quality standards. 

- Experience with molecular assays (cell cultures, histology, PCR, Gel Electrophoresis, qPCR, etc.). 

- Experience with data management, statistical analysis (including but not limited to, probit models for determination of LC/D), and the ability to generate figures/summaries of key results.

- Experience with arthropod identification via taxonomic dichotomous keys.

Required Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities: 

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills to demonstrate the ability to cultivate and maintain professional working relationships with people of various backgrounds. 

- Peer-reviewed publications demonstrating independent research contributions, project execution, and scientific writing. 

- Proficiency in quantitative methods and statistical analysis 

- Phenomenal data organizational skills including maintaining organized data/samples in a timely and detailed manner both physically and virtually; to ensure transparent records for all collaborators.

- Demonstrated capacity to independently troubleshoot issues. 

- Ability to multi-task and work cooperatively with others. 

- Ability and willingness to occasionally work extended hours including weekends and holidays, as determined by arthropod care and experimental needs. 

- Ability to work in confined spaces at site while caring for arthropods. 

- Willingness to work with live-arthropods, including potentially live-animals, and to follow animal welfare, safety, and compliance requirements in a research environment. 

- Willingness to work with arthropods in unpleasant conditions and with offensive odors from animal products. 

- Maintaining knowledge and implementation of lab standard operating procedures, workspace preparation, lab techniques, and safety.

Other Requirements or Other Factors: 

- Opportunities to participate in other ongoing projects in the lab will arise as skill set, interest, project progression, and independence is demonstrated. 

- Must be willing to work with pesticides and potentially biosafety risk group agents of level 2. 

- Work may require standing/sitting at for extended periods of time. 

- Occasional weekend duties to support active research is required. 

- Work occasionally requires hot, outdoor environments in remote areas. 

- Occasional overnight and/or weekend travel associated with research or conferences. 

- Through the USDA cooperative agreement this position is for 2 years. Acquiring additional funding may be supported depending on the postdoctoral research associate’s ability to lead grant procurement.

What You Need to Know

Salary: Compensation for this position is commensurate based on the selected candidate’s qualifications.

Why Work at Texas A&M AgriLife?

When you choose to work for Texas A&M AgriLife, you become part of an organization that is an established leader in agriculture and life sciences with a wide range of capabilities to meet the needs of our statewide, national, and international constituents.

In addition, Texas A&M AgriLife offers a comprehensive benefit package including the following:

  • Health, dental, vision, life and long-term disability insurance with Texas A&M AgriLife contributing to employee health and basic life premiums

  • 12-15 days of annual paid holidays

  • Up to eight hours of paid sick leave and at least eight hours of paid vacation each month

  • Automatic enrollment in the Teacher Retirement System of Texas

  • Employee Wellness Initiative for Texas A&M AgriLife

Applicant Instructions

Applications received by Texas A&M AgriLife must either have all job application data entered or a resume attached. Failure to provide all job application data or a complete resume could result in an invalid submission and a rejected application. We encourage all applicants to upload a resume or use a LinkedIn profile to prepopulate the online application.

title: Engineer, Senior - Civil and Structural - Engineering Projects
description:
Engineer, Senior – Civil & Structural – Engineering Projects (242069)

About Us

New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.

About the role

NPL is seeking an experienced Engineer, Senior - Civil & Structural to join the Capital & Projects Department. Reporting to the Superintendent – Engineering Projects, this role is responsible for providing technical leadership in the design, review, and delivery of civil and structural engineering solutions for capital projects across the operation.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, within budget, and to engineering standards while providing guidance to junior engineers and managing external engineering consultants.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Lead and review civil and structural engineering designs, drawings, and specifications.
• Prepare technical documents, including reports, calculations and drawings
• Provide package engineering and procurement support
• Provide engineering input to design deliverables (documents and drawings)
• Provide engineering checks of design deliverables
• Able to produce technical drawings using AutoCAD software
• Build strong collaborative working relationships, manage contractors, consultants and support key stakeholders at various stages to adhere technical and statutory compliance, quality delivery, and ensure schedule baselines and contractual obligations.
• Provide technical support in all project phases
• Effectively communicate with contractors and other parties involved in any projects
• Prepare budget plans for Approval for Expenditure (AFE) and ensure projects are executed within the budget limits at appropriate stages
• Perform risk assessments and develop mitigation plans
• Manage and mentor junior engineer(s)
• Maintain a high level of health and safety awareness and comply with NPL Occupational Health & Safety Policy and all health rules and procedures


About You

Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in civil or Structural Engineering.
• Minimum 8 years' relevant experience in civil and structural design engineering.
• Strong experience in concrete and steel structure design.
• Adept user of software such as SpaceGass, STAAD.Pro, and AutoCAD.
• Proficient in AS/NS and PNG design standards e.g. AS/NZS 4671, AS2870, AS3600, AS/NZS 1170.0 - 1170.4 (Loads), PNGS 1001- 1982 etc.
• Experience in software like AutoCAD or similar.
• Experience in engineering project management.
• Mining industry and gold processing plant experience will be an advantage.
• Strong communication, planning, analytical and problem-solving skills
• Proven track record of seamless cross-function coordination and able to provide inputs and function effectively on interdepartmental assignments as required.
• Good knowledge of bulk earthwork or civil engineering and design is desirable

Mobilization Requirement

This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately. Females are encouraged to apply.

Join Our Team as an Engineer, Senior – Civil & Structural – Engineering Projects

Embark on a rewarding career with NPL as an Engineer, Senior – Civil & Structural – Engineering Projects. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. Enjoy a balanced work schedule, competitive compensation, and a chance to develop your career and technical expertise in a supportive and professional environment.

Note: This advert will be open until 14th September 2026. If you do not hear from NPL within next two (2) weeks following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.

title: Tech Lead Engineer
description:
Senior Tech Lead / Principal Engineer

About the Company

An innovative, fast-growing FinTech is transforming the mortgage industry through technology and AI, with a mission to make borrowing more accessible and help mortgage brokers overcome affordability and risk challenges.

The business has experienced significant growth, increasing annual lending volumes by over 80% to approximately £350m in 2025, alongside major investment in technology and AI.

The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead to help shape and build the next generation of a modern lending platform.

This is not a traditional management role. You'll remain heavily involved in designing, coding, testing and reviewing production software while influencing architecture, technical direction and engineering standards.

AI is central to the role. You'll work hands-on with LLMs, RAG, agentic workflows and AI-enabled services, taking ideas from rapid experimentation through to secure, reliable production systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype and ship production software across the lending platform.
  • Build AI-powered products using LLMs, RAG, agents and model APIs.
  • Develop AI tools for brokers and underwriters, including decision support and workflow automation.
  • Shape architecture and technical direction through practical experimentation.
  • Build scalable, secure APIs, web applications and AWS cloud-native services.
  • Establish approaches to AI evaluation, observability, safety and cost management.
  • Raise engineering standards through mentoring, pairing and code reviews.
  • Work with technical and non-technical stakeholders to turn complex problems into practical solutions.

Tech Stack

Python, React, TypeScript, Django, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, REST APIs, Git and CI/CD.

AI technologies include LLMs, RAG, vector search/embeddings, agentic workflows, prompt engineering, structured outputs, LLM evaluation and Amazon Bedrock.

What We're Looking For

  • Expert Python development skills.
  • Strong React/TypeScript experience.
  • Strong experience with Django and/or FastAPI.
  • Demonstrable technical leadership through influence, delivery and mentoring.
  • Hands-on experience building and productionising AI/LLM systems.
  • A pragmatic approach focused on simplicity, maintainability, security and reliability.

Web Administrator

Company: AAA Radiators

Location: Croydon Park, NSW 2133

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: $82,000–$95,000 per annum plus superannuation

Classification: Information & Communication Technology – Web Development & Production

About the Business

AAA Radiators is an Australian family business with over 40 years’ experience supplying automotive cooling, air-conditioning, lighting, and electrical parts, including radiators, intercoolers, condensers, and headlights, to trade customers nationally. Operating distribution warehouses across NSW, VIC, QLD, and WA, we support mechanical workshops and commercial fleet operators. Our B2B e-commerce platform gives trade clients access to thousands of components, trade pricing, and efficient online ordering. As our digital operations continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Web Administrator to maintain and improve the accuracy, reliability, and usability of these customer-facing digital systems.

About the Role

The Web Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of AAA Radiators’ website and B2B platform. Working with sales, warehouse, procurement, customer service teams, and external technology providers, the Web Administrator ensures our ordering channels remain accurate, reliable, and user-friendly. This position focuses on CMS management, catalogue maintenance, front-end updates, website functionality, and platform usability. The role works alongside our internal IT team, which manages broader infrastructure, database, and system development activities.

Key Responsibilities

Website Administration & Content Management

  1. Manage website updates, CMS administration, storefront configuration, and ongoing improvements to customer-facing digital content.
  2. Maintain website pages, navigation structures, and product information while documenting content changes.
  3. Perform front-end visual checks to ensure website content and layouts display correctly before publishing.
  4. Identify website content, display, and usability issues, coordinating appropriate resolutions with internal and external teams.

Digital Catalogue & E-Commerce Support

  1. Maintain accuracy of a large online catalogue, uploading descriptions, specifications, images, and technical documentation.
  2. Manage customer account features, including trade customer account registrations, login access, and pricing visibility settings.
  3. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure live storefront information accurately reflects active inventory.
  4. Support front-end improvements to product search, filtering, navigation, and online ordering layouts.

Technical Coordination & Escalation

  1. Monitor storefront uptime, page performance, and responsiveness across desktop and mobile devices.
  2. Maintain website access settings, SSL renewals, and website-level security settings.
  3. Document display errors and broken links, and escalate database synchronisation issues or API faults to the IT team.
  4. Monitor analytics and apply basic SEO practices to improve customer experience and site visibility.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  1. Minimum one year work experience maintaining commercial websites, customer portals, e-commerce platforms, or digital catalogues.
  2. Experience with CMS tools, e-commerce administration, and high-volume B2B or wholesale platforms.
  3. Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and clear cross-team communication skills.
  4. Diploma or higher in Information Technology, Web Development, E-Commerce, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  5. Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for website maintenance and front-end updates.
  6. Understanding of responsive web design principles.
  7. Understanding of hosting, domain management, SSL setups, Google Analytics, and technical SEO.
  8. Ability to evaluate user interfaces, identify layout issues, and document storefront anomalies.

Benefits & How to Apply

  1. Stable full-time role with a collaborative, established national industry leader.
  2. Clear ownership over the visual presentation and usability of a major trade platform.
  3. Professional development opportunities in digital commerce management.

Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your experience in website administration and digital catalogue management.

AAA Radiators is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

title: Senior Vice President - Loan Operations
description:
About Citco:

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we’ve been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we’ll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

About the Team & Business Line:

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.

As a core member of our Loan operation team, you will be working with some of the industry’s most accomplished professionals to deliver award-winning services for the world’s largest alterative credit lenders. Citco’s total loan portfolio exceeds 100B, across a variety of asset and loan types including publicly traded bank debt, private syndications, middle market transactions, and commercial real estate. We provide shadow and direct loan agency.

About the Role:
The Senior Vice President (SVP) of Loan Operations is a strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing the global delivery, risk management, and performance of loan processing functions. The SVP will lead a high-performing team across multiple regions, ensure operational excellence, drive client satisfaction, and implement scalable solutions that support business growth and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead and manage global loan operations teams responsible for trade capture, funding, position management, reconciliations, and lifecycle events across syndicated and bilateral loans.
  • Define and execute strategic initiatives to scale operations, enhance controls, and improve overall efficiency.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (Middle Office, Fund Accounting, Compliance, IT) and external clients to ensure timely and accurate processing.
  • Provide governance oversight of agent notice workflows, system transitions, and issue resolution processes.
  • Build and maintain a strong risk and control environment by implementing the best practices and robust documentation standards.
  • Drive transformation projects include automation, system integration, and workflow optimization (e.g., Aexeo, Sentry, CitcoRecs).
  • Manage talent across global locations, including coaching, performance reviews, and succession planning.
  • Serve as an escalation point for clients and internal teams on complex or high-risk transactions.
  • Ensure adherence to internal policies, client SLAs, and regulatory obligations.
  • Contribute to the firm’s strategic direction through active participation in governance committees and global initiatives.

About You:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in loan operations, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Deep understanding of syndicated loans, private credit, bilateral lending, and associated operational processes.
  • Proven track record of managing global teams and driving operational improvements.
  • Strong project management skills and experience with system implementations.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (MBA or CFA preferred).

Our Benefits

Your well-being is of paramount importance and central to our success here at Citco. Citco offers a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package to support your career success and personal needs. Your base salary will be determined by several factors such as the role, experience, skillset, market conditions, etc. Furthermore, qualifying positions can participate in an annual discretionary bonus pool based on company profitability and individual contributions. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, short and long-term disability benefits, a retirement savings plan, tuition reimbursement, mental health and wellness support, parental leave, and more. Additional details about our total rewards package will be shared during the hiring process.

At Citco, we take pride in fostering an inclusive culture by prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation, mutual respect, and collaboration. We warmly welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. If you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer, Citco adheres to making all employment and personnel decisions without discriminating based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, physical disability, mental disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national or ethnic origin, or any other protected status. We believe that an inclusive workforce not only enriches our company but also drives us towards greater success.
